title: 25 ટકા ટેરિફના અમેરિકાના પ્રસ્તાવ પર ભારતનો સ્પષ્ટ જવાબ, જાણો શું કહ્યું?
description: કથિત વધારાની ઉત્પાદન ક્ષમતાના આધારે ભારત સહિત 14 અર્થવ્યવસ્થા પર નવા ટેરિફ લાદવાના યુએસના પ્રસ્તાવ પર, ભારત સરકારે કહ્યું કે દેશમાં માળખાકીય રીતે વધારાની ઉત્પાદન ક્ષમતા નથી.
author: એબીપી અસ્મિતા વેબ ટીમ
content:
USTR એ કથિત વધારાની ઉત્પાદન ક્ષમતા અને અનુચિત ગતિવિધિના આરોપો પર ભારત સહિત 14 અર્થવ્યવસ્થાઓ પર નવા ટેરિફનો પ્રસ્તાવ મૂક્યો છે. ભારતે આ આરોપોને ફગાવ્યા છે.
25 ટકા ટેરિફના અમેરિકાના પ્રસ્તાવ પર ભારતનો સ્પષ્ટ જવાબ, જાણો શું કહ્યું?
કથિત વધારાની ઉત્પાદન ક્ષમતાના આધારે ભારત સહિત 14 અર્થવ્યવસ્થા પર નવા ટેરિફ લાદવાના યુએસના પ્રસ્તાવ પર, ભારત સરકારે કહ્યું કે દેશમાં માળખાકીય રીતે વધારાની ઉત્પાદન ક્ષમતા નથી.
- અમેરિકાના નવા ટેરિફ પ્રસ્તાવ પર ભારતે ક્ષમતાનો ઇનકાર કર્યો.
- અમેરિકાએ 8 મહિના તપાસ બાદ ભારત પર ટેરિફ સૂચવ્યા.
- ભારત દ્વિપક્ષીય વેપાર સમજૂતી હેઠળ મુદ્દાઓ ઉકેલવા સંમત.
- ભારત અમેરિકા સાથે વહેલી તકે સમજૂતી કરવા પ્રતિબદ્ધ છે.
ભારતે અમેરિકાના નવા ટેરિફ લાદવાના પ્રસ્તાવ પર પોતાનું વલણ સ્પષ્ટ કરતાં કહ્યું છે કે દેશમાં કોઈપણ ઔદ્યોગિક ક્ષેત્રમાં વધારાની ઉત્પાદન ક્ષમતા નથી. યુએસ ટ્રેડ રિપ્રેઝન્ટેટિવ (USTR) એ ભારત સહિત 14 અર્થ વ્યવસ્થા પર કથિત વધારાની ઉત્પાદન ક્ષમતા અને અનુચિત ગતિવિધિના આરોપો પર નવા ટેરિફ લાદવાનો પ્રસ્તાવ મૂક્યો છે.
ભારત સરકારે જણાવ્યું હતું કે, આ મામલાની તપાસ અંગેની નોટિસની સમીક્ષા કરવામાં આવી રહી છે અને તેણે સમગ્ર પ્રક્રિયા દરમિયાન અમેરિકા સાથે રચનાત્મક રીતે સહયોગ કર્યો છે.
ભારતે આરોપોને ફગાવ્યા
વાણિજ્ય અને ઉદ્યોગ મંત્રાલયે બુધવારે જાહેર કરેલા નિવેદનમાં જણાવ્યું હતું કે, તપાસ શરૂ કરવાની નોટિસ અને ત્યારબાદની કાર્યવાહી દરમિયાન વાણિજ્ય વિભાગે સ્પષ્ટ કર્યું હતું કે, ભારતના કોઈપણ ક્ષેત્રમાં માળખાકીય રીતે વધારાની ઉત્પાદન ક્ષમતા નથી.મંત્રાલયના જણાવ્યા અનુસાર, અમેરિકાની નોટિસ હાલમાં સમીક્ષા હેઠળ છે. ભારતે તપાસની સમગ્ર પ્રક્રિયા દરમિયાન પોતાનો પક્ષ મજબૂતીથી રજૂ કર્યો છે અને સંબંધિત મુદ્દાઓ પર રચનાત્મક રીતે ભાગ લીધો છે.
આઠ મહિનાની તપાસ બાદ ટેરિફનો પ્રસ્તાવ
અમેરિકાએ ટ્રેડ એક્ટ 1974ની કલમ 301 હેઠળ આઠ મહિના સુધી તપાસ કર્યા બાદ નવા ટેરિફ (આયાત શુલ્ક) લાદવાનો પ્રસ્તાવ મૂક્યો છે. આ તપાસમાં 16 વેપારી ભાગીદારો સાથે સંકળાયેલી કથિત અયોગ્ય વેપાર પ્રવૃત્તિઓ અને વધારાની ઉત્પાદન ક્ષમતા સંબંધિત તપાસ કરવામાં આવી હતી. અમેરિકાના આ પ્રસ્તાવમાં ભારત ઉપરાંત ચીન, બાંગ્લાદેશ, કંબોડિયા, યુરોપિયન યુનિયન, ઇન્ડોનેશિયા, જાપાન, દક્ષિણ કોરિયા, મલેશિયા, સિંગાપોર, સ્વિટ્ઝર્લેન્ડ, તાઇવાન, થાઇલેન્ડ અને વિયેતનામને પણ સામેલ કરવામાં આવ્યા છે.અમેરિકાના પ્રસ્તાવ મુજબ, ભારત પર 25 ટકા જ્યારે ચીન પર 40 ટકા ટેરિફ (આયાત શુલ્ક) લાદવાનો પ્રસ્તાવ મૂકવામાં આવ્યો છે.
વેપાર સમજૂતી હેઠળ મુદ્દાઓ ઉકેલવા પર ભાર
ભારતે સ્પષ્ટ કર્યું છે કે અમેરિકા સાથે વેપાર સંબંધિત તમામ મુદ્દાઓ પર ચાલી રહેલી દ્વિપક્ષીય વેપાર સમજૂતી (BTA)ની વાટાઘાટો હેઠળ જ ચર્ચા થવી જોઈએ.
વાણિજ્ય મંત્રાલયે જણાવ્યું હતું કે, બંને દેશો આ સમજૂતીને લઈને વાટાઘાટો કરી રહ્યા છે. ભારત શરૂઆતથી જ એવું વલણ ધરાવે છે કે વેપાર સંબંધિત તમામ ચિંતાઓ અને મુદ્દાઓનું સમાધાન આ વાટાઘાટોના માળખા હેઠળ જ કરવામાં આવે.
મંત્રાલયે વધુમાં જણાવ્યું હતું કે ભારત સરકાર અમેરિકા સાથે મળીને શક્ય તેટલી વહેલી તકે દ્વિપક્ષીય વેપાર સમજૂતીને અંતિમ સ્વરૂપ આપવા માટે પ્રતિબદ્ધ છે.
સરકારના જણાવ્યા અનુસાર, આ દિશામાં ભારત વોશિંગ્ટન સાથે સતત રચનાત્મક સહયોગ જાળવી રાખશે.
Before You Go
Surat: બારડોલી ટ્રિપલ મર્ડર કેસમાં પોલીસને સફળતા, મહારાષ્ટ્રથી 1 શખ્સની અટકાયત, વીમા વિવાદની આશંકા
Frequently Asked Questions
અમેરિકાએ ભારત પર નવા ટેરિફ લાદવાનો પ્રસ્તાવ શા માટે મૂક્યો છે?
ભારતે અમેરિકાના ટેરિફના પ્રસ્તાવ પર શું પ્રતિક્રિયા આપી છે?
ભારતે સ્પષ્ટ કર્યું છે કે દેશમાં કોઈપણ ઔદ્યોગિક ક્ષેત્રમાં વધારાની ઉત્પાદન ક્ષમતા નથી. ભારતે સમગ્ર પ્રક્રિયા દરમિયાન અમેરિકા સાથે રચનાત્મક રીતે સહયોગ કર્યો છે.
અમેરિકાના આ પ્રસ્તાવમાં ભારત સિવાય કયા દેશોનો સમાવેશ થાય છે અને ભારત માટે કેટલા ટેરિફ સૂચવાયા છે?
આ પ્રસ્તાવમાં ચીન, બાંગ્લાદેશ, યુરોપિયન યુનિયન સહિત કુલ 14 અર્થવ્યવસ્થાઓ શામેલ છે. અમેરિકાએ ભારત પર 25% અને ચીન પર 40% ટેરિફ લાદવાનો પ્રસ્તાવ મૂક્યો છે.
ભારત વેપાર સંબંધિત મુદ્દાઓને ઉકેલવા માટે કયો માર્ગ અપનાવવા માંગે છે?
ભારત વેપાર સંબંધિત તમામ મુદ્દાઓને ચાલી રહેલી દ્વિપક્ષીય વેપાર સમજૂતી (BTA)ની વાટાઘાટો હેઠળ ઉકેલવા માંગે છે. ભારત સરકાર શક્ય તેટલી વહેલી તકે BTA ને અંતિમ સ્વરૂપ આપવા પ્રતિબદ્ધ છે.

title: યૂપી ચૂંટણીઃ સર્વેએ મચાવ્યો તહેલકો, 'કાંટે કે ટક્કર'માં કોની બની રહી છે સરકાર ?
description: જો આપણે મત હિસ્સાની વાત કરીએ તો, અહીં પણ નજીકની સ્પર્ધા દેખાઈ રહી છે. સર્વે મુજબ, જો ચૂંટણી અત્યારે યોજાય તો ભાજપને 36.69 ટકા મત મળી શકે છે
author: એબીપી અસ્મિતા વેબ ટીમ
content:
યૂપી ચૂંટણીઃ સર્વેએ મચાવ્યો તહેલકો, 'કાંટે કે ટક્કર'માં કોની બની રહી છે સરકાર ?
જો આપણે મત હિસ્સાની વાત કરીએ તો, અહીં પણ નજીકની સ્પર્ધા દેખાઈ રહી છે. સર્વે મુજબ, જો ચૂંટણી અત્યારે યોજાય તો ભાજપને 36.69 ટકા મત મળી શકે છે
- 2027 યુપી ચૂંટણીમાં ભાજપ-સપા વચ્ચે નજીકની સ્પર્ધા.
- ભાજપને 177-215, સપાને 160-202 બેઠકો મળવાનો અંદાજ.
- સર્વે મુજબ, સપાને ભાજપ કરતાં વધુ મત હિસ્સો.
- મુખ્યમંત્રી તરીકે યોગી આદિત્યનાથ પ્રથમ પસંદગી રહ્યા.
2027ની યુપી વિધાનસભા ચૂંટણી અંગેનો લેટેસ્ટ સર્વે બહાર પાડવામાં આવ્યો છે. આ મુજબ, યુપીમાં નજીકની સ્પર્ધાની અપેક્ષા છે. સર્વે મુજબ, જો હવે ચૂંટણીઓ યોજાય તો, ભાજપ યુપીમાં 177–215 બેઠકો જીતી શકે છે. સપા 160–202 બેઠકો જીતી શકે છે. સર્વે મુજબ, જયંત ચૌધરીની આરએલડી 10 બેઠકો, અપના દળ (એસ) 5, સુભાસ્પા 3–5, નિષાદ પાર્ટી 1–3, કોંગ્રેસ 2 અને બસપા 1 બેઠક જીતી શકે છે. રાજા ભૈયા બે બેઠકો જીતી શકે છે. સર્વેમાં સૌથી મહત્વપૂર્ણ મુદ્દો એ છે કે યુપીમાં 42 બેઠકો એવી છે જ્યાં ભાજપ અને સપા વચ્ચે ખૂબ જ નજીકની સ્પર્ધાની અપેક્ષા છે.
એ નોંધવું જોઈએ કે ઉત્તર પ્રદેશમાં, જ્યાં 403 વિધાનસભા બેઠકો છે, બહુમતી માટે જાદુઈ સંખ્યા 202 છે. જો આ સર્વેના આંકડાઓને ગઠબંધન દ્વારા ધ્યાનમાં લેવામાં આવે તો, NDA 181-226 બેઠકો જીતી શકે છે, અને અખિલ ભારતીય જોડાણ 174-219 બેઠકો જીતી શકે છે. ઉત્તર પ્રદેશ SCORE ઓપિનિયન પોલ 15 ઓક્ટોબર, 2026 અને 23 નવેમ્બર, 2026 વચ્ચે હાથ ધરવામાં આવ્યો હતો.
ભાજપ અને સપા વચ્ચે મત હિસ્સામાં પણ કાંટાની ટક્કર છે!
જો આપણે મત હિસ્સાની વાત કરીએ તો, અહીં પણ નજીકની સ્પર્ધા દેખાઈ રહી છે. સર્વે મુજબ, જો ચૂંટણી અત્યારે યોજાય તો ભાજપને 36.69 ટકા મત મળી શકે છે. સપાને 36.98 ટકા મત મળી શકે છે. બસપાને 11.45 ટકા, કોંગ્રેસને 7.67 ટકા, ચંદ્રશેખર આઝાદની પાર્ટીને 2.54 ટકા, અપના દળ (એસ)ને 1.23 ટકા, આરએલડીને 1.15 ટકા, સુભાસ્પાને 0.8 ટકા, નિષાદ પાર્ટીને 0.51 ટકા, રાજા ભૈયાની પાર્ટીને 0.12 ટકા અને અન્યને 0.87 ટકા મત મળી શકે છે.
મુખ્યમંત્રી પદ માટે કોણ પસંદ છે?
મુખ્યમંત્રી યોગી આદિત્યનાથ મુખ્યમંત્રી પસંદગીઓની યાદીમાં ટોચ પર છે. સર્વે મુજબ, 35.29 ટકા લોકોએ મુખ્યમંત્રી યોગીને પોતાની પસંદગી જાહેર કરી છે. સપાના વડા અખિલેશ યાદવ બીજા ક્રમે છે, 26.50 ટકા લોકો તેમને રાજ્યના આગામી મુખ્યમંત્રી તરીકે જોવા માંગે છે. 8.59 ટકા લોકો બસપાના વડા માયાવતીને મુખ્યમંત્રી તરીકે પસંદ કરે છે. 22.66 ટકા લોકોએ 'ખબર નથી' જવાબ આપ્યો. સર્વેમાં, 1.90 ટકા લોકોએ ચંદ્રશેખર આઝાદ, 1.25 ટકા લોકોએ પ્રિયંકા ગાંધી, 1 ટકા રાજનાથ સિંહ, 0.27 ટકા લોકોએ રાહુલ ગાંધી અને 0.14 ટકા લોકોએ કેશવ પ્રસાદ મૌર્યને પસંદ કર્યા.

title: Train Fan Electricity: ઘરની વીજળીથી કેમ નથી ચાલી શકતા ટ્રેનના પંખા ? જાણી લો કારણ
description: Train Fan Electricity: પરંપરાગત નોન-એસી રેલવે કોચ સામાન્ય રીતે પંખા અને લાઇટ માટે 110 વોલ્ટ ડીસી સપ્લાયનો ઉપયોગ કરે છે. તેની સરખામણીમાં ભારતમાં ઘરગથ્થુ વીજળી સામાન્ય રીતે 230 વોલ્ટ એસી પર સપ્લાય કરવામાં આવે છે. કારણ કે વોલ્ટેજ અને કરંટ બંને અલગ-અલગ પ્રકારના હોય છે, આ કારણે ટ્રેનના પંખાને સીધા ઘરના સોકેટ સાથે જોડવાથી તેની મોટર ખરાબ થઈ શકે છે.
author: એબીપી અસ્મિતા વેબ ટીમ
content:
હોમફોટો ગેલેરીદેશTrain Fan Electricity: ઘરની વીજળીથી કેમ નથી ચાલી શકતા ટ્રેનના પંખા ? જાણી લો કારણ
Train Fan Electricity: ઘરની વીજળીથી કેમ નથી ચાલી શકતા ટ્રેનના પંખા ? જાણી લો કારણ
Train Fan Electricity: ભારતીય ટ્રેનોમાં લાગેલા પંખા ઘરની વીજળીથી ચાલી શકતા નથી. ચાલો જાણીએ તેની પાછળનું કારણ શું છે અને રેલવેના પંખા ઘરના પંખાથી શા માટે અલગ છે
Train Fan Electricity: પરંપરાગત નોન-એસી રેલવે કોચ સામાન્ય રીતે પંખા અને લાઇટ માટે 110 વોલ્ટ ડીસી સપ્લાયનો ઉપયોગ કરે છે. તેની સરખામણીમાં ભારતમાં ઘરગથ્થુ વીજળી સામાન્ય રીતે 230 વોલ્ટ એસી પર સપ્લાય કરવામાં આવે છે. કારણ કે વોલ્ટેજ અને કરંટ બંને અલગ-અલગ પ્રકારના હોય છે, આ કારણે ટ્રેનના પંખાને સીધા ઘરના સોકેટ સાથે જોડવાથી તેની મોટર ખરાબ થઈ શકે છે.
2/8
ઘરગથ્થુ ઇન્વર્ટર સામાન્ય રીતે 12 વોલ્ટ અથવા 24 વોલ્ટ ડીસી બેટરીનો ઉપયોગ કરે છે. આ સાથે, તેઓ ઘરગથ્થુ ઉપકરણો માટે તેમની શક્તિને એસીમાં રૂપાંતરિત કરે છે. 110 વોલ્ટ ડીસી માટે ડિઝાઇન કરાયેલ રેલવે પંખો આ વ્યવસ્થા દ્વારા સીધો ચાલી શકતો નથી. જોકે, ઘરગથ્થુ બેટરી સિસ્ટમને ઉચ્ચ વોલ્ટેજ સ્તર માટે પણ ડિઝાઇન કરી શકાય છે.
3/8
સ્વ-ઉત્પાદક રેલવે ડબ્બાઓમાં ટ્રેનના પૈડાં સાથે જોડાયેલા અલ્ટરનેટર વીજળી ઉત્પન્ન કરે છે. આ વીજળી કોચમાં લાગેલી બેટરીઓને ચાર્જ કરે છે જે ટ્રેન ઊભી રહે ત્યારે અથવા અલ્ટરનેટરથી વીજળી ઉત્પન્ન ન થતી હોય ત્યારે પંખા અને લાઇટ જેવા જરૂરી ઉપકરણોને વીજળી પૂરી પાડે છે.
4/8
બેટરી સિસ્ટમ એ સુનિશ્ચિત કરે છે કે ટ્રેન ઊભી હોય ત્યારે પણ મુસાફરોને મૂળભૂત વિદ્યુત સુવિધા મળતી રહે. જોકે, પંખા અને લાઇટ કેટલા સમય સુધી કામ કરશે તે બેટરીની ક્ષમતા અને તેની સ્થિતિ પર આધાર રાખે છે.
5/8
એવો દાવો છે કે રેલવેએ 110 વોલ્ટ ડીસી પંખા અપનાવ્યા છે જેથી ચોરી થાય તો તેનો ઉપયોગ ઘરોમાં ન કરી શકાય. જોકે, કોઈ સ્પષ્ટ સત્તાવાર પુરાવા આ વાતને સમર્થન આપતા નથી. રેલવેના ટેકનિકલ દસ્તાવેજો આ પ્રણાલીનો ઉલ્લેખ કોચના ઉપકરણોને વીજળી પૂરી પાડવાની એક રીત તરીકે કરે છે.
6/8
રેલવેના પંખા, લાઇટ અને અન્ય ઉપકરણો સરકારી રેલવે સંપત્તિ છે. રેલવે સંપત્તિ અધિનિયમ 1966ની કલમ 3 મુજબ, ગેરકાયદેસર કબજો અથવા ચોરી કરવા પર 5 વર્ષ સુધીની કેદ, દંડ અથવા બંને થઈ શકે છે. વારંવાર ગુનો કરવા પર પણ આ જ સજા થાય છે.
7/8
એવો દાવો કે રેલવે સંપત્તિ ચોરી કરવા પર આપમેળે 7 વર્ષની જેલની સજા થાય છે તે ખોટો છે. કાયદામાં 5 વર્ષ સુધીની જેલ, દંડ અથવા બંનેની જોગવાઈ છે.
8/8
110 વોલ્ટ ડીસી વ્યવસ્થાને દરેક રેલવે કોચ માટે યુનિવર્સલ સ્ટાન્ડર્ડ ન માનવી જોઈએ. પરંપરાગત સ્વ-ઉત્પાદક કોચમાં અલ્ટરનેટર એસી વીજળી ઉત્પન્ન કરે છે જેને રેક્ટિફાયર રેગ્યુલેટર દ્વારા ડીસીમાં બદલી શકાય છે.

title: PM Modi, Nepal PM Balendra Shah jointly flag off Saryu-Kamala Express connecting Ayodhya with Janakpur Dham
description: PM Modi and Nepal PM Balendra Shah flag off the Saryu-Kamala Express, boosting rail connectivity and religious tourism between India and Nepal.
author: Odisha TV Bureau
content:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah on Monday jointly flagged off the Saryu-Kamala Express, a new weekly train service connecting Ayodhya Cantt in Uttar Pradesh with Janakpur Dham in Nepal.
The new passenger service marks another step towards strengthening cross-border rail connectivity between India and Nepal while facilitating travel between two important religious destinations that share longstanding cultural and historical ties.
Also Read: Sensex plunges 1,484 points, Nifty falls 1.75% by closing amid high profit booking
Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, speaking at the inauguration, described the relationship between India and Nepal as a centuries-old bond rooted in faith, shared rivers and family ties. He also highlighted the traditional 'roti-beti' connection between the two countries.
The train will connect important destinations across Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, with key stoppages at Gorakhpur, Basti, Raxaul, Sitamarhi, Madhubani and Jaynagar.
These stops are expected to improve rail access for passengers across several districts, facilitating travel for religious visits, family connections and other purposes. The service is expected to give a boost to religious tourism by improving access to Ayodhya and Janakpur Dham.
Increased visitor movement could also create opportunities for hotels, restaurants, local transport operators and small businesses in the region.
Besides pilgrims and tourists, the train is expected to benefit families, students and business travellers by providing greater convenience for maintaining personal and professional relationships across the border.
The importance of the service extends beyond passenger convenience, as improved transport links can encourage commercial interaction, support regional economic activity and strengthen cultural exchange between neighbouring communities.
The initiative is part of broader efforts to improve railway connectivity between India and Nepal. Cross-border rail projects, including the Jaynagar-Bijalpura-Bardibas and Jogbani-Biratnagar links, are progressing in stages.
The proposed Raxaul-Kathmandu railway line is also part of the broader vision to strengthen connectivity between the two countries.
Alongside infrastructure development, capacity-building efforts have also been undertaken, with Nepal Railway officers and staff receiving training in various aspects of train operations at Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya in Vadodara.
Also Read: Over 25 lakh patients treated under Ayushman Scheme in Odisha, Rs 6,877 Cr spent: Health Minister
Together, these initiatives are aimed at creating further opportunities for passenger movement, facilitating trade and strengthening transport links between important regions of India and Nepal. Shah is on a two-day state visit to India from November 22 to 23.
It is his first visit to India since assuming office in March 2026. During the visit, he is scheduled to hold bilateral talks with Prime Minister Modi at Hyderabad House and call on President Droupadi Murmu. (ANI)

title: Vande Bharat travels over 450 kms with faulty brakes, major accident averted
description: An empty Vande Bharat Express train traveled 463 km with ineffective brakes, prompting South Eastern Railway to investigate the October incident.
author: Rashmi Ranjan Mohanty
content:
A serious safety lapse came to light after an empty Vande Bharat train travelled nearly 463 km with the braking systems of all its coaches allegedly rendered ineffective. The incident, which occurred in October, has prompted the South Eastern Railway (SER) to order an investigation into the circumstances that allowed the rake to continue despite warnings from loco pilots.
According to several national media and PTI reports, the incident took place on October 24, when an empty Vande Bharat chair car rake was being moved from Hatia in Jharkhand to Jhansi in Uttar Pradesh with the help of a freight locomotive. Railway personnel allegedly failed to connect the coaches' braking system properly with the locomotive before the journey began.
The first warning came from the loco pilot, who noticed extremely poor braking performance during a brake power test after leaving Hatia. He reportedly submitted a written complaint to railway officials upon reaching Ranchi. However, the rake was permitted to continue its journey.
A second alert was reportedly raised by another loco pilot operating the train from Muri station. He informed the concerned controllers that the brakes were not responding even when pressure in the brake pipe was reduced.
The problem was detected only after the rake reached Deen Dayal Upadhyaya (DDU) station in Uttar Pradesh's Chandauli district. An inspection revealed that the braking systems of all the coaches had been isolated, leaving them without effective brakes.
In an order issued on November 7, the SER directed the Divisional Railway Manager (DRM), Ranchi, to conduct a probe and fix responsibility for the lapses.
The preliminary findings reportedly pointed to negligence by maintenance personnel, section and traction controllers, and members of the train crew. The report also flagged the failure to physically check the braking systems before departure and the crew's lack of familiarity with the Vande Bharat rake's braking mechanism.
The incident occurred weeks before the Kolkata-Sairang Express derailment in Assam on November 11, adding to concerns over railway safety and operational procedures.

title: India rationalises visa regime, reducing main categories from 13 to 9 and sub-categories from 49 to 23
description: India simplifies its visa rules, reducing categories and application form requirements by up to 70% to make travel and visa processing easier for foreign nationals.
author: Poonam Singh
content:
India has simplified its visa regime by reducing the number of main visa categories from 13 to 9, and sub-categories from 49 to 23, with the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) updating its IT systems to implement the changes and visa issuance under the revised framework is expected to begin by the end of this year.The MHA has also undertaken a comprehensive exercise to simplify and rationalise visa application forms across 23 categories and sub-categories of Visas. As per the ministry, the required fields or columns for all 23 categories and sub-categories of Visas have been reduced by 65 per cent to 70 per cent-- an initiative to significantly reduce the information required from foreign nationals and simplify visa forms while retaining essential details necessary for visa processing. The move, MHA said, will reduce time and effort required to complete application by the applicant as well as it will enhance administrative efficiency by facilitating more focused scrutiny and processing of visa application."The Government of India has simplified its visa regime by reducing the number of main visa categories from 13 to 9 and the number of sub-categories from 49 to 23. The move aimed at making it more compact, coherent and responsive to the requirements of foreign nationals visiting India. To implement all changes made in the Indian Visa regime, the MHA is updating the IT systems, and by year-end, visas will be granted as per the new rationalisation," said the MHA.The revised visa framework now comprises nine main categories: Business Visa, Diplomatic Visa, Work Visa, Journalist Visa, Medical Visa, Official Visa, Student Visa, Visitor Visa and Miscellaneous Visa.Business Visa is allowed for long-term business activities, including establishing an industrial and business venture; short- term business activities like participation in sports and cultural or commercial performances, production investment business, attending conferences, shooting of films including documentaries and advertisement films. However, a Diplomatic Visa is granted to diplomats, including UN Diplomats assigned to India or visiting India and their dependents.Work Visa is allowed for long-term employment with Indian companies or organisations, working in NGOs and missionary activities, and Journalist Visa is granted to Journalists accredited in India.Medical Visa is granted to foreigners visiting India to undergo intensive or indoor medical treatment, including treatment under AYUSH systems and their attendants, while Official Visa is provided to non-diplomatic officials, including UN non-diplomatic officials assigned to India or on a visit to India and their dependents.Student Visa is granted to school, graduate and post-graduate education, studies in Yoga, Vedic culture and Indian music and dance, Buddhist studies, studies of Indian languages and Indian knowledge systems, research, internship and exchange students.Visitor Visas are provided for tourism, short-term activities including business meetings, medical consultations and Wellness retreats, transit and mountaineering. However, Miscellaneous Visa is granted to Persons of Indian Origin and their spouses and children, those coming to join various specified institutions like Auroville Foundation, dependents of foreign nationals coming on various long-duration visas, stay visa for Afghanistan nationals, Long Term Visa for certain categories of nationals from neighbouring countries and other miscellaneous purposes not covered by any other visa category.On August 27 this year, the MHA said it "reduced the number of main visa categories from 13 to 9 and the number of sub-categories from 49 to 23." This follows the earlier rationalisation undertaken in October, 2025, when the main visa categories were reduced from 22 to 13 and sub-categories from 63 to 49. While considering the simplification of the Indian Visa regime, the ministry said the government of India studied the Visa system of developed countries and global standards.Officials said the consolidation of similar purposes of travel is aimed at providing greater clarity and ease in identifying the appropriate visa category while facilitating legitimate foreign arrivals.Currently, the MHA said, e-visa is processed by electronic travel authorisation under 13 subcategories. The facility of e-visa is presently available to the nationals of 172 countries.The erstwhile Tourist Visa has been renamed Visitor Visa, reflecting a broader range of permitted purposes beyond conventional tourism. The category has been organised into two sub-categories, V-1 and V-2, so that applicants may select a visa suited to the nature and duration of their proposed visit.In addition to other eligible visitor activities, V-1 Visa covers short-term activities such as business meetings, medical consultations, wellness retreats, short-duration medical treatment and short-term courses in Indian languages, music, art and craft. It is granted for 30 days with multiple entries.V-2 Visa is intended for longer-duration visits, with validity of 1, 5 or 10 years, as specified. It covers the activities permissible under V-1 and mountaineering. For mountaineering, a visa of six months, with multiple entries, will be granted.By bringing a wider range of short visits under a clearly identified category, the new arrangement makes visa selection simpler for travellers who may combine leisure with business meetings, medical consultations, wellness retreats or cultural learning, including short-duration yoga programmes. The longer-duration V-2 option provides continuity and convenience for eligible repeat visitors, while the specific mountaineering provision addresses the distinct needs of such travel.The Medical Visa framework retains separate provisions for treatment under conventional and AYUSH systems. M-1 Visa covers medical treatment other than treatment under AYUSH systems, while M-3 Visa covers treatment under AYUSH systems. M-1 and M-3 Visas, including their e-Visa variants, will be granted for one year as a default option with multiple entries. Corresponding medical attendant visa provisions are also available accordingly; M-2 and M-4 Visas will be granted for attendants of M-1 and M-3 visa holders, respectively.This arrangement gives patients greater predictability when treatment involves multiple consultations, follow-up appointments or staged procedures. Multiple-entry validity can reduce the need for repeated visa applications during a course of care, while the distinct AYUSH provision helps applicants identify the appropriate treatment route. The availability of attendant visas also facilitates support by accompanying persons. This will encourage Medical Value Tourism in India as per the Prime Minister’s Vision of Heal in India.The Student Visa category has been consolidated into two broad sub-categories. S-1 Visa covers school, graduate and post-graduate education. S-2 Visa covers PhD and research scholars in Indian universities, visiting faculty, foreign research students visiting India for research, scientific and anthropological expeditions, internships and exchange students, among other specified academic activities.For foreign students enrolled in Indian educational institutions through the Study in India portal, the e-S1 Visa may be granted for up to five years or for the duration of the academic course, whichever is less, with multiple entries. These provisions offer students a more readily identifiable visa pathway and greater certainty for academic planning. Longer validity linked to the course duration can also minimise procedural interruptions and make it easier for eligible students to travel during their studies.The Business Visa category has been consolidated into B-1 and B-2. B-1 Visa covers long-term, licence-based business activities, including foreign nationals seeking to establish industrial or business ventures in India. B-2 Visa covers short-term, contract-based business activities, including Production Investment Business, conferences, sports, performative arts and films.A specific provision has also been made for foreign subject-matter specialists, engineers and technical personnel engaged by Indian companies in activities such as installation and commissioning, quality checks and essential maintenance, production, IT and ERP ramp-up, training, supply-chain development, plant design and bring-up, senior management and technical support, including transfer of know-how, technology and services.Such personnel may be granted a Production Investment Business Visa under the B-2 category through the e-Visa platform. This was earlier granted under e-B4 visa nomenclature.This differentiation gives businesses greater clarity when planning long-term investments as against short-term contractual assignments. The dedicated provision for technical specialists can facilitate timely deployment of expertise for setting up and operationalising industrial facilities, transferring technology, training personnel and supporting production, thereby improving predictability for companies and foreign professionals alike.Taken together, the changes reduce overlap between visa categories and make the framework easier to navigate for visitors, patients, students, researchers, investors and business professionals. The rationalisation is intended to support legitimate travel, education, healthcare and economic engagement with India through clearer, purpose-based visa options, subject to applicable eligibility criteria and conditions. author: Soloni Dash
content:
ନନ୍ଦିଘୋଷ ବ୍ୟୁରୋ : ବିଶ୍ୱ ରାଜନୀତିରେ ବଦଳୁଛି ଶକ୍ତି ସମୀକରଣ। ଆମେରିକା ରାଷ୍ଟ୍ରପତି ଡୋନାଲଡ୍ ଟ୍ରମ୍ପଙ୍କୁ ମଧ୍ୟବର୍ତ୍ତୀକାଳୀନ ନିର୍ବାଚନରେ ଝଟକା ଲାଗିବା ପରେ ଇରାନର ଆଭିମୁଖ୍ୟକୁ ନେଇ ବଢ଼ିଛି ଚର୍ଚ୍ଚା। ଆମେରିକାର ରାଜନୈତିକ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ଇରାନ ସହ କୂଟନୈତିକ ସମ୍ପର୍କ ଉପରେ କି ପ୍ରଭାବ ପକାଇବ, ତାହା ଏବେ ବିଶ୍ୱର ନଜରରେ।
ଅନ୍ୟପଟେ ହର୍ମୁଜ୍ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀକୁ ନେଇ ଇରାନର ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ଭାରତ ସମେତ ଅନେକ ଦେଶ ପାଇଁ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ବହନ କରୁଛି। ବିଶ୍ୱର ଅନ୍ୟତମ ପ୍ରମୁଖ ତୈଳ ପରିବହନ ମାର୍ଗ ହେଉଛି ହର୍ମୁଜ୍। ଏହି ସମୁଦ୍ରପଥରେ ଅସ୍ଥିରତା ଯୋଗୁଁ ଅଶୋଧିତ ତୈଳ ଓ ଏଲ୍‌ପିଜି ଯୋଗାଣ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ହେବା ସହ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଜାତୀୟ ବଜାରରେ ଦରବୃଦ୍ଧିର ଆଶଙ୍କା ରହିଛି।
ଭାରତ ନିଜର ତୈଳ ଆବଶ୍ୟକତାର ବଡ଼ ଅଂଶ ଆମଦାନୀ କରୁଥିବାରୁ ହର୍ମୁଜ୍ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀରେ ଜାହାଜ ଚଳାଚଳ ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ ହେବା ଦେଶ ପାଇଁ ଆଶ୍ୱସ୍ତିକର ହୋଇପାରେ। ଏହାଦ୍ୱାରା ତୈଳ ଓ ଗ୍ୟାସ ଯୋଗାଣ ଉପରେ ଚାପ କମିବା ସହ ପରିବହନ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ହ୍ରାସ ପାଇବାର ଆଶା ରହିଛି। ତେବେ ଭାରତ ଓ ଇରାନ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଚାବାହାର ବନ୍ଦର ସମେତ ଅନେକ ରଣନୈତିକ ଓ ବାଣିଜ୍ୟିକ ସ୍ୱାର୍ଥ ଜଡ଼ିତ ରହିଛି। ତେବେ ଆମେରିକା ସହ ଭାରତର ଘନିଷ୍ଠ ସମ୍ପର୍କ ଥିବାରୁ ଉଭୟ ଦେଶ ସହ ସନ୍ତୁଳନ ରକ୍ଷା କରିବା ନୂଆଦିଲ୍ଲୀ ପାଇଁ ବଡ଼ କୂଟନୈତିକ ଚ୍ୟାଲେଞ୍ଜ।
ଏବେ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ହେଉଛି, ଇରାନର ଏହି ଆଭିମୁଖ୍ୟ ଭାରତକୁ ଶକ୍ତି ସୁରକ୍ଷା କ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ ଆଶ୍ୱସ୍ତି ଦେବ କି? ହର୍ମୁଜ୍ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀରେ ସ୍ଥାୟୀ ଶାନ୍ତି ଫେରିବ କି? ଏହାର ଉତ୍ତର ନିର୍ଭର କରିବ ଆମେରିକା-ଇରାନ ଆଲୋଚନା ଓ ଆଗାମୀ କୂଟନୈତିକ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ଉପରେ।

title: ଭୂଟାନରେ ପ୍ରକୃତିର ତାଣ୍ଡବ: ଭାରତ ପାଇଁ ବଢିଲା ବିପଦ !

author: Subhalaxmi Das
content:
ନନ୍ଦିଘୋଷ ବ୍ୟୁରୋ:ପାହାଡରୁ ପୁଣିଥରେ ବାଜିଲାଣି ବିପଦର ଘଣ୍ଟି । ନେପାଳ ଭଳି ଭୁଟାନରେ ଏବେ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ଟେକିଛି ବଡ ବିପଦ । ଭାରତ ପାଇଁ ଜାରି ହେଲା ଆଲର୍ଟ ! ନେପାଳର ଜଳପ୍ରଳୟ ମନରୁ ଲିଭୁଣୁ ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ଭୁଟାନର ଉଚ୍ଚ ହିମାଳୟ ଉପତ୍ୟକାରେ ଏକ ବଡ ଗ୍ଲାସିୟର ହ୍ରଦ ଧସିଯାଇଛି । ଯାହାଫଳରେ ତଳମୁ୍ଣ୍ଡରେ ପ୍ରବାହିତ ହେଉଥିବା ନଦୀଗୁଡିକ ଏବେ ଉଗ୍ର ରୂପ ଧାରଣ କରିଛନ୍ତି । ଏହି ବିସ୍ଫୋରଣ ଏବେ ଆମ ଦେଶ ଭାରତ ପାଇଁ ବଡ ବିପଦ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିଛି । ଯେଉଁଥିପାଇଁ ଆସାମ ଏବଂ ପଶ୍ଚିମବଙ୍ଗର ସୀମାନ୍ତ ଜିଲ୍ଲାଗୁଡିକରେ ହାଇ ଆଲର୍ଟ ଜାରି କରାଯାଇଛି । ଗତ ଏକ ମାସ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ନେପାଳରେ ଦେଖାଦେଇଥିବା ଭୟଙ୍କର ବିପର୍ଯ୍ୟୟ ପରେ ଏବେ ଏହି ନୂତନ ସଙ୍କଟ ଭାରତ ଏବଂ ଭୂଟାନ ପାଇଁ ଚିନ୍ତାର କାରଣ ପାଲଟିଛି । ସତେ ଯେପରି ସମଗ୍ର ପୂର୍ବ ହିମାଳୟ ଗୋଟେ ପରେ ଗୋଟେ ନିଜର ରାଗ ଦେଖାଉଛନ୍ତି ।
ଚଳିତ ବର୍ଷ ଅଗଷ୍ଟ ମାସରେ ନେପାଳ-ତିବ୍ଦତ ସୀମାରେ ଡ୍ୟାମ୍ ଭାଙ୍ଗିବା କାରଣରୁ ଗ୍ଲାସିୟର ହ୍ରଦ ଧସିଯାଇଥିଲା । ଫଳରେ ଭଗ୍ନାବଶେଷ ଏବଂ ପାଣିର ଭୟଙ୍କର ବନ୍ୟା ନେପାଳକୁ ପୂରା ଛାରଖାର କରିଦେଇଥିଲା । ରାସ୍ତାଘାଟ, ପୋଲ ଏବଂ ସୀମାବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଅଞ୍ଚଳଗୁଡିକ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଧ୍ବଂସବିଧ୍ବସ୍ତ ହୋଇଯାଇଥିଲା । ଆଉ ଏବେ ଭୁଟାନରେ ସମାନ କାହାଣୀର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ହେଉଛି । ଭୁଟାନର ଉଚ୍ଚ ଇଲାକାରେ ଥିବା ବରଫ ହ୍ରଦଗୁଡିକରେ ଦୀର୍ଘ ସମୟ ଧରି ଅସ୍ଥିରତା ଲାଗି ରହିଛି । ବର୍ଦ୍ଧିତ ତାପମାତ୍ରା ଯୋଗୁଁ ବରଫ ତରଳିବାରେ ଲାଗିଛି ଏବଂ ବନ୍ଧଗୁଡିକ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ହୋଇ ଭାଙ୍ଗିବାରେ ଲାଗିଛି । ଫଳସ୍ବରୂପ ଲକ୍ଷ ଲକ୍ଷ ଲିଟର ଜଳ ହଠାତ୍ ମାଡି ଆସିପାରେ । ଆଉ ଏହି ଜଳ ସିଧାସଳଖ ଆସାମର ବ୍ରହ୍ମପୁତ୍ର ଉପତ୍ୟକା ଏବଂ ପଶ୍ଚିମବଙ୍ଗର ଡୁଅର୍ସ ଅଞ୍ଚଳର ନଦୀଗୁଡିକୁ ପ୍ରବାହିତ ହେବ । ଯାହା ଭାରତ ପାଇଁ ସତର୍କ ଘଣ୍ଟି ବଜାଇଛି ।
ଉଚ୍ଚ ଇଲାକାରେ ବରଫ କାନ୍ଥ ଦ୍ବାରା ଗଠିତ ହ୍ରଦଗୁଡିକ ଏବେ ପ୍ରକୃତିର ଟାଇମ୍ ବମ୍ ପାଲଟିଛି । ତାପମାତ୍ରା ଯୋଗୁଁ ବରଫ ଦ୍ରୁତ ବେଗରେ ତରଳୁଛି ଏବଂ ହ୍ରଦର ଜଳସ୍ତର ବଢିଯାଉଛି । ଆଉ ଅଚାନକ ବନ୍ଧ ଭାଙ୍ଗିବା ଦ୍ବାରା ଭଗ୍ନାବଶେଷ ସହ ପାଣି ନିମ୍ନଗାମୀ ହେଉଛି । ଭୁଟାନରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଏହା ହି ହୋଇଛି, ଯେତେବେଳେ ପଥର ଏବଂ କାଦୁଅ ମିଶା ବନ୍ୟା ପାଣି ସୀମାନ୍ତ ନଦୀ ଦେଇ ଭାରତର ସମତଳ ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ଆଡକୁ ଅଗ୍ରସର ହେଉଛି । ପ୍ରଭାବରେ ଆସାମର କୋକ୍ରାଝାର, ବକ୍ସା, ଚିରାଙ୍ଗ ଏବଂ ଧୁବ୍ରି ଜିଲ୍ଲାରେ ନଦୀର ଜଳସ୍ତର ଦ୍ରୁତ ଗତିରେ ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଉଛି । ସେହିପରି ଭୁଟାନ ସୀମାକୁ ଲାଗି ରହିଥିବା ପଶ୍ଚିମବଙ୍ଗର ଜଳପାଇଗୁଡି ଏବଂ ଆଲିପୁରଦ୍ବାରରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ସମାନ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ରହିଛି । ଏହି ବିପର୍ଯ୍ୟୟ ଦ୍ବାରା ହଜାର ହଜାର ପରିବାର ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ହୋଇପାରନ୍ତି ଏବଂ କୃଷି ନିର୍ଭରଶୀଳ ଅଞ୍ଚଳର ଜୀବିକା ବିପଦରେ ପଡିପାରେ । ଏହାକୁ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିରେ ରଖି ଆସାମ ଏବଂ ପଶ୍ଚିମବଙ୍ଗ ଉଭୟ ନଦୀ କୂଳରେ ନିଜ ନିଜର ବିପର୍ଯ୍ୟୟ ଟିମ୍ କୁ ମୁତୟନ କରିଛନ୍ତି । ୨୪ ଘଣ୍ଟିଆ କଣ୍ଟ୍ରୋଲ ରୁମ ଆକ୍ଟିଭ ରହିଛି ଏବଂ ଜଳସ୍ତର ଉପରେ ଲଗାତତାର ଭାବେ ନଜର ରଖାଯାଇଛି ।
ପ୍ରକୃତିର ଏହି ପ୍ରକୋପ ଜଳବାୟୁ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନର ଏକ ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଚେତାବନୀ । ଯଦି ସମୟ ଥାଉ ଥାଉ କୌଣସି ବଡ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ନିଆନଯାଏ । ତେବେ ହିମାଳୟର ଏହି ବରଫ ହ୍ରଦଗୁଡିକ ବାରମ୍ଭାର ବିପଦ ହୋଇ ଠିଆ ହେବ ।

title: ଆଜି ଭାରତ-ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ଟକ୍କର !
description: ନନ୍ଦିଘୋଷ ବ୍ୟୁରୋ: ଭାରତ ଏବଂ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଚାଲିଥିବା ୫ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ ଟି-୨୦ ସିରିଜର ଆଜି ହେଉଛି ଦ୍ଵିତୀୟ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ । ଖ୍ରୀଷ୍ଟଚର୍ଚ୍ଚର ହେଗ୍‌ଲି ଓଭାଲ୍ ଠାରେ ଖେଳାଯିବ ଏହି ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ । ଭାରତୀୟ ସମୟ ଅନୁସାରେ ମଧ୍ୟାହ୍ନ ୧୨ଟାରେ ଟସ୍ ପଡିବ ଏବଂ ୧୨ ଟା ୩୦ ମିନିଟ୍‌ରେ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହେବ। ପ୍ରଥମ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍‌ରେ ସଞ୍ଜୁ ସାମସନଙ୍କ ବିସ୍ଫୋରକ ୬୭ ରନ୍ ବଳରେ ଭାରତ ବିଜୟ ହାସଲ କରି ସିରିଜ୍‌ରେ ୧-୦ ରେ […]
category: ଖେଳ, ଜାତୀୟ, ତାଜା ଖବର, ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଖବର, ହାଇଲାଇଟ୍ ସମ୍ବାଦ
author: Subhalaxmi Das
content:
ନନ୍ଦିଘୋଷ ବ୍ୟୁରୋ: ଭାରତ ଏବଂ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଚାଲିଥିବା ୫ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ ଟି-୨୦ ସିରିଜର ଆଜି ହେଉଛି ଦ୍ଵିତୀୟ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ । ଖ୍ରୀଷ୍ଟଚର୍ଚ୍ଚର ହେଗ୍‌ଲି ଓଭାଲ୍ ଠାରେ ଖେଳାଯିବ ଏହି ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ । ଭାରତୀୟ ସମୟ ଅନୁସାରେ ମଧ୍ୟାହ୍ନ ୧୨ଟାରେ ଟସ୍ ପଡିବ ଏବଂ ୧୨ ଟା ୩୦ ମିନିଟ୍‌ରେ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହେବ। ପ୍ରଥମ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍‌ରେ ସଞ୍ଜୁ ସାମସନଙ୍କ ବିସ୍ଫୋରକ ୬୭ ରନ୍ ବଳରେ ଭାରତ ବିଜୟ ହାସଲ କରି ସିରିଜ୍‌ରେ ୧-୦ ରେ ଆଗୁଆ ରହିଛି।ଶ୍ରେୟାସ ଆୟରଙ୍କ ନେତୃତ୍ଵରେ ଯୁବ ଭାରତୀୟ ଦଳ ଏହି ଗ୍ରାଉଣ୍ଡରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍‌ରେ ୨୨୬ ରନ୍‌ର ଏକ ବିଶାଳ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟକୁ ପିଛା କରି ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ବିପକ୍ଷରେ ସବୁଠାରୁ ବଡ଼ ସଫଳ ରନ୍ ଚେଜ୍‌ର ରେକର୍ଡ କରିଥିଲା। ତେବେ ଆଜି ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଟିମ୍ ଇଣ୍ଡିଆ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ବଡ଼ ଖବର ସାମ୍ନାକୁ ଆସିଛି। ଆହତ ସମସ୍ୟା କାରଣରୁ ଷ୍ଟାର୍ ୱିକେଟକିପର ବ୍ୟାଟର ଈଶାନ କିଷାନ ଦ୍ଵିତୀୟ ଟି-୨୦ରୁ ବାଦ୍ ପଡ଼ିଛନ୍ତି। ତେଣୁ ତାଙ୍କ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ୧୫ ବର୍ଷୀୟ ଯୁବ ସେନସେସନ ବୈଭବ ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟବଂଶୀ ଙ୍କୁ ପ୍ଲେଇଙ୍ଗ୍-୧୧ରେ ସୁଯୋଗ ମିଳିପାରେ ବୋଲି ଚର୍ଚ୍ଚା ହେଉଛି। ଭାରତୀୟ ଦଳ ୨-୦ ରେ ସିରିଜରେ ଆଗକୁ ବଢିବାକୁ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ରଖି ମୈଦାନକୁ ଓହ୍ଲାଇବ । ଅପରପକ୍ଷରେ, ଘରୋଇ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ଦଳ ମିଚେଲ ସାଣ୍ଟନରଙ୍କ ଅଧିନାୟକତ୍ୱରେ ଆଜିର ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଜିତି ସିରିଜ୍‌କୁ ବରାବର କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଜୋରଦାର ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି କରିଛି। ହେଗ୍‌ଲି ଓଭାଲ୍‌ର ପିଚ୍ ବ୍ୟାଟିଂ ଅନୁକୂଳ ହୋଇଥିବାରୁ ପୁଣି ଏକ ହାଇ-ସ୍କୋରିଂ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ମିଳିବ ବୋଲି ଆଶା କରାଯାଉଛି।
କହିରଖୁଛୁ ଯେ, ଭାରତ ଏବଂ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲାଣ୍ଡ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଏପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ୩୨ ଟି ଆନ୍ତର୍ଜାତୀୟ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଖେଳାଯାଇଛି । ଯେଉଁଥିରୁ ୧୮ ଟି ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ରେ ଭାରତ ବିଜୟ ହାସଲ କରିଥିବା ବେଳେ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲାଣ୍ଡ ୧୧ଟି ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଜିତିପାରିଛି । ସେହିଭଳି ୩ଟି ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଟାଏ ମଧ୍ୟ ହୋଇଥିଲା । ତଥାପି ତିନୋଟି ଟାଏ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଦୁଇଟି ସୁପରଓଭରରେ ପରିଣତ ହୋଇଥିଲା , ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ଭାରତ ବିଜୟୀ ହୋଇଥିଲା ।

content:
Ration Card Update : ਹੁਣ ਰਾਸ਼ਨ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲੇਗਾ ਸਰ੍ਹੋਂ ਦਾ ਤੇਲ, ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਪਰਿਵਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲੇਗਾ ਫਾਇਦਾ
Ration Card Update : ਮਹਿੰਗਾਈ ਦੇ ਦੌਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਸੋਈ ਦਾ ਖਰਚਾ ਘਟਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਰਾਸ਼ਨ ਕਾਰਡ ਧਾਰਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਰਾਹਤ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ। ਹਰਿਆਣਾ ਦੇ ਖੁਰਾਕ ਅਤੇ ਸਪਲਾਈ ਵਿਭਾਗ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਰਾਸ਼ਨ ਡਿਪੂਆਂ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਯੋਗ ਪਰਿਵਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ
Ration Card Update : ਮਹਿੰਗਾਈ ਦੇ ਦੌਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਸੋਈ ਦਾ ਖਰਚਾ ਘਟਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਰਾਸ਼ਨ ਕਾਰਡ ਧਾਰਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਰਾਹਤ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ। ਹਰਿਆਣਾ ਦੇ ਖੁਰਾਕ ਅਤੇ ਸਪਲਾਈ ਵਿਭਾਗ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਰਾਸ਼ਨ ਡਿਪੂਆਂ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਯੋਗ ਪਰਿਵਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਸਤੇ ਭਾਅ 'ਤੇ ਸਰ੍ਹੋਂ ਦਾ ਤੇਲ ਦੇਣਾ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਦਾ ਲਾਭ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਰੇਖਾ ਤੋਂ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲੇ (BPL) ਅਤੇ ਅੰਤੋਦਿਆ ਅੰਨ ਯੋਜਨਾ (AAY) ਦੇ ਯੋਗ ਪਰਿਵਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲੇਗਾ। ਖਾਸ ਗੱਲ ਇਹ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਇਹ ਤੇਲ ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲੇਗਾ, ਸਗੋਂ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਦੇ ਮੈਂਬਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਦੇ ਹਿਸਾਬ ਨਾਲ 15 ਤੋਂ 45 ਰੁਪਏ ਦੇਣੇ ਪੈਣਗੇ। ਵਿਭਾਗ ਨੇ ਅਕਤੂਬਰ 2026 ਦੇ ਤੇਲ ਕੋਟੇ ਨੂੰ ਲੈਣ ਦੀ ਆਖਰੀ ਤਰੀਕ 30 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਰੱਖੀ ਹੈ।
ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਦੇ ਮੈਂਬਰਾਂ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਮਿਲੇਗਾ ਤੇਲ
ਵਿਭਾਗ ਦੇ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਰਾਸ਼ਨ ਕਾਰਡ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਰਜ ਮੈਂਬਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਦੇ ਹਿਸਾਬ ਨਾਲ ਤੇਲ ਦੀ ਮਾਤਰਾ ਅਤੇ ਕੀਮਤ ਤੈਅ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ।
- 1 ਤੋਂ 2 ਮੈਂਬਰਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਨੂੰ 500 ਮਿਲੀਲੀਟਰ ਤੇਲ 15 ਰੁਪਏ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਿਲੇਗਾ।
- 3 ਤੋਂ 6 ਮੈਂਬਰਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਨੂੰ 1 ਲੀਟਰ ਤੇਲ 30 ਰੁਪਏ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਿਲੇਗਾ।
- 6 ਜਾਂ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਮੈਂਬਰਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਨੂੰ 1.5 ਲੀਟਰ ਤੇਲ 45 ਰੁਪਏ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਿਲੇਗਾ।
ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਸਟਾਕ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਵੰਡਿਆ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ
ਵਿਭਾਗ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਰਾਸ਼ਨ ਡਿਪੂ ਮਾਲਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਹਦਾਇਤ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਕੋਲ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਪਿਆ ਸਰ੍ਹੋਂ ਦੇ ਤੇਲ ਦਾ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਸਟਾਕ ਪਹਿਲ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰ 'ਤੇ ਵੰਡਿਆ ਜਾਵੇ। ਇਸ ਲਈ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਆਓ, ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਪਾਓ ਦਾ ਨਿਯਮ ਲਾਗੂ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
ਇੰਝ ਹੋਵੇਗੀ ਜਾਂਚ
ਤੇਲ ਅਤੇ ਰਾਸ਼ਨ ਲੈਣ ਲਈ ਲਾਭਪਾਤਰੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਰਾਸ਼ਨ ਡਿਪੂ 'ਤੇ e-POS ਮਸ਼ੀਨ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਬਾਇਓਮੈਟ੍ਰਿਕ ਤਸਦੀਕ ਕਰਵਾਉਣੀ ਪਵੇਗੀ। ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਹੀ ਤੈਅ ਮਾਤਰਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਾਸ਼ਨ ਅਤੇ ਸਰ੍ਹੋਂ ਦਾ ਤੇਲ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ। ਜਿਹੜੇ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਇਸ ਸਹੂਲਤ ਦਾ ਲਾਭ ਲੈਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹ 30 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਰਾਸ਼ਨ ਡਿਪੂ 'ਤੇ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਮਹੀਨੇ ਦਾ ਤੇਲ ਕੋਟਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ।
ਨੋਟ: ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਬ੍ਰੇਕਿੰਗ ਖ਼ਬਰਾਂ ਪੜ੍ਹਨ ਲਈ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸਾਡੇ ਐਪ ਨੂੰ ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ। ਜੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਵੀਡੀਓ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋ ਤਾਂ ABP ਸਾਂਝਾ ਦੇ YouTube ਚੈਨਲ ਨੂੰ Subscribe ਕਰ ਲਵੋ। ABP ਸਾਂਝਾ ਸਾਰੇ ਸੋਸ਼ਲ ਮੀਡੀਆ ਪਲੇਟਫਾਰਮਾਂ ਤੇ ਉਪਲੱਬਧ ਹੈ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸਾਨੂੰ ਫੇਸਬੁੱਕ, ਟਵਿੱਟਰ, ਕੂ, ਸ਼ੇਅਰਚੈੱਟ ਅਤੇ ਡੇਲੀਹੰਟ 'ਤੇ ਵੀ ਫੋਲੋ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ।

title: Labour Code : ਕਰਮਚਾਰੀਆਂ ਤੇ ਮਜ਼ਦੂਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਬੁਰੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ! ਇੱਕ ਸਾਲ ਬਾਅਦ ਵੀ ਕਈ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਲਾਗੂ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤੇ 4 ਨਵੇਂ ਲੇਬਰ ਕੋਡ
description: Labour Code : ਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਕਰਮਚਾਰੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਮਜ਼ਦੂਰਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੀ ਵੱਡੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਆਈ ਹੈ। ਕੇਂਦਰ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਵੱਲੋਂ 29 ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਕਿਰਤ ਕਾਨੂੰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਲਿਆਂਦੇ ਗਏ 4 ਨਵੇਂ ਲੇਬਰ ਕੋਡ (Labour Codes) ਨੂੰ ਲਾਗੂ ਹੋਏ ਇੱਕ ਸਾਲ ਬੀਤਣ ਦੇ ਬਾ

Labour Code : ਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਕਰਮਚਾਰੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਮਜ਼ਦੂਰਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੀ ਵੱਡੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਆਈ ਹੈ। ਕੇਂਦਰ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਵੱਲੋਂ 29 ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਕਿਰਤ ਕਾਨੂੰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਲਿਆਂਦੇ ਗਏ 4 ਨਵੇਂ ਲੇਬਰ ਕੋਡ (Labour Codes) ਨੂੰ ਲਾਗੂ ਹੋਏ ਇੱਕ ਸਾਲ ਬੀਤਣ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ ਕਈ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਅਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਲਾਗੂ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤਾ। ਗ੍ਰਾਂਟ ਥੌਰਨਟਨ ਭਾਰਤ ਦੀ ਇੱਕ ਸਰਵੇ ਰਿਪੋਰਟ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਸਿਰਫ਼ 50.6 ਫ਼ੀਸਦੀ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਹੀ ਨਵੇਂ ਕਾਨੂੰਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਲਾਗੂ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਤਿਆਰ ਹਨ। ਇਸ ਸਰਵੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਖੇਤਰਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ 200 ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਲਿਆ। ਰਿਪੋਰਟ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ 28.8 ਫ਼ੀਸਦੀ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਅਜੇ ਤਿਆਰੀ ਕਰ ਰਹੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਜਦਕਿ 11.7 ਫ਼ੀਸਦੀ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਇਸ ਦਿਸ਼ਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੰਮ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤਾ। ਹੈਰਾਨੀ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਇਹ ਹੈ ਕਿ 9 ਫ਼ੀਸਦੀ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਨਵੇਂ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਤੱਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।
ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਵੇਂ ਕਾਨੂੰਨਾਂ ਕਾਰਨ ਵਧਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਰਚਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਹੈ। ਸਰਵੇ ਵਿੱਚ 74.4 ਫ਼ੀਸਦੀ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਕਿ ਨਵੇਂ ਤਨਖਾਹ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਕਾਰਨ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਖਰਚ ਵਧ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ 49.6 ਫ਼ੀਸਦੀ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਮੰਨਣਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਖਰਚ ਵਿੱਚ 5 ਫ਼ੀਸਦੀ ਤੱਕ ਵਾਧਾ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਦਕਿ 12 ਫ਼ੀਸਦੀ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ 5 ਫ਼ੀਸਦੀ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਾਧੇ ਦਾ ਖਦਸ਼ਾ ਹੈ। ਖਾਸ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਗ੍ਰੈਚੁਟੀ (Gratuity) ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੋਵੀਡੈਂਟ ਫੰਡ (PF) ਵਿੱਚ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਯੋਗਦਾਨ ਵਧਣ ਨਾਲ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਵਿੱਤੀ ਬੋਝ ਪੈ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।
ਨਵੇਂ ਲੇਬਰ ਕੋਡਾਂ ਤਹਿਤ ਤਨਖਾਹ ਦੇ ਢਾਂਚੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਬਦਲਾਅ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅਸਰ ਮੁਲਾਜ਼ਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਬੇਸਿਕ ਸੈਲਰੀ, ਭੱਤਿਆਂ, ਪੀਐੱਫ ਅਤੇ ਗ੍ਰੈਚੁਟੀ ਦੀ ਗਣਨਾ 'ਤੇ ਪੈ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਸਰਵੇ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ 66.2 ਫ਼ੀਸਦੀ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਕਰਮਚਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਤਨਖਾਹ ਢਾਂਚੇ ਦੀ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਕਰ ਲਈ ਹੈ, ਜਦਕਿ 10.5 ਫ਼ੀਸਦੀ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਅਜੇ ਇਸ ਦੀ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਬਣਾ ਰਹੀਆਂ ਹਨ।
ਦੱਸ ਦੇਈਏ ਕਿ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਨੇ 29 ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਕੇਂਦਰੀ ਕਿਰਤ ਕਾਨੂੰਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਰ ਨਵੇਂ ਲੇਬਰ ਕੋਡ ਬਣਾਏ ਹਨ। ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੇਜ ਕੋਡ (Code on Wages), ਸਮਾਜਿਕ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਕੋਡ (Code on Social Security), ਉਦਯੋਗਿਕ ਸਬੰਧ ਕੋਡ (Industrial Relations Code) ਅਤੇ ਕਿੱਤਾਮੁਖੀ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਕੋਡ (Occupational Safety Code) ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹਨ। ਰਿਪੋਰਟ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਲਾਗੂ ਕਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਅਜੇ ਵੀ ਕਈ ਚੁਣੌਤੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਸਾਹਮਣਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਪੈ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ।

content:
Jhajjar News : ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥਣ ਦੀ ਸ਼ੱਕੀ ਹਾਲਾਤਾਂ 'ਚ ਮੌਤ, ਪੁਲਿਸ ਨੇ ਰੁਕਵਾਇਆ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਸਸਕਾਰ ,ਜਾਣੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਾਮਲਾ
Jhajjar News : ਹਰਿਆਣਾ ਦੇ ਝੱਜਰ 'ਚ ਇੱਕ 18 ਸਾਲਾ ਬੀਐੱਸਸੀ ਦੀ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥਣ ਦੀ ਘਰ ਦੇ ਵਿਹੜੇ 'ਚ ਬਣੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇ ਟੈਂਕ 'ਚ ਡੁੱਬਣ ਕਾਰਨ ਮੌਤ ਹੋ ਗਈ। ਟੈਂਕ ਕਰੀਬ 10 ਫੁੱਟ ਡੂੰਘਾ ਸੀ। ਜਦੋਂ ਤੱਕ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਇਸ ਘਟਨਾ ਦਾ ਪਤਾ ਲੱਗਿਆ
Jhajjar News : ਹਰਿਆਣਾ ਦੇ ਝੱਜਰ 'ਚ ਇੱਕ 18 ਸਾਲਾ ਬੀਐੱਸਸੀ ਦੀ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥਣ ਦੀ ਘਰ ਦੇ ਵਿਹੜੇ 'ਚ ਬਣੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇ ਟੈਂਕ 'ਚ ਡੁੱਬਣ ਕਾਰਨ ਮੌਤ ਹੋ ਗਈ। ਟੈਂਕ ਕਰੀਬ 10 ਫੁੱਟ ਡੂੰਘਾ ਸੀ। ਜਦੋਂ ਤੱਕ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਇਸ ਘਟਨਾ ਦਾ ਪਤਾ ਲੱਗਿਆ, ਉਦੋਂ ਤੱਕ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥਣ ਦੀ ਮੌਤ ਹੋ ਚੁੱਕੀ ਸੀ।
ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਜਲਦਬਾਜ਼ੀ 'ਚ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਸਸਕਾਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਤਿਆਰੀਆਂ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ ਜਾ ਰਹੀਆਂ ਸਨ। ਇਸੇ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਗੁਆਂਢੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਮਾਮਲੇ ਨੂੰ ਸ਼ੱਕੀ ਦੱਸਦਿਆਂ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਸੂਚਨਾ ਦੇ ਦਿੱਤੀ।ਸੂਚਨਾ ਮਿਲਣ 'ਤੇ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਮੌਕੇ 'ਤੇ ਪਹੁੰਚੀ ਅਤੇ ਲਾਸ਼ ਨੂੰ ਕਬਜ਼ੇ 'ਚ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਸਿਵਲ ਹਸਪਤਾਲ ਪਹੁੰਚਾਇਆ। ਉੱਥੇ ਲਾਸ਼ ਦਾ ਪੋਸਟਮਾਰਟਮ ਕਰਵਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ।
ਭਦਾਨੀ ਪਿੰਡ ਦੀ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਸੀ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥਣ
ਪੁਲਿਸ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਤਕਾ ਦੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਝੱਜਰ ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹੇ ਦੇ ਭਦਾਨੀ ਪਿੰਡ ਦੀ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਹੀਤੂ (18) ਪੁੱਤਰੀ ਪਵਨ ਵਜੋਂ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ। ਉਹ ਬੀਐੱਸਸੀ ਦੀ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥਣ ਸੀ ਅਤੇ ਆਨਲਾਈਨ ਕੋਚਿੰਗ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਕਰ ਰਹੀ ਸੀ। ਉਸ ਦੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਝੱਜਰ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਸਕੂਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਡਰਾਈਵਰ ਵਜੋਂ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ।
ਪੁਲਿਸ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਮਾਮਲੇ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ। ਪੋਸਟਮਾਰਟਮ ਰਿਪੋਰਟ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਮੌਤ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਨਾਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਹੋਰ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਆ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ।
ਨੋਟ: ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਬ੍ਰੇਕਿੰਗ ਖ਼ਬਰਾਂ ਪੜ੍ਹਨ ਲਈ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸਾਡੇ ਐਪ ਨੂੰ ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ। ਜੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਵੀਡੀਓ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋ ਤਾਂ ABP ਸਾਂਝਾ ਦੇ YouTube ਚੈਨਲ ਨੂੰ Subscribe ਕਰ ਲਵੋ। ABP ਸਾਂਝਾ ਸਾਰੇ ਸੋਸ਼ਲ ਮੀਡੀਆ ਪਲੇਟਫਾਰਮਾਂ ਤੇ ਉਪਲੱਬਧ ਹੈ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸਾਨੂੰ ਫੇਸਬੁੱਕ, ਟਵਿੱਟਰ, ਕੂ, ਸ਼ੇਅਰਚੈੱਟ ਅਤੇ ਡੇਲੀਹੰਟ 'ਤੇ ਵੀ ਫੋਲੋ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ।

title: पॉश इलाके सेक्टर-8 में लाखों की लूट, घरेलू सहायिका ने मालकिन को नशीला पदार्थ खिलाकर दिया वारदात को अंजाम; CCTV फुटेज आया सामने
description: चंडीगढ़: शहर के सबसे पॉश इलाकों में शुमार सेक्टर-8 स्थित एक कोठी में लाखों रुपये की लूटपाट की सनसनीखेज वारदात सामने आई है। घर में…
author: Sonam Malhotra
content:
चंडीगढ़: शहर के सबसे पॉश इलाकों में शुमार सेक्टर-8 स्थित एक कोठी में लाखों रुपये की लूटपाट की सनसनीखेज वारदात सामने आई है। घर में अकेली मौजूद मालकिन किरण मित्तल को जहरीला पदार्थ देकर बेहोश किया गया और इसके बाद आरोपी घर से लाखों रुपये का कीमती सामान व मोबाइल फोन समेटकर फरार हो गए।
घरेलू सहायिका ने तीन साथियों संग रची लूट की साजिश
इस पूरी वारदात को अंजाम देने का गंभीर आरोप नेपाल मूल की करीब 23 वर्षीय युवती गोमा छेत्री पर लगा है, जिसे घर में घरेलू सहायिका के तौर पर काम पर रखा गया था। आरोप है कि गोमा छेत्री ने मौके का फायदा उठाते हुए अपने तीन अन्य पुरुष साथियों को घर पर बुलाया और उनके साथ मिलकर इस बड़ी लूटपाट की घटना को अंजाम दिया।
CCTV वीडियो में कैद हुई वारदात
अब इस लूटकांड से जुड़ा एक अहम CCTV वीडियो भी सामने आया है, जिसमें आरोपियों की संदिग्ध गतिविधियां साफ तौर पर दिखाई दे रही हैं। वीडियो सामने आने के बाद चंडीगढ़ पुलिस हरकत में आ गई है और फुटेज को कब्जे में लेकर मामले की गहनता से जांच कर रही है। पुलिस टीम आरोपियों की भूमिका, पूरी वारदात की प्लानिंग और घर से लूटे गए कुल सामान का ब्योरा जुटाने के साथ-साथ फरार आरोपियों की तलाश में छापेमारी कर रही है।

title: Major accident in Bijnor: ਗੰਗਾ ਘਾਟ ‘ਤੇ ਇਸ਼ਨਾਨ ਕਰਨ ਗਏ ਇੱਕੋ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਦੇ 4 ਜੀਅ ਡੁੱਬੇ, 12 ਸਾਲਾ ਬੱਚੀ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਬਚਾਇਆ ਗਿਆ

author: Sonam Malhotra
content:
ਬਿਜਨੌਰ : ਉੱਤਰ ਪ੍ਰਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਬਿਜਨੌਰ ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹੇ ਦੇ ਨਾਂਗਲ ਸੋਤੀ ਗੰਗਾ ਘਾਟ ‘ਤੇ ਇਸ਼ਨਾਨ ਕਰਨ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਇੱਕ ਦਰਦਨਾਕ ਹਾਦਸਾ ਵਾਪਰ ਗਿਆ। ਨਜੀਬਾਬਾਦ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਦੇ ਚਾਰ ਮੈਂਬਰ ਗੰਗਾ ਦੇ ਤੇਜ਼ ਵਹਾਅ ਵਿੱਚ ਡੁੱਬ ਗਏ। ਮੌਕੇ ‘ਤੇ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਮੁਸਤੈਦੀ ਸਦਕਾ 12 ਸਾਲਾ ਬੱਚੀ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਬਾਹਰ ਕੱਢ ਲਿਆ ਗਿਆ, ਜਦਕਿ ਇੱਕ ਔਰਤ ਸਮੇਤ ਤਿੰਨ ਜਣਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਅਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਕੋਈ ਸੁਰਾਗ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਗ ਸਕਿਆ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਘਟਨਾ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਘਾਟ ‘ਤੇ ਹਫੜਾ-ਦਫੜੀ ਮਚ ਗਈ।
ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ, ਨਜੀਬਾਬਾਦ ਦੇ ਮੁਹੱਲਾ ਰਮਪੁਰਾ ਦਾ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਇਹ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਦੁਪਹਿਰ ਕਰੀਬ 12 ਵਜੇ ਨਾਂਗਲ ਸੋਤੀ ਗੰਗਾ ਘਾਟ ‘ਤੇ ਇਸ਼ਨਾਨ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਪਹੁੰਚਿਆ ਸੀ। ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹਾਉਂਦੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਅਚਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੁਲਨ ਵਿਗੜਨ ਕਾਰਨ 22 ਸਾਲਾ ਲੜਕੀ, 17 ਸਾਲਾ ਨੌਜਵਾਨ, 16 ਸਾਲਾ ਨੌਜਵਾਨ ਅਤੇ 12 ਸਾਲਾ ਲੜਕੀ ਡੂੰਘੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਚਲੇ ਗਏ। ਡੁੱਬਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਮੈਂਬਰ ਆਪਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਿਸ਼ਤੇਦਾਰ ਦੱਸੇ ਜਾ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ। ਰੌਲਾ ਪੈਣ ‘ਤੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੇ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਹਰਕਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਉਂਦਿਆਂ 12 ਸਾਲਾ ਬੱਚੀ ਨੂੰ ਤਾਂ ਬਚਾ ਲਿਆ, ਪਰ ਬਾਕੀ ਤਿੰਨੋਂ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੁੜ੍ਹ ਗਏ।
ਹਾਦਸੇ ਦੀ ਸੂਚਨਾ ਮਿਲਦਿਆਂ ਹੀ ਏ.ਐੱਸ.ਪੀ. ਸਿਟੀ ਡਾ. ਕੇ.ਜੀ. ਸਿੰਘ, ਏ.ਡੀ.ਐੱਮ. ਅਤੇ ਐੱਸ.ਡੀ.ਐੱਮ. ਪੁਲਿਸ ਫੋਰਸ ਸਮੇਤ ਮੌਕੇ ‘ਤੇ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਗਏ। ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਨਿਗਰਾਨੀ ਹੇਠ ਸਥਾਨਕ ਗੋਤਾਖੋਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਮਦਦ ਨਾਲ ਗੰਗਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਾਪਤਾ ਹੋਏ ਤਿੰਨਾਂ ਜੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਭਾਲ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ। ਦੂਜੇ ਪਾਸੇ, ਘਟਨਾ ਦੇ ਕਰੀਬ ਤਿੰਨ ਘੰਟੇ ਬੀਤ ਜਾਣ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ ਐੱਨ.ਡੀ.ਆਰ.ਐੱਫ. (NDRF) ਜਾਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਵਿਸ਼ੇਸ਼ ਬਚਾਅ ਟੀਮ ਨੂੰ ਮੌਕੇ ‘ਤੇ ਨਾ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਜਾਣ ਕਾਰਨ ਪੀੜਤ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਭਾਰੀ ਰੋਸ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ। ਪਰਿਵਾਰਕ ਮੈਂਬਰਾਂ ਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਾਸਨ ਤੋਂ ਮੰਗ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਬਚਾਅ ਕਾਰਜਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੇਜ਼ੀ ਲਿਆਂਦੀ ਜਾਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਲਾਪਤਾ ਮੈਂਬਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਜਲਦ ਲੱਭਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ।

title: Horrific road accident in Kannauj: स्कूल बस को ट्रक ने मारी टक्कर, 4 बच्चों की मौत, 35 बच्चे घायल
description: कन्नौज, 24 नवंबर उत्तर प्रदेश के कन्नौज जिले में आगरा-लखनऊ एक्सपेसवे पर सुबह दर्दनाक सड़क हादसा हो गया।सड़क किनारे खड़ी स्कूल के बच्चों की बस…
author: Diksha Bhatt
content:
कन्नौज, 24 नवंबर
उत्तर प्रदेश के कन्नौज जिले में आगरा-लखनऊ एक्सपेसवे पर सुबह दर्दनाक सड़क हादसा हो गया।सड़क किनारे खड़ी स्कूल के बच्चों की बस को तेज रफ्तार ट्रक ने टक्कर मार दी। हादसे में चार स्कूली बच्चों की मौत हो गई और 35 बच्चे घायल हो गए। हादसे के बाद इलाके में चीख-पुकार मच गई।
मिली जानकारी के अनुसार औरिएंट पब्लिक स्कूल की बच्चे मथुरा और वृंदावन घूमकर लौट रहे थे। बस में 50 बच्चे और 6 टीचर मौजूद थे। मंगलवार सुबह एक्सप्रेसवे पर बस टॉयलेट के लिए रूकी हुई थी। इसी दौरान तेज रफ्तार ट्रक ने जोरदार टक्कर मार दी। टक्कर के बाद बस क्षतिग्रस्त हो गई।
हादसे के बाद पुविस और प्रशासन मौके पर पहुंचा और राहत और बचाव कार्य शुरू किया। सभी घायल बच्चों को नजदीकी अस्पतालों में भर्ती करवाया गया। जहां उनका इलाज जारी है।
उत्तर प्रदेश के मुख्यमंत्री योगी आदित्यनाथ ने इस हादसे पर दुख जताते हुआ गहरा शोक व्यक्त किया है।मृतकों के प्रति संवेदनाएं व्यक्त की है और अधिकारियों को राहत और बचाव कार्य में तेजी लाने के निर्देश दिए हैं।इस दर्दनाक हादसे के बाद पूरे क्षेत्र में शोक का माहौल है।

title: Pregnant at 19, Woman Killed by Parents in Name of Honour in Iran
description: They forced her to swallow around 30 anticonvulsant pills
author: Northeast Live Digital Desk
content:
Pregnant at 19, Woman Killed by Parents in Name of Honour in Iran
First Published: 25th November, 2026 16:08 IST
They forced her to swallow around 30 anticonvulsant pills
How much is a life worth? Can a relationship, a pregnancy or a decision about one’s personal life ever become a reason for taking away that life? And when does the notion of family honour become a matter of life and death?
In a chilling case of suspected honour killing in Iran, a 19-year-old pregnant woman was killed by her parents.
The incident took place in the western Iranian city of Sanandaj.
The deceased woman has been identified as Helia Fattahi. She was two months pregnant.
According to the Hengaw Organisation for Human Rights, after she disclosed that she was pregnant, her parents, Voria Fattahi and Leila Veis, went to court on Nov 21 to file a complaint against Fattahi.
Later, they forced her to swallow around 30 anticonvulsant pills and, upon realising she was still alive, suffocated her to death with a pillow.
Both her parents have been arrested by the police and, during interrogation, they have confessed to the killing, according to a report in Iran International.
Hengaw and another human rights organisation, Hana, described the murder as an alleged “honour” killing.
The horrific allegations have once again raised disturbing questions about violence against women, family control and the deadly consequences of so-called honour-based crimes.

title: Oscars 2027: Marathi film ‘Gondhal,’ Nagaland drama ‘Angh’ among 104 films in International Feature film race
description: According to a report by The Hollywood Reporter, 100 films were submitted by individual countries and territories
author: Northeast Live Digital Desk
content:
Oscars 2027: Marathi film ‘Gondhal,’ Nagaland drama ‘Angh’ among 104 films in International Feature film race
First Published: 25th November, 2026 15:27 IST
According to a report by The Hollywood Reporter, 100 films were submitted by individual countries and territories
Marathi film Gondhal and Nagaland-set drama Angh have entered the race for the 99th Academy Awards, bringing two Indian films into consideration in the International Feature Film category.According to the list released by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences on Tuesday, the two films are among 104 titles eligible for consideration in the category at the 2027 Oscars.Directed by Santosh Davakhar, Gondhal is India’s official submission for the Oscars. Meanwhile, filmmaker Theja Rio’s Angh secured its place in the race after winning the Platform Award at the Toronto International Film Festival.
According to a report by The Hollywood Reporter, 100 films were submitted by individual countries and territories, while four others qualified through awards at major international film festivals.Apart from Angh, the festival award qualifiers include Midday Meal, which won the Busan Award for Best Film at the Busan International Film Festival, Shame and Money, which won the World Cinema Grand Jury Prize for Dramatic Film at the Sundance Film Festival, and Yellow Letters, which won the Golden Bear for Best Film at the Berlin International Film Festival.Other films in the International Feature Film category include Japan’s All of a Sudden, Nepal’s Elephants in the Fog, Poland’s Fatherland, Romania’s Fjord, Spain’s La Bola Negra, France’s Minotaur, South Korea’s Possible Love, the United Kingdom’s Rehearsals for a Revolution and Pakistan’s Hanging by a Wire.With their inclusion in the eligibility list, both Gondhal and Angh can now compete in the preliminary round of voting. The Academy will later announce the shortlist, followed by the final nominations.As per the Academy’s rules, an International Feature Film must be a feature-length film produced outside the United States, with most of its dialogue in a language other than English. Members of the Academy from all branches can take part in the preliminary voting, provided they meet the minimum viewing requirements.Set in rural Maharashtra, Gondhal follows the events of a single night against the backdrop of the traditional midnight Gondhal ritual. The film brings together music, dance, mythology and religious traditions as part of its story.On the other hand, Angh is set in 1960s Nagaland. The film follows an ageing Konyak village chief and his son, who are among the last people trying to preserve their ancestral faith and traditional way of life as changes take place around them.The 99th Academy Awards will take place at the Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood in 2027. (ANI)

title: India’s Most Trusted Bottled Water Brand Bisleri Declared Unsafe? What FSSAI Found, What Company Says and What Consumers Need to Know
description: What exactly did the food safety regulator find, how has the company responded, and what should consumers know?
author: Northeast Live Digital Desk
content:
India’s Most Trusted Bottled Water Brand Bisleri Declared Unsafe? What FSSAI Found, What Company Says and What Consumers Need to Know
First Published: 24th November, 2026 19:30 IST
What exactly did the food safety regulator find, how has the company responded, and what should consumers know?
Bisleri, one of India’s most recognised packaged drinking water brands, has come under scrutiny following findings by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI).
The findings have sparked questions about the safety and quality of its packaged drinking water, prompting consumers to seek clarity.
What exactly did the food safety regulator find, how has the company responded, and what should consumers know?
Bisleri Under FSSAI Scanner: Water Sample Found Unsafe
In a social media statement on Sunday, the food safety regulator said a sample of “Packaged Drinking Water (other than Mineral Water)” collected from Bisleri’s premises was found to be non-compliant with prescribed safety standards.
The FSSAI has categorically and conclusively clarified that bromates were found below the permissible limit on re-testing of the above batch sample.
There were 6 samples collected for testing, containing water from the same source and initially all 6 samples were cleared and passed. In the subsequent re-test 1 out of 6 samples had reported PAHs at 0.144 micrograms per litre in Batch GO 270. Another sample from the same Batch GO 270 cleared all parameters.
The company subsequently appealed against the findings, following which the sample was sent to a referral food laboratory for further analysis. The laboratory also declared it “unsafe” after detecting polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs), the regulator said. Based on the laboratory findings, FSSAI concluded that the company had violated provisions relating to unsafe food under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. It has, therefore, sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International Pvt Ltd under the law, reported the Times of India.
Bisleri’s defence: What is the company saying?
After FSSAI had sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International Pvt. Ltd. after a sample of its packaged drinking water failed safety tests, the company, in a statement said, “”We are aware of recent media reports that the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has issued a notice to Bisleri. The matter dates back approximately 14 months, to a batch produced in September 2025 at Bisleri’s Goa manufacturing facility, one of 143 plants in our network. On 30 September 2025, FSSAI collected six samples from the Goa facility. Initial testing found that five samples met all applicable standards. The sixth recorded a bromate level of 12 micrograms per litre, against the prescribed limit of 10 micrograms per litre. Following Bisleri’s appeal dated 22 November 2025, FSSAI sent that sample to a referral laboratory for retesting. The referral laboratory found bromate of the sample within the prescribed limit and separately flagged polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) in the sample. The difference between the two results raised questions that Bisleri believed warranted clarification. Bisleri arranged for the same sample to be tested independently at an FSSAI-approved laboratory. That test found bromate within the prescribed limit. We submitted the independent test results to FSSAI’s Western Regional Office with a formal letter dated 2 February 2026. We received no further communication from FSSAI after that submission and understood the matter to be closed. To date, Bisleri has received no notice by email or in hard copy and has been unable to locate the reported notice on FSSAI’s website. Drinking water safety is a priority for Bisleri. We maintain stringent quality controls of over 90 tests across our 10-step manufacturing process and will continue to cooperate with FSSAI to address the matter through the appropriate regulatory process. A trusted brand for years, Bisleri remains safe for consumption…”
What Should Consumers Know?
Consumers should check the packaging, manufacturing details, batch number and expiry date before purchasing packaged drinking water.
They should also follow any specific safety advisories issued by the food safety authorities.

title: Priceless heritage of Indian democracy: PM Modi greets citizens on Constitution Day
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday greeted all fellow citizens on the occasion of Constitution Day and said the Constitution is a priceless heritage of Indian democracy, one that will continue to guide in realising the resolve of a developed India.
author: PTI
content:
New Delhi, Nov 26: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday greeted all fellow citizens on the occasion of Constitution Day and said the Constitution is a priceless heritage of Indian democracy, one that will continue to guide in realising the resolve of a developed India.
Modi also said that it is a day to pay homage to the makers of the Constitution and an occasion to reaffirm the commitment to strengthening the values enshrined in it.
"Warmest greetings on Constitution Day to all fellow citizens," he said in a social media post.
The prime minister also paid his salutations and reverence to B R Ambedkar and all the great luminaries of the Constituent Assembly on this occasion.
"The gift they bestowed upon us in the form of the Constitution is a priceless heritage of Indian democracy, one that will continue to guide us in realising the resolve of a 'Viksit Bharat' (Developed India)," he said.
Constitution Day, also known as 'Samvidhan Divas', is celebrated in the country on November 26 every year to commemorate the adoption of the Constitution of India.
On November 26, 1949, the Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution of India, which came into effect from January 26, 1950.
The Modi government in 2015 notified its decision to celebrate November 26 every year as Constitution Day to promote the values of the foundational document among citizens.

title: 100 young filmmakers complete 48-hour challenge at IFFI; ‘One Last Stop’ wins top prize
description: ‘One Last Stop’, directed by Mohak Gandhi of the Red Team, won the Best Film award carrying a cash prize of ₹5 lakh, while ‘A Little Something’, directed by Tamanna Thakur of the Green Team, secured the runner-up position with ₹3 lakh.
author: GK NEWS SERVICE
content:
Panaji, Nov 25: A hundred young creative professionals put their filmmaking skills to the test in a 48-hour challenge at the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa, with the sixth edition of Creative Minds of Tomorrow (CMOT) concluding on Tuesday with the screening of five short films and awards across 15 categories.
‘One Last Stop’, directed by Mohak Gandhi of the Red Team, won the Best Film award carrying a cash prize of ₹5 lakh, while ‘A Little Something’, directed by Tamanna Thakur of the Green Team, secured the runner-up position with ₹3 lakh.
Thakur also won the Best Director award, while Siddhi Parkar was adjudged Best Actor for her performance in ‘Shells’, produced by the Blue Team.
The concluding ceremony was attended by IFFI Festival Director and filmmaker Ashutosh Gowariker, Additional Secretary, Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, Prabhat, Managing Director of the National Film Development Corporation (NFDC) and Vice-Chancellor of the Film and Television Institute of India (FTII), Dhiraj Singh, besides members of the jury.
The Great Grand Jury comprised Aimee Baruah, Premraj, Madhu Apsara, Rumi Jaffrey and Medha Kherdekar Reddy.
Triasha Manna won Best Cinematographer for ‘One Last Stop’, while Nayan Chotaliya and Manav Agarwal received the Best Editor award for ‘A Little Something’. Jithin S was recognised as Best Scriptwriter for ‘Shells’. Aswin Ashok won Best Sound Design for ‘Two Sunsets and Zero Sunrises’, while Sree Parvati S was named Best Playback Singer for ‘Shells’. Akshay Anmol Katore won Best Music Composer for ‘Neel Machli’.
Srushti Wagh and Rupalika Paul received awards for Costume Design and Art Design for ‘One Last Stop’. Kashish Jaiswal won Best Hair and Makeup Artist for ‘Shells’, while Harsh Sahani and Prakash Kumar Mehta were recognised for Animation and VFX for ‘Neel Machli’. Sudeksha Sarkar won Best Voice-over/Dubbing for ‘A Little Something’.
Congratulating the participants, Additional Secretary Prabhat described CMOT as a bridge between emerging talent and the film industry, providing young creators an opportunity to showcase their abilities and connect with industry professionals.
Referring to this year’s theme, ‘Roots & Wings: Honouring our Roots, Embracing our Future’, he highlighted the coming together of cultural heritage, innovation and technology, and said the growing AVGC-XR sector was opening new opportunities for young professionals in the creative industries.
Gowariker congratulated the teams and emphasised the collaborative nature of filmmaking, urging participants to sustain the bonds formed during the challenge, continue working together and build on the experience. The challenge began on November 21, with participants divided into five teams of 20: Red, Green, Blue, Yellow and Beige. Each team was required to conceptualise, shoot and complete a short film within 48 hours on the common theme.
The participants represented 13 filmmaking disciplines, including direction, acting, cinematography, editing, sound design, scriptwriting, art direction, animation, visual effects, music composition, playback singing, hair and makeup, and costume design.
After shooting at locations across Goa, the teams moved to a dedicated post-production hub at Kala Academy to complete editing, sound mixing and visual finishing within the deadline.
Since its inception in 2021, CMOT has emerged as a platform connecting young creative professionals with the media and entertainment industry. Its alumni have gone on to work on international productions and earn recognition at festivals and platforms including Cannes, Berlinale, Toronto International Film Festival and the International Emmy Awards.
In an outcome from the previous edition, 18 participants were selected by Mukesh Chhabra Casting Company, highlighting the initiative’s potential to translate talent into professional opportunities. The filmmaking challenge was curated and conducted by FTII in collaboration with NFDC, with FTII faculty mentoring participants and the Entertainment Society of Goa facilitating shooting permissions across the state.

title: Pharmacy council cautions against AI-driven medicine prescriptions, calls for regulatory curbs
description: Cautioning against the trend of prescribing medicines based on artificial intelligence suggestions, the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) on Wednesday said the government should bring strict regulatory provisions to prevent the uncontrolled use of AI in this area.
author: PTI
content:
Indore, Nov 25: Cautioning against the trend of prescribing medicines based on artificial intelligence suggestions, the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) on Wednesday said the government should bring strict regulatory provisions to prevent the uncontrolled use of AI in this area.
Jashubhai H Chaudhari, Vice-President of the PCI, also called for stringent regulations governing online pharmacies.
"AI is very helpful in education and many other fields, but it cannot be blindly trusted in diagnosing diseases and selecting medicines without the advice of a qualified doctor or a pharmacist. The government should enact strict regulatory provisions to control the use of AI in this area," Chaudhari told PTI in Indore.
Responding to a question, he said the PCI does not support the concept of online pharmacies because it is not possible to physically verify whether or not a registered pharmacist is dispensing medicines to customers.
Chaudhari stressed that there should be strict regulations for online pharmacies, and the PCI has periodically submitted its suggestions to the government in this regard.
The PCI is a statutory body under the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. The council, constituted in 1949, regulates pharmacy education and the profession.
The PCI Vice-President said antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is an emerging threat to the entire healthcare system and acts as an "invisible enemy" for patients.
Antimicrobial resistance is a condition in which bacteria, viruses, fungi, or parasites become less effective or no longer respond to drugs. This makes infections difficult or impossible to treat, increasing the risk of disease spread, serious illness, disability, and death.
Chaudhari said the PCI is raising awareness about the threat of AMR through various campaigns.
He explained that students participating in these campaigns are being trained as "AMR Warriors" who will go among people and raise awareness about this threat.
Chaudhary said, "People should not take antimicrobial drugs, especially antibiotics, without consulting a doctor or pharmacist. If needed, the full dosage of these medications should be taken."
He informed that the PCI is planning at least eight state-level job fairs for pharmacy students across the country between January and March.
Chaudhari was in Indore to participate in an event organised by the PCI in collaboration with local organisations on the theme of 'Swastha Bharat: Combating Antimicrobial Resistance.'

title: Sooryavanshi Smashes World-Record 52-Ball Double Ton as India A Thrash UAE
description: SRINAGAR: Teenage batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi on Tuesday smashed the fastest double century in List A cricket history, reaching 200 in just 52 deliveries as India A crushed the United Arab Emirates by nine wickets in the ACC Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 in Doha. Follow Us On G-Ne w s | Whatsapp …
author: KL News Network
content:
SRINAGAR: Teenage batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi on Tuesday smashed the fastest double century in List A cricket history, reaching 200 in just 52 deliveries as India A crushed the United Arab Emirates by nine wickets in the ACC Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 in Doha.
The 15-year-old produced a breathtaking unbeaten-on-the-record-books innings of 204 off just 53 balls, featuring 28 sixes and seven fours, as India A chased down the target of 250 in only 14.2 overs.
Sooryavanshi’s extraordinary knock eclipsed the previous List A record of a 103-ball double century set by New Zealand’s Chad Bowes in October 2024. He reached the landmark 51 deliveries faster than the previous record-holder.
The left-handed opener also broke the record for the fastest century in List A cricket, bringing up his hundred in just 28 balls and surpassing Australian batter Jake Fraser-McGurk’s previous mark of 29 deliveries, set for South Australia against Tasmania in the 2023–24 season.
His 28 sixes also established a new record for the most maximums in a single List A innings.
India A’s chase suffered an early setback when Abhishek Sharma was dismissed, but Sooryavanshi and the other batters ensured there was no further resistance from the UAE bowling attack. His explosive innings propelled India A to victory in just 14.2 overs, with nine wickets in hand.
The result also secured India A’s qualification for the semi-finals, making them the fourth team to reach the last four of the tournament.
Sooryavanshi’s performance marked one of the most extraordinary individual batting displays in List A cricket, with the teenager rewriting multiple records in a single innings.

title: Sooryavanshi Creates History With World-Record 28-Ball Century
description: SRINAGAR: Teenage batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi on Tuesday created history by scoring the fastest century in List A cricket, reaching the milestone in just 28 balls for India A against the United Arab Emirates in the ACC Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 in Doha.   Follow Us On G-Ne w s | Whatsapp …
author: KL News Network
content:
The 15-year-old broke the previous world record of 29 balls held by Australian batter Jake Fraser-McGurk, who had achieved the feat for South Australia against Tasmania in the 2023–24 season.
Opening the innings in India’s chase of 250 runs, Sooryavanshi launched an extraordinary assault on the UAE bowling attack, reaching his half-century in just 16 deliveries before completing his hundred off the 28th ball.
At the time of the reported live score, he had raced to 121 runs off 32 deliveries, striking 15 sixes and four fours at a remarkable strike rate of 378.13.
His innings helped India A reach 100 runs in just five overs, setting a record for the fastest team century in List A cricket, according to the match report.
Sooryavanshi’s achievement also eclipsed the Indian record previously held by Bihar batter Sakibul Gani, who had scored a 32-ball century against Arunachal Pradesh in the Vijay Hazare Trophy during the 2025–26 season.
The list of fastest centuries in List A cricket is now headed by Sooryavanshi, followed by Fraser-McGurk (29 balls), South African great AB de Villiers (31 balls), Sakibul Gani (32 balls) and Ishan Kishan (33 balls).
The record-breaking knock further underlined the teenager’s growing reputation in Indian cricket, adding another landmark performance to his impressive run in the India A jersey.

title: Delhi Court Issues Non-Bailable Warrant Against Dhruv Rathee in 2018 Case
description: SRINAGAR: A Delhi court has issued a non-bailable warrant against YouTuber Dhruv Rathee in a defamation case dating back to 2018, after earlier attempts to serve summons on him remained unsuccessful, Bar and Bench reported. Follow Us On G-Ne w s | Whatsapp Dhruv Rathee Judicial Magistrate First Class Anam Rais Khan issued the …
author: KL News Network
content:
SRINAGAR: A Delhi court has issued a non-bailable warrant against YouTuber Dhruv Rathee in a defamation case dating back to 2018, after earlier attempts to serve summons on him remained unsuccessful, Bar and Bench reported.
Judicial Magistrate First Class Anam Rais Khan issued the warrant on Monday. The court has scheduled the next hearing for December 3.
The case stems from a video uploaded by Rathee in May 2018, in which he alleged that members of the Bharatiya Janata Party’s (BJP) IT cell had attempted to bribe Vikas Sankrityayan, also known as Vikas Pandey.
The video was subsequently retweeted by then Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal, following which Pandey initiated defamation proceedings against both Rathee and Kejriwal.
According to Newslaundry, the court had earlier issued a bailable warrant against Rathee. In October, it allowed an application seeking an early hearing after the complainant’s counsel, advocate Samaksh Sharma, submitted that summons had remained unserved for several years as Rathee primarily resides abroad.
Pandey, who describes himself as a supporter of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, is the founder of the social media page ‘I Support Narendra Modi’.
The disputed video had alleged that Pandey was associated with the BJP IT cell and had offered Rs 50 lakh through an intermediary to Mahavir Prasad in exchange for withdrawing allegations that the organisation spread fake news.
The latest warrant marks a further development in the defamation proceedings, which involve allegations made in the 2018 video and its subsequent circulation on social media.

title: SP’s 5-candidate list sparks Cong-Samajwadi tensions
description: UP seat-sharing row: We are not begging, says Masood as SP defends announcement for 5 seats  Lucknow, Nov 25: “We aren’t begging,” said a miffed Congress Uttar Pradesh working committee chief Imran Masood on Wednesday as there was no headway in the seat-sharing talks for the assembly elections with ally Samajwadi Party, which has already […]
author: Agencies
content:
UP seat-sharing row: We are not begging, says Masood as SP defends announcement for 5 seats
Lucknow, Nov 25: “We aren’t begging,” said a miffed Congress Uttar Pradesh working committee chief Imran Masood on Wednesday as there was no headway in the seat-sharing talks for the assembly elections with ally Samajwadi Party, which has already announced five candidates, arguing that the move was a normal part of the process.
The Samajwadi Party (SP) has been insisting that the criteria should be “winning equations” and not the number of seats.
The announcement of candidates by the SP on Tuesday came even as the contentious seat-sharing talks between the two parties were underway, irking several Congress leaders, including Masood, while the ruling BJP swooped in to suggest that the Congress-SP marriage was fraught with contradictions and prone to an implosion.
The SP chief has urged the Congress to focus on fielding “PDA candidates” while the latter counselled restraint to SP leaders, whose remarks on its ally’s political strength were adding more fuel to the fire.
Masood on Wednesday said he will discuss with the party leadership whether seat-sharing talks with the SP should continue.
The five seats for which the SP announced candidates on Tuesday include two in Saharanpur, Masood’s Lok Sabha constituency.
He said, “When you are holding talks on one hand and making announcements on the other, it shows that you are not serious.” “We will discuss within our party what needs to be done and whether we should sit for talks or not. The party will decide what course of action to take,” he told PTI Videos.
The first round of talks that ended on Tuesday at Congress veteran Pramod Tiwari’s Delhi residence remained inconclusive, with SP revealing its initial offer of 26 seats, way lower than Congress’s expectations.
Of the five seats that the SP declared candidates for in a surprise move, four are held by its sitting MLAs — Ashu Malik from Saharanpur, Nahid Hasan from Kairana, Umar Ali Khan from Behat in Saharanpur and Mehboob Ali from Amroha.
The four seats are in western Uttar Pradesh, where the SP expects a challenge from BJP, its ally RLD, as well as the recently floated Samajik Parivartan Morcha of AIMIM leader Asaduddin Owaisi and Aazad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) chief Chandrashekar Aazad.
Its fifth candidate is Jyoti Lodhi, who will contest from Lalitpur in Bundelkhand.
Tej Narain Pandey alias Pawan Pandey was already declared the party candidate from Ayodhya in August.
‘Should have avoided’: Cong on SP declaring list
The Congress on Wednesday expressed displeasure over the SP announcing a list of five candidates for the Uttar Pradesh Assembly polls, saying the move should have been avoided when seat-sharing talks were ongoing.
The Congress also appealed to the leaders of both parties to respect each others’ sentiments, prioritise meeting the public’s expectations and freeing the people of Uttar Pradesh from a “dictatorial government.” On Tuesday, hours after the second round of the meeting between the two parties to discuss, the Samajwadi Party (SP) announced its list of five candidates for the elections.
“They should have avoided that and waited (for the talks to be over). Nevertheless, this had also happened in the 2024 Lok Sabha polls, and some candidates were withdrawn as well,” AICC in-charge of UP, Rajendra Pal Gautam, said. “I hope everything will go in the right direction,” he added.
‘Ram Naam Satya’ time approaching for SP: Yogi
“Radhe Radhe is just the beginning. Time for Ram Naam Satya is approaching for the SP”, said Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath while accusing its leadership of practising family-centric politics and failing to respect the sentiments of Ram devotees.
Adityanath also targeted SP chief Akhilesh Yadav over his proposed visit to Ayodhya, saying those who tried to sail in two boats would eventually drown.
“If the SP leadership had shown some wisdom in the 1990s, bullets would not have been fired at Ram devotees. They should now apologise to Ram devotees and Hindus,” he was quoted in a press statement of an interview at ABP Conclave here.
“Radhe Radhe is just the beginning; the time for Ram Naam Satya is approaching for the SP,” he added.
Explaining his remark, the chief minister said ‘Radhe Radhe’ was an appropriate greeting in Mathura, ‘Jai Shri Ram’ in Ayodhya and ‘Har Har Mahadev’ in Kashi, according to local religious traditions. He added that ‘Ram Naam Satya’ was traditionally associated with a person’s final journey. (PTI)

content:
Centre unveils Rs 11,000-cr push for construction equipment sector
New Delhi, Nov 25: The Union Cabinet on Wednesday approved a Rs 11,000-crore scheme to boost the country’s Construction and Infrastructure Equipment (CIE) manufacturing ecosystem. Addressing the media after the Cabinet meeting, Information and Broadcasting Minister (I&B) Ashwini Vaishnaw said the scheme will run for eight years, starting in FY2026-27, and aims to build indigenous capacity in advanced CIE and position India as a key player in the global market. (PTI)
India Pavilion bags Visitors’ Lion at Venice Biennale
New Delhi, Nov 25: The India Pavilion won the top award, the Visitors’ Lion, at the prestigious Venice Art Biennale, Union Culture Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat announced on Wednesday, describing it as a “remarkable recognition” of the country’s growing cultural influence. The pavilion, under the theme ‘Geographies of Distance: Remembering Home’, explored memory and belonging in a rapidly transforming world. “A moment of immense pride! India wins the Best National Pavilion – Visitors’ Lion at the Venice Art Biennale, the Olympics of the art world. The honour, decided through votes by visitors from across the globe, is a remarkable recognition of India’s growing cultural influence,” he said. The India Pavilion returned to the Biennale Arte — one of the components of La Biennale di Venezia — after a gap of seven years. (PTI)
Thick smoke and flames billow after a fire broke out in the remote Panwani village, that engulfed several wooden residential structures in the area, affecting 58 families, in Uttarkashi district of Uttarakhand, on Tuesday. (PTI)
J’khand student digitises 6.8 lakh PDF files of UP SIR rolls
New Delhi, Nov 24: Sarthak Sidhant, a student from Jharkhand who hogged the spotlight for flagging irregularities in CBSE’s On-Screen Marking (OSM) system, has claimed to have digitised 6.8 lakh PDF files of Uttar Pradesh voter rolls published by the Election Commission of India (ECI) into a searchable format. Sidhant said his team used Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to process every voter roll PDF published by the ECI for Uttar Pradesh. “Hello chat, we OCR’d every voter roll PDF that the ECI put out of Uttar Pradesh. The 2024 Lok Sabha roll, both SIR rolls and the 2027 draft. 6.8 lakh PDFs, mostly scans. Now 54.8 crore rows, one table for each of the 403 constituencies,” he said in a post on X. The Election Commission has so far refused to react to the claim. (PTI)

title: PM suggests Parl session before Dec 15
description: PM suggests Parl session before Dec 15
author: NagaPost
content:
NEW DELHI, NOV 25 (PTI): Prime Minister Narendra Modi is learnt to have suggested to his ministerial colleagues that they complete preparations for the next Parliament session before December 15 and advised them against undertaking foreign travel in the run-up to it.
Sources aware of the matter said the issue of the next Parliament session figured at Wednesday’s Cabinet meeting chaired by Modi.
PM suggested that the session be convened before December 15, sources said, adding that the Cabinet Committee on Parliamentary Affairs will finalise when it will commence and its duration. Modi stressed the need for preparations, asking the ministers to ensure that their respective ministries are ready for the upcoming session.

title: Union Cabinet clears Rs 2,632 cr to boost postal network
description: Union Cabinet clears Rs 2,632 cr to boost postal network
author: NagaPost
content:
NEW DELHI, NOV 25 (PTI): The Union Cabinet on Wednesday approved two schemes with a total outlay of Rs 2,632 crore for the Department of Posts to boost postal network and services as well as modernise its estate infrastructure over a period of five years.
Union minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said that the Cabinet has cleared the Postal Operations Scheme with an outlay of Rs 1,141 crore and the Estates Management Scheme for the Department of Posts with an outlay of Rs 1,491 crore.
“Enhancement of the Postal Operations Scheme of the Department of Posts (DoP) and approval of the Estates Management Scheme for the Department of Posts have been done,” Vaishnaw said.
The “Postal Operations” has been approved for the 16th Finance Commission Cycle from FY 2026-27 to FY 2030-31 to strengthen postal infrastructure, improve operational efficiency and support the growing requirements of logistics, e-commerce and digital service delivery across the country, the minister said.
Vaishnaw said that post offices will be developed as rural business hubs for banking services, train tickets, insurance projects, etc.
“There will be an enhanced focus on parcels,” he said.
Union communications minister Jyotiraditya Scindia, in a social media post, said that the approval is a “glow-up” for India Post.
Minister of state for communications, Chandra Sekhar Pemmasani, expressed gratitude to Prime Minister Narendra Modi for recognising the hard work and strong revenue growth of India Post.
“Today’s cabinet approvals (FY 2026–31) will transform our network and empower our workforce,” he said.
The postal network comprises 1.65 lakh post offices (including 1,49,385 in rural areas). India Post remains a critical vehicle for mail, banking (POSB/IPPB), insurance (PLI), Aadhaar services, Post Office Passport Seva Kendras and rural artisan support via Dakghar Niryat Kendras (DNKs).
The postal operations scheme will support modernisation of postal infrastructure, strengthen last-mile delivery, improve logistics efficiency, promote financial inclusion and enhance customer-centric service delivery across the country.
According to the information shared by Scindia, the approved corpus under “Estates Management Scheme” will be utilised for setting up 190 new buildings, revamping 50 old buildings, upgrading 5,050 post offices, preserving 20 heritage buildings, renovating 150 residential colonies and setting up an integrated technology centre in Bengaluru.
The approved fund comprises Rs 280 crore for building 190 departmental postal buildings on vacant departmental plots, Rs 108 crore for demolishing and rebuilding 50 dilapidated departmental postal structures and Rs 318 crore for upgrading and establishing uniform branding across 2,550 departmental SubPost Offices.

title: Cabinet approves Rs 2,014-cr greenfield airport in Silchar
description: Cabinet approves Rs 2,014-cr greenfield airport in Silchar
author: NagaPost
content:
Spl. Correspondent
NEW DELHI, NOV 25 (NPN): The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, has approved the development of a new greenfield airport at Doloo in Silchar, Assam, at an estimated cost of Rs 2,014 crore.
The project will be undertaken by the Airports Authority of India (AAI) to address the operational and space constraints of the existing defence landlocked civil enclave at Silchar Airport and cater to sustained growth in passenger traffic.
Located in Cachar district, Doloo is strategically positioned in the Barak Valley, a region known for its tea gardens, agro-based industries and potential for eco and cultural tourism.
The proposed terminal building will cover 12,351 square metres and have the capacity to handle 800 passengers during peak hours.
It will feature modern passenger amenities, sustainable green building principles and provision for modular expansion.
The project also includes a 2,705-metre-long and 45-metre-wide Code 4C-compliant runway suitable for A-320 aircraft.
A new apron will accommodate six A-320 aircraft, along with a dedicated isolation bay.
The airport is expected to meet growing air traffic demand in South Assam and adjoining areas of neighbouring states. It is also expected to ease pressure on existing infrastructure, promote trade and tourism, and strengthen connectivity between the Northeast and wider national and international growth corridors.

title: रोहतक में खूनी गैंगवार; मिलन ढाबे पर बाबा और हिमांशु भाऊ गैंग के बीच ताबड़तोड़ चली गोलियां, 3 शूटरों की मौके पर मौत; एक को दौड़ा-दौड़ाकर मारी गोली
description: हरियाणा के रोहतक में खूनी गैंगवार हुई है। बुधवार को देर रात यहां मिलन ढाबे पर अंधाधुंध फायरिंग हुई, जिसमें चार युवकों की हत्या कर दी गई है। यह वारदात खरावड़ पुलिस चौकी से महज 50 कदम की दूरी पर हुई है।
author: Ankur Shrivastava
content:
रोहतक में खूनी गैंगवार; मिलन ढाबे पर बाबा और हिमांशु भाऊ गैंग के बीच ताबड़तोड़ चली गोलियां, 3 शूटरों की मौके पर मौत; एक को दौड़ा-दौड़ाकर मारी गोली
हरियाणा के रोहतक में खूनी गैंगवार हुई है। बुधवार को देर रात यहां मिलन ढाबे पर अंधाधुंध फायरिंग हुई, जिसमें चार युवकों की हत्या कर दी गई है। यह वारदात खरावड़ पुलिस चौकी से महज 50 कदम की दूरी पर हुई है।
- भारत
- 2 min read
हरियाणा के रोहतक में खूनी गैंगवार हुई है। बुधवार को देर रात यहां मिलन ढाबे पर अंधाधुंध फायरिंग हुई, जिसमें चार युवकों की हत्या कर दी गई है। यह वारदात खरावड़ पुलिस चौकी से महज 50 कदम की दूरी पर हुई है। मृतकों में रिंकू पुत्र जगबीर वासी डिघल, विनित पुत्र जयबीर डिघल , गन्जू वासी डिघल और हिमांशु पुत्र राजबीर वासी बेरी शामिल है। जानकारी के मुताबिक, स्विफ्ट कार में सवार पांच हथियारबंद बदमाश पहुचे थे। आरोपितों ने खाना खा रहे युवकों पर ताबड़तोड़ गोलियां बरसा दीं। गोलियों की आवाज से ढाबे पर मची भगदड़ मच गई। जान बचाने के लिए लोग टेबल और कुर्सियों के पीछे छिप गए।
प्रारंभिक जानकारी के अनुसार करीब साढ़े 12 बजे पांच हथियारबंद बदमाश स्विफ्ट कार में सवार होकर मिलन ढाबे पर पहुंचे। उस समय कुछ युवक खाना खा रहे थे। प्रत्यक्षदर्शियों के मुताबिक बदमाशों ने आते ही युवकों पर अंधाधुंध गोलियां बरसानी शुरू कर दीं। फायरिंग के दौरान तीन युवकों की मौके पर ही मौत हो गई। चौथा युवक घटनास्थल से भागने की कोशिश कर रहा था, लेकिन हमलावरों ने उसका पीछा किया और उसे भी गोली मार दी। वारदात के बाद आरोपी कई मिनट तक मौके पर हथियार लहराते हुए घूमते रहे और फिर फरार हो गए।
पुलिस ने क्या कहा
वारदात की सूचना मिलते ही रोहतक पुलिस रेंज के आईजी हामिद अख्तर भी मौके पर पहुंचे। फिलहाल पुलिस ने मामला दर्ज कर जांच शुरू कर दी है। पुलिस का कहना है कि आरोपियों की तलाश के टीमें बनाई गई है। पुलिस के कहना है कि जल्द ही सभी आरोपियों को गिरफ्तार कर लिया जाएगा। वहीं आशंका जताई जा रही है और कहा जा रहा है कि डीघल गांव में पिछले दिनों हुए युवक के मर्डर के चलते यह घटना हुई है।

title: Rajasthan: पंचायत चुनाव में झटके के बाद भाजपा का दिल्ली में मंथन, मदन राठौड़ समेत पूरी टीम तलब
