षटकारांचा उल्लेख करणं महत्त्वाचं आहे, कारण वैभव सूर्यवंशीच्या खेळण्याच्या शैलीबाबत त्याचा आक्रमकपणा आणि षटकार मारण्याच्या क्षमतेची वारंवार चर्चा होते.
काही तज्ज्ञांचं मत आहे की, वैभव सूर्यवंशीला भारताच्या टी-20 आंतरराष्ट्रीय संघात कायमचं स्थान मिळायला हवं आणि सलामीवीर म्हणून त्याच्या स्थानाशी काही काळ तरी छेडछाड केली जाऊ नये.
'स्पर्धा तगडी आहे'
ज्येष्ठ क्रीडा पत्रकार आणि तज्ज्ञ अयाझ मेमन यांना विचारण्यात आलं की, अशा शानदार खेळी केल्यानंतरही वैभवला संघात स्थान देऊन दीर्घकाळ का आजमावलं जात नाही? यावर त्यांनी म्हटलं की हा प्रश्न अगदी रास्त आहे.
नुकतीच भारतीय संघाने न्यूझीलंडमध्ये पाच सामन्यांची टी-20 मालिका खेळली. त्यापैकी दोन सामन्यांत वैभव सूर्यवंशीला संघात खेळण्याची संधी देण्यात आली.
यापैकी एका सामन्यात त्याला सलामीला खेळण्याची संधी मिळाली आणि त्याने 19 चेंडूंमध्ये 45 धावा केल्या.
मालिका सुरू होण्यापूर्वी कर्णधार श्रेयस अय्यर यांना वैभवला संधी देण्याबाबत विचारण्यात आलं होतं. ते म्हणाले होते, "त्याच्यासारख्या प्रतिभावान खेळाडूने ड्रेसिंग रूमच्या वातावरणात आनंदी राहणं महत्त्वाचं आहे."
अय्यर यांच्या म्हणण्यानुसार, "तो खूपच लहान आहे आणि येत्या काळात त्याला अनेक संधी मिळतील. तो थेट संघात येऊन स्थान मिळवू शकत नाही, कारण आमचे सलामीवीरही सातत्याने चांगली कामगिरी करत आहेत."
पण ही रणनीती योग्य आहे का?
अयाझ मेमन यांनी बीबीसीला सांगितलं, "बहुतेक लोकांचं म्हणणं आहे की वैभव सूर्यवंशी हा 'चाइल्ड प्रॉडिजी' आहे किंवा एका पिढीत एखादाच होणारा खेळाडू आहे. अशा खेळाडूला योग्य वेळी आणि सातत्याने संधी मिळाली नाही, तर त्याचे तोटेही होऊ शकतात. सचिन तेंडुलकरलाही खूप कमी वयात संधी देण्यात आली होती. त्यांना एकदा संधी दिल्यानंतर सातत्याने खेळवलं गेलं आणि त्यानंतर त्यांनी काय केलं, ते आपल्या सर्वांसमोर आहे."
1989 मध्ये पाकिस्तानविरुद्ध सचिन तेंडुलकरने कसोटी आणि वनडे क्रिकेटमध्ये पदार्पण केलं, तेव्हा त्याचं वय 16 वर्षं होतं.
जागतिक विक्रमाबद्दल बोलायचं झालं तर पाकिस्तानच्या हसन रझाने अवघ्या 14 वर्षं 233 दिवसांच्या वयात झिम्बाब्वेविरुद्ध पहिला वनडे सामना खेळला होता.
End of podcast promotion
सामान्यतः इंग्लंड आणि ऑस्ट्रेलियामध्ये काउंटी आणि स्टेट संघांकडून खेळणाऱ्या खेळाडूंना राष्ट्रीय संघात स्थान मिळवण्यासाठी बराच वेळ लागतो. मात्र आंतरराष्ट्रीय क्रिकेटमध्ये कमी वयात पदार्पण करून आपलं स्थान निर्माण करणाऱ्या आशियाई खेळाडूंची यादी मोठी आहे.
मंगळवारी यूएईविरुद्ध खेळलेल्या वैभवच्या खेळीबाबत अयाझ मेमन म्हणाले, "वैभवची कालची खेळी ही एक विलक्षण खेळी होती. जणू तो निवड समितीला काहीतरी संदेश देत होता. असा खेळाडू क्वचितच पाहायला मिळतो. चांगलं खेळूनही संघात कायमचं स्थान मिळण्याची आशा दिसत नसेल, तर त्याचा खेळाडूच्या मानसिक कणखरतेवरही परिणाम होऊ शकतो."
ते म्हणाले, "कोणताही खेळाडू असा विचार करू शकतो की, चांगलं खेळूनही संघात नीट स्थान मिळत नाहीये, तर आता आणखी काय करायचं? दहा सामन्यांमध्ये अपयशी ठरल्यानंतर संघाबाहेर करणं समजू शकतं. पण एक-दोन सामने खेळवणं आणि त्यानंतर पुन्हा बाहेर करणं योग्य नाही. वैभवला दीर्घकाळ संधी देण्याची गरज आहे."
पण कर्णधार अय्यर यांनी सलामीच्या जोडीबाबत मांडलेल्या मुद्द्याचं काय?
यावर मेमन म्हणाले, "अभिषेक शर्मा आणि संजू सॅमसन हे दोघेही उत्कृष्ट खेळाडू आहेत, हे खरं आहे. पण वैभवसाठी संघात जागा कशी निर्माण करता येईल, याचे मार्ग तुम्हाला शोधावे लागतील. कधी त्याला खेळवायचं आणि कधी बाहेर बसवायचं, असं करता येणार नाही."
बीबीसीने वैभवबाबत प्रसिद्ध क्रीडा तज्ज्ञ आणि लेखिका मीनाक्षी राव यांच्याशी चर्चा केली. त्यांच्या मते, या खेळाडूबाबत संतुलित दृष्टिकोन ठेवण्याची गरज आहे.
मीनाक्षी यांच्या म्हणण्यानुसार, "वैभवबाबत सगळीकडे खूप चर्चा आणि उत्सुकता आहे. तो इतर ठिकाणी चांगली कामगिरी करतो तेव्हा त्याची मोठी चर्चा होते. पण भारतीय संघाकडून खेळताना एखाद्या दिवशी तो अपयशी ठरला, तर लगेच तो खराब खेळत असल्याचं म्हटलं जातं. हे योग्य नाही. तो प्रत्येक सामन्यात धावा करेल, अशी अपेक्षा करणं निरर्थक आहे. पण त्याला सातत्याने संधी द्यायला हव्यात."
मीनाक्षी यांच्या मते, वैभवची आक्रमक फलंदाजी ही त्याची यूएसपी आहे आणि त्यात बदल करण्याचा प्रयत्न केला जाऊ नये. मात्र त्याच वेळी आंतरराष्ट्रीय खेळपट्ट्या आणि आंतरराष्ट्रीय गोलंदाजांसमोर त्याची परीक्षा होणंही गरजेचं आहे.
यासोबतच वैभवला काही टी-20 सामन्यांमध्ये सातत्याने 30-40 धावांच्या खेळी करून आपल्या सातत्याचा अंदाजही द्यावा लागेल.
त्या म्हणाल्या, "वैभवला आंतरराष्ट्रीय क्रिकेटमध्ये खेळपट्टी आणि गोलंदाज यांना समजून घेण्याची गरज आहे. कारण येत्या काळात गोलंदाजही त्याच्या खेळाचा अभ्यास करतील. अशा परिस्थितीत त्याला त्यावर उत्तरं शोधावी लागतील. तांत्रिकदृष्ट्या आपला खेळ अधिक भक्कम करावा लागेल. ड्रेसिंग रूममध्ये राहूनही तो खूप काही शिकू शकतो."
मीनाक्षी यांचं मत आहे की, पुढील वर्षी होणाऱ्या वनडे विश्वचषकापूर्वी वैभवला काही वनडे सामन्यांमध्येही खेळवलं पाहिजे. त्याचबरोबर देशांतर्गत क्रिकेटमध्ये जेव्हा-जेव्हा संधी मिळेल, तेव्हा त्याने दीर्घ फॉरमॅटचं क्रिकेटही खेळायला हवं.
त्या म्हणाल्या, "त्याचं वय कमी आहे, त्यामुळे संघात स्थान पक्कं करण्यासाठी त्याच्याकडे अजून बराच वेळ आहे, हे खरं आहे. पण तो सध्या ज्या फॉर्ममध्ये आहे आणि त्याच्या खेळात जो आक्रमकपणा दिसतो, तो त्याला कायम ठेवावा लागेल. प्रतिभेची अजिबात कमतरता नाही. मात्र त्यासोबत सातत्य, परिस्थितीनुसार खेळात बदल करण्याची क्षमता, सामन्याची समज आणि तांत्रिक कौशल्य यांची गरज असेल. आणि या सगळ्या गोष्टी त्याला आंतरराष्ट्रीय सामने खेळूनच मिळतील."
मीनाक्षी यांच्या म्हणण्यानुसार, "तो 15 वर्षांच्या ऐवजी 16 वर्षांचा असताना संघातील कायमस्वरूपी खेळाडू बनला, तरी त्यात काही अडचण नाही. कारण त्याच्याकडे वेळ आहे. पण त्याला निवडक दौऱ्यांमध्ये नक्कीच खेळवलं पाहिजे. कारण जगभरातील गोलंदाजांनी त्याच्या खेळाचा अभ्यास सुरू केला असेल. आता त्यालाही आंतरराष्ट्रीय गोलंदाजांचा खेळ समजून घेणं शिकावं लागेल."
(बीबीसीसाठी कलेक्टिव्ह न्यूजरूमचे प्रकाशन.)

title: वैभव सूर्यवंशी : 'इतके सिक्सर तर हाताने देखील फेकता येणार नाहीत'; पाकिस्तानच्या माजी क्रिकेटपटूंकडून तोंडभरून कौतुक
description: आशिया कप रायझिंग स्टार्स सामन्यात युएईविरुद्ध वैभव सूर्यवंशीने केलेल्या स्फोटक खेळीची जगभरात चर्चा होत असून, विशेषतः पाकिस्तानच्या माजी क्रिकेटपटूंनी त्याचं तोंडभरून कौतुक केलं आहे.
author: BBC News मराठी
content:
वैभव सूर्यवंशी : 'इतके सिक्सर तर हाताने देखील फेकता येणार नाहीत'; पाकिस्तानच्या माजी क्रिकेटपटूंकडून तोंडभरून कौतुक
आशिया कप रायजिंग स्टार्स सामन्यात युएईविरुद्ध वैभव सूर्यवंशीने केलेल्या स्फोटक खेळीची जगभरात चर्चा होत असून, विशेषतः पाकिस्तानच्या माजी क्रिकेटपटूंनी त्याचं तोंडभरून कौतुक केलं आहे.
मंगळवारी पाकिस्तान 'ए' संघाने नेपाळला 96 धावांनी पराभूत केले. पण पाकिस्तानमध्ये, या विजयापेक्षाही भारताच्या युएईविरुद्धच्या विजयाची जास्त चर्चा होत आहे.
15 वर्षीय वैभव सूर्यवंशीच्या नावावर लिस्ट ए मध्ये सर्वात जलद द्विशतक करण्याचा विक्रम आहे.
त्यानं युएईविरुद्ध अवघ्या 52 चेंडूंमध्ये द्विशतक झळकावलं आणि यामध्ये 28 षटकार व सात चौकारांचा समावेश होता.
भारताचा माजी कर्णधार सौरव गांगुली म्हणाले की, "वैभव सूर्यवंशीनं 28 चेंडूंमध्ये शतक झळकावून लिस्ट ए क्रिकेटमधील सर्वात जलद शतकाचा नवा विक्रम रचला आहे. त्यानं जेक फ्रेझर-मॅकगर्कचा 29 चेंडूंमध्ये शतक करण्याचा आधीचा विक्रम मागे टाकला आहे."
"तो चांगला खेळला. हा 'ए' दर्जाचा संघ आहे. टी-20 मधील त्याची क्षमता विलक्षण आहे. तसेच, त्याचे पॉवर हिटिंग उत्कृष्ट होतं. तो खूप चांगला खेळला," असंही सौरव गांगुली म्हणाले.
पाकिस्तानमधील माजी क्रिकेटपटूंनी म्हटलं आहे की, 'व्हीडिओ गेम्समध्येही इतके षटकार मारता येत नाहीत' किंवा 'संपूर्ण संघसुद्धा इतके षटकार मारू शकत नाही.'
'संपूर्ण संघाला मारता येणार नाहीत एवढे षटकार'
पाकिस्तानचे माजी क्रिकेटपटू बासित अली म्हणाले की, 'युएईविरुद्ध तर सामनाच होऊ शकला नाही.'
आपल्या यूट्यूब चॅनलवर भाष्य करताना ते म्हणाले की , "यूएईनं 249 धावांचं चांगलं टार्गेट दिलं होतं आणि दुसऱ्या डावात खेळपट्टी खराब होईल असं वाटत होतं. पण, मैदानावरचं दृश्य वेगळंच होतं. संपूर्ण संघाला जेवढे षटकार मारता येत नाहीत, तेवढे वैभवने मारले."
बासित अली म्हणाले की, "त्यानं प्रत्येक षटकामध्ये एकतर तीन षटकार आणि दोन चौकार किंवा तीन चौकार आणि दोन षटकार मारले. लिस्ट ए चे सर्व विक्रम बबलूने (वैभव) आपल्या नावावर केले."
"वैभवने आंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तरावर एकाच दिवसात इतर कोणत्याही संघापेक्षा जास्त षटकार मारले. मला वाटतं त्यानं धावत जाऊन फक्त आठ धावा केल्या, तर बाउंड्रीजच्या जोरावर सुमारे 196 धावा केल्या."
"ज्या मैदानावर सामना खेळला जात होता, ते काही छोटं मैदान नव्हतं. पण मागील दोन सामन्यांमध्ये चांगली कामगिरी न केल्यामुळे दबावही होता. उपांत्य फेरी आणि अंतिम फेरीत येण्यापूर्वीच त्यांनी आपला फॉर्म दाखवून दिला आहे."
'एक्सेप्शनल टॅलेंट'
पाकिस्तानचा माजी क्रिकेटपटू मोहम्मद वसीम म्हणाला की, 'वैभव सूर्यवंशीचा विक्रम दुसरा कुणीही मोडू शकत नाही, कदाचित तो स्वतःच तो मोडू शकेल.'
माजी क्रिकेटपटू तनवीर अहमद म्हणाले की, "तो जे खेळत आहे ती एक विलक्षण प्रतिभा आहे. 15 वर्षांच्या मुलासाठी हे खरोखरच आश्चर्यकारक आहे."
तनवीर अहमद यांनी सूर्यवंशीच्या वयावरही प्रश्नचिन्ह उपस्थित केलं, पण त्याचबरोबर असंही म्हटलं की, त्याला आपल्या कमकुवत बाजू सांभाळण्यासाठी अजून अधिक काम करण्याची गरज आहे.
ते म्हणाले की, "ज्या पद्धतीनं तो फलंदाजी करत होता, त्याला त्याच्या पसंतीनुसार चेंडू मिळत होते आणि तो त्यावर फटकेबाजी करत होता. कदाचित त्यामुळेच आंतरराष्ट्रीय क्रिकेटमध्ये त्याला त्या पद्धतीनं खेळवलं जात नाही. कारण, आंतरराष्ट्रीय क्रिकेटमध्ये अशा प्रकारे षटकार मारणं तितकं सोपं नसतं."
"कदाचित म्हणूनच त्याला संघासोबत राहण्यासाठी, दौरे करत राहण्यासाठी आणि शिकण्यासाठी वेळ दिला जात आहे. ज्या बाबींमध्ये तो कमकुवत आहे, जसं की कव्हर्स बनवताना, त्यानं त्यावर अधिक काम केलं पाहिजे. हा एक मार्ग आहे."
पाकिस्तान क्रिकेटवर टीका करताना तनवीर अहमद म्हणाले की, "जर वैभव पाकिस्तानमध्ये असता, तर त्याचा टी-20, एकदिवसीय आणि कसोटी संघात समावेश झाला असता आणि त्याला कर्णधारही बनवण्यात आलं असतं."
'एवढे षटकार तर हातानेही फेकले जाऊ शकत नाहीत'
End of podcast promotion
पाकिस्तानचा माजी क्रिकेटपटू कामरान अकमलनं एका यूट्यूब चॅनलवर बोलताना सांगितलं की, वयाच्या 25-30 व्या वर्षी जी कामगिरी करता येते आणि क्रिकेट व त्यातून जी प्रसिद्धी मिळते, ती वैभवने वयाच्या 15 व्या वर्षीच मिळवली.
तो म्हणाला की, "संघ कोणताही असो, रिझल्ट दिसला पाहिजे. कुणी एक चेंडू जरी सीमारेषेच्या दिशेनं टाकला, तरी तेवढ्या धावा होणार नाहीत. मी 52 चेंडू टाकले तरी 28 षटकार कधीच होणार नाहीत. त्यानं ते बॅटनं करून दाखवलं."
वैभव सूर्यवंशीच्या खेळाची तुलना आता पाकिस्तानमधील त्यांच्या स्वतःच्या संघाशीही केली जाऊ लागली आहे.
त्याच संभाषणात कामरान अकमल म्हणाला की, "वैभवची परिपक्वता आणि क्रिकेटमधील त्याचा दृष्टिकोन पाहता, त्याला आंतरराष्ट्रीय क्रिकेट खेळायला मिळत आहे. त्याला 15 वर्षांच्या वयोगटातून बाहेर काढण्यात आलं आहे."
"त्याच्या वयाचा विचार करणं आता थांबवायला हवं. आपल्या व्यवस्थेत, त्याच्यासारख्या खेळाडूला 'अंडर-15' गटाच्या पुढे जाऊच द्यायला नको होतं. त्यांची मानसिकता तर बघा. त्याच्याकडून कोणत्या प्रकारचा क्रिकेट खेळवलं जात आहे? आपण कदाचित तळापासून सुरुवात करण्याऐवजी वरच्या स्तरावरून गोष्टी हाताळत आहोत. साहजिकच, याचा परिणाम त्याच्या खेळाकडे पाहण्याच्या दृष्टिकोनावर, त्याच्या कामगिरीवर आणि एकूणच त्याच्या खेळण्यावर होणारच."
पाकिस्तानमध्ये नवीन खेळाडूंना पुढे का आणलं जात नाही, असा प्रश्न कामराननं विचारला.
पाकिस्तानी क्रीडा विश्लेषक मोहम्मद मोहसिन यांनी त्यांच्या यूट्यूब चॅनलवर वैभवच्या खेळीबद्दल बोलताना सांगितलं की, युएईच्या ड्रेसिंग रूमला नक्कीच विचारलं गेलं असेल, "तिथं किती माणसं होती?" त्यावर त्यांनी उत्तर दिलं असेल, 'तो एकटाच होता.'"
मोहम्मद मोहसिन म्हणाले की, "ख्रिस गेल स्वतःला एक अद्वितीय खेळाडू मानतो. तो (वैभव) स्वतःचेच विक्रम मोडून क्रिकेट खेळत आहे. ज्या दिवशी त्याची बॅट फॉर्मात असते, त्या दिवशी बोलण्यासारखं दुसरं काहीच उरत नाही."
किती विक्रम मोडले?
सर्वात जलद अर्धशतक: 21 जून रोजी श्रीलंका 'ए' संघाविरुद्ध 11 चेंडूंमध्ये. यापूर्वी हा विक्रम के. विरारत्ने यांच्या नावावर होता, ज्यांनी 1 नोव्हेंबर 2005 रोजी 12 चेंडूंमध्ये अर्धशतक झळकावलं होतं.
सर्वात जलद शतक: 24 नोव्हेंबर रोजी 28 चेंडूंमध्ये.
यापूर्वी हा विक्रम जेक फ्रेझर-मॅकगर्कच्या नावावर होता, ज्यानं 8 ऑक्टोबर 2023 रोजी 29 चेंडूंमध्ये शतक झळकावलं होतं.
सर्वात जलद 150: 24 नोव्हेंबर रोजी 40 चेंडूंमध्ये.
यापूर्वी हा विक्रम स्वतः वैभव सूर्यवंशीच्या नावावर होता, ज्यानं 24 डिसेंबर 2025 रोजी 59 चेंडूंमध्ये 159 धावा केल्या होत्या.
सर्वात जलद द्विशतक: आज 52 चेंडूंमध्ये.
यापूर्वी हा विक्रम चॅड बोव्सच्या नावावर होता. त्यानं 22 ऑक्टोबर 2024 रोजी 103 चेंडूंमध्ये द्विशतक झळकावलं होतं.
लिस्ट ए आणि टी-20 क्रिकेट या दोन्ही प्रकारांमध्ये शतक झळकावणारा सर्वात तरुण खेळाडू म्हणून सूर्यवंशीच्या नावावर विक्रम आहे. इतकंच नव्हे, तर तो टी-20 क्रिकेटमध्ये संघाचं नेतृत्व करणारा सर्वात तरुण खेळाडूदेखील आहे.

title: Delhi Police beats and detains a Caravan journalist during CEC protests
description: Caravan staffer Ryan Thomas was covering the protests against Gyanesh Kumar and SIR, which the government has tried to quash with an unprecedented police mobilisation in the capital.
author: The Caravan
content:
We’re glad this article found its way to you. If you’re not a subscriber, we’d love for you to consider subscribing—your support helps make this journalism possible. Either way, we hope you enjoy the read. Click to subscribe: subscribing
The Delhi Police detained and brutally beat up The Caravan’s assistant multimedia producer, Ryan Thomas, on 11 October. Ryan was covering the protests against Gyanesh Kumar and SIR, which the government has tried to quash with an unprecedented police mobilisation in the capital, with multiple trains and metros halted, and with internet shut down across central Delhi. Earlier in the day, the Supreme Court had directed that, among other things, journalists “shall not be hindered in discharge of their professional duties in any manner whatsoever.”
Around 6 pm, on Janpath Road, as the police were detaining protesters, Ryan started following and recording a video of a group of policemen taking an individual to a detention bus parked nearby. One of them, Assistant Sub-Inspector Kapil Kumar—who was, unlike the others, wearing a name tag—turned and asked Ryan, “Tum kya kar rahe ho yeh”—what are you doing? Suddenly, three cops rushed towards Ryan and began manhandling and hitting him, while dragging him to the detention bus. Ryan repeatedly told them he is a journalist, and his press card was hanging from his neck via a lanyard and visibly displayed.
Inside the bus, five police (two more had come into the bus by then) hit Ryan on the head multiple times and tried to snatch his phone. They tried to force him to delete the images he had recorded. When he refused, stating that he was willing to cooperate with them but would not give up his phone or camera, they intensified the beating. They tried to break his camera and goaded him. One of them said, “Camera se zyada deshbhakti aa raha hai logon main aajkal”—people are feeling a bit too much nationalism because of cameras these days.
A few minutes later, about two other policemen came into the bus. They began saying “Isko doosri gadi mein le chalte hain. Isko doosri jagah le ke jaenge, kyunki ye samajh nahin raha hai”—Let’s take him elsewhere, in a different vehicle, since he is not quite getting it. Kapil Kumar handed Ryan over to these policemen. As he was being taken out of the bus, Ryan asked the two officials not to hit him, since he was cooperating with them. At that point, one of them slapped him hard on the face.
Ryan was pushed into a police car where the detainee he had been trying to record was sitting, along with three other police officials. These officials asked Ryan his name. When they heard it, they slapped him. They asked him his father’s name, and again slapped him upon hearing his answer. Again, they asked him to delete footage from his phone and hand it over. When he refused, a policeman prodded him in the stomach with the butt of his gun. At one point, a policeman pointed to a scar on his own hand and tried to insist to Ryan, “You have done this.”
Finally, the vehicle arrived at the G Block of Connaught Place, where police and paramilitary personnel were shoving more protesters into detention buses. The police threatened to put Ryan in a bus but finally let him go.
Ryan reached the emergency room at Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital at 7pm, with three colleagues from The Caravan. Upon reaching, he clearly told the RML staff that the police had beat him up while he was reporting on the protests and that he wanted a medico-legal certificate. He repeated the same to the police, as a part of the MLC proceedings. The doctors examined him and ordered some tests, including a CT scan. Once the tests were done, after more than three hours, Ryan was shown the MLC. Under the heading of “Gist of incident as stated by the injured/accompanying person,” there was a sub heading of “Alleged history.” The authorities had written “injury during protest on 11 oct 26 at 6.30pm cannaught place, c /o headache.” They did not mention that the police had caused the injury. When he, and our other staffers, insisted that this fact be mentioned in the MLC, the authorities refused and asked them to meet the medical superintendent the next day if they wished.
The Caravan reached out to Rajeev Ranjan, the Delhi Police public-relations officer, and Sachin Sharma, the deputy commissioner of police for the New Delhi district, but did not receive a response.

title: The ongoing fight for justice for Narendra Dabholkar
description: Hamid Dabholkar talks about the life and legacy of his father, the rationalist and activist Narendra Dabholkar, who was murdered thirteen years ago. Hamdi discusses developments of the ongoing legal battle and the larger struggle for rationalism that he and the Maharashtra Andhashraddha Nirmoolan Samiti, the organisation his father founded, continue to wage.
author: Shiv Inder Singh
content:
We’re glad this article found its way to you. If you’re not a subscriber, we’d love for you to consider subscribing—your support helps make this journalism possible. Either way, we hope you enjoy the read. Click to subscribe: subscribing
On 18 August 2026, the Bombay High Court stayed the life sentence given to Sachin Andure, who was convicted by a special court for the murder of Narendra Dabholkar, the rationalist, activist and founder of the Maharashtra Andhashraddha Nirmoolan Samiti. The bench granted him bail, citing “extremely weak” evidence and that Andure had a fair chance of acquittal in his pending appeal.
On the morning of 20 August 2013, 67-year-old Dabholkar was shot dead in Pune by two men. More than a decade later, on 10 May 2024, a special CBI court in Pune convicted Sharad Kalaskar and Andure of his murder and sentenced them to life imprisonment, while acquitting the alleged mastermind Virendrasinh Tawde, a lawyer named Sanjiv Punalekar, and his assistant, Vikram Bhave, of murder, criminal conspiracy, and other charges. The court also found the three accused not guilty under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act. The Dabholkar family filed an appeal in the high court challenging the acquittal of the three accused.
Andure and Kalaskar filed separate appeals challenging their convictions. Kalaskar was granted bail by the Bombay High Court in April. Dabholkar’s family and the MANS opposed the bail application in April.
In the years following Dabholkar’s murder, the thinker and writer Govind Pansare, the intellectual and activist MM Kalburgi, and the journalist Gauri Lankesh were killed in a similar fashion. Their murders were shown to be part of a conspiracy to suppress rational and progressive voices. The perpetrators of these murders were associated with the Hindu right-wing organisation Sanatan Sanstha, which consistently opposed Dabholkar’s rational views and called his campaign—which included enacting a law against superstitions in Maharashtra—anti-Hindu. Following Dabholkar’s death, the Maharashtra Legislative Assembly passed the Maharashtra Prevention and Eradication of Human Sacrifice and other Inhuman, Evil and Aghori Practices and Black Magic Act in 2013, which remains in effect today.

title: India–China relations are now shaped entirely on Beijing’s terms
description: Beijing views Modi’s India as a state that projects aggressive rhetoric on domestic television channels but lacks the material and military strength to back up its words.
author: Sushant Singh
content:
We’re glad this article found its way to you. If you’re not a subscriber, we’d love for you to consider subscribing—your support helps make this journalism possible. Either way, we hope you enjoy the read. Click to subscribe: subscribing
Salman Khan set out to star in a film about the Galwan clash, in June 2020, in which twenty Indian soldiers died confronting Chinese troops. Since then, the filmmakers have had to change its title, Battle of Galwan, to Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace. They had to reshoot forty percent of the film to erase direct references to China and scrub out the explicit Galwan context. The narrative has shifted from a nationalistic military showdown into a broader human drama about the cost of war. These changes followed a new directive from the defence ministry, which judged that, even though it had earlier approved the script, portraying China as an adversary was not the right call at present. Narendra Modi, in seeking an accommodation with Beijing, is also attempting to control how Indians remember their soldiers’ deaths.
The producers of The Lion of Galwan, a biopic tracking the bravery of the sepoy Gurtej Singh, who died in the Galwan clash, shelved the film after the government’s decree. Without an authentic depiction of the actual combat and geopolitical context, they felt, the film had lost its purpose. Compare this to Haqeeqat, Chetan Anand’s seminal 1964 film about the 1962 Sino-India war, made with extensive support from the defence ministry. Under Modi, India has now arrived at a moment when even naming the adversary in a recent military clash threatens political sensitivities and diplomatic interests.
Khan’s film teaser had sparked online criticism in China, with the Global Times claiming that it “distorted facts” and fueled anti-China sentiment. On Chinese social-media platforms such as Weibo, users accused Bollywood of rewriting history and violating historical facts. Indian official sources initially defended the film as artistic expression, but the Modi government soon stepped in, to protect ties with Beijing. Asked about the issue, the ministry of external affairs spokesperson said film-production regulation in India was “looked after by the relevant authorities”—meaning the ministries of information and broadcasting, and defence, respectively. The I&B ministry has now given a no-objection certificate to Khan’s film after the new narrative reportedly casts India–China relations in a more positive light.
The Modi government's interventions in film projects on Galwan were driven by the shift initiated by the October 2024 India–China border understanding—a direct diplomatic concession to Beijing. What India received in return is much less clear. Since that understanding, followed by a meeting between Modi and Xi at Kazan, the official ecosystem in India has engineered a systematic attempt to project a sense of normalcy in bilateral relations. Meetings between senior officials and ministers have resumed, diplomatic exchanges have gathered pace and official language has grown more reassuring, particularly from the Indian side. This narrative relies on deliberate evasion concerning the actual ground situation across eastern Ladakh.

title: 26/11 Mumbai Attacks: How 10 Terrorists Held the City Hostage For 60 Hours
description: From the firing at Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus to the sieges at the Taj, Oberoi and Nariman House, a timeline of the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks that killed 166 people.
author: Outlook News Desk
content:
- Ten Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorists launched coordinated attacks at multiple locations in Mumbai on November 26, 2008, killing 166 people.
- The 60-hour siege targeted the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, Oberoi-Trident, Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus and Nariman House, among other locations.
- The attacks ended on November 29 after security forces killed nine attackers and arrested Ajmal Amir Kasab, the only terrorist captured alive.
On November 26, 2008, ten armed terrorists from Pakistan-based Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) entered Mumbai by sea and launched coordinated attacks across the city, targeting crowded public places, two luxury hotels and a Jewish community centre. The attacks involved indiscriminate firing, grenade attacks and bomb blasts at 13 locations, leaving 166 people dead and 238 injured. Among those killed were 18 police officers and security personnel and 26 foreign nationals. Nine attackers were killed during the security operations, while the tenth, Ajmal Amir Kasab, was captured alive.
The attacks, which continued for nearly 60 hours, brought Mumbai to a standstill as police, the Army, Navy commandos and the National Security Guard (NSG) attempted to rescue hostages and neutralise the gunmen. The assault exposed major gaps in India's coastal and internal security arrangements and prompted changes to its counterterrorism infrastructure. Eighteen years later, here is a timeline of what happened during the November 26–29 attacks.
November 26, 2008: The attackers enter Mumbai
The ten terrorists travelled from Karachi, Pakistan, towards Mumbai by sea. According to then Union Home Minister P Chidambaram's statement in the Lok Sabha on December 11, 2008, they left Karachi on November 23 aboard a vessel named Al Hussaini. They subsequently hijacked an Indian fishing boat, the MV Kuber, killed its occupants and used it to approach the Mumbai coastline.
The attackers abandoned the fishing vessel a few miles from the city and transferred to inflatable dinghies. According to the Supreme Court's account, eight of the terrorists landed near Badhwar Park in Colaba between 8 pm and 8.30 pm on November 26. The remaining two continued towards Nariman Point by boat before making their way to the Oberoi-Trident Hotel. The attackers then split into groups and moved towards their designated targets.
The locations included Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus (CST), Leopold Café, the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, the Oberoi-Trident Hotel and Nariman House, a Jewish community centre in Colaba.
9.30 pm onwards: Attacks begin across Mumbai
The attacks began at approximately 9.15 pm, according to the Supreme Court judgment. One of the first locations targeted was Leopold Café, a popular restaurant frequented by tourists and locals. Two gunmen entered the establishment and opened fire, killing people and injuring several others. The Maharashtra High-Level Enquiry Committee recorded the attack at approximately 9.30 pm, while the first police control-room call about firing at the café came later.
The attackers also targeted the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, the Oberoi-Trident Hotel and CST within a short period. According to the Maharashtra High-Level Enquiry Committee's report, the Mumbai Police control room received its first call about injuries at Leopold Café at 9.48 pm. Reports of firing at the Taj, Oberoi and CST followed.
At CST, two attackers, Ajmal Kasab and Abu Ismail, opened fire on passengers in the crowded railway terminal. They fired indiscriminately and hurled grenades before leaving the station and moving towards Cama and Albless Hospital.
At Cama Hospital, Kasab and Ismail entered the premises and opened fire. They moved through the building as police personnel attempted to confront them. Additional Commissioner of Police Sadanand Date and other officers engaged the attackers, but the two terrorists managed to escape. They subsequently ambushed police personnel outside the hospital, killing several officers.
The attacks extended beyond the main target locations. Two taxis carrying explosives were blown up in separate explosions at Mazgaon, near Wadi Bunder, and Vile Parle. The Mazgaon blast killed three people and injured 19, while the Vile Parle explosion killed two people and injured three, according to the Supreme Court judgment.
Meanwhile, other attackers entered the Taj and Oberoi-Trident hotels, opening fire and taking people hostage. At Nariman House, the terrorists attacked the Jewish community centre, trapping residents and visitors inside.
Late November 26: Police officers ambushed
After leaving CST, Kasab and Abu Ismail moved towards Cama and Albless Hospital. During their movement through the city, they ambushed police officers, killing several personnel, including Maharashtra Anti-Terrorism Squad chief Hemant Karkare, Additional Commissioner of Police Ashok Kamte and encounter specialist Vijay Salaskar.
After the ambush, the two terrorists seized a police Qualis and escaped. They later abandoned the vehicle and forced their way into a white Skoda car at gunpoint, taking its occupants' vehicle before heading towards Girgaum Chowpatty.
Early November 27: Kasab is captured alive
At approximately 12.30 am on November 27, police intercepted Kasab and Abu Ismail at a barricade near Girgaum Chowpatty. According to the Supreme Court's account in the Kasab case, the two attackers were travelling in a Skoda car when they were stopped.
Abu Ismail was killed in the ensuing exchange of fire, while Kasab was captured alive. Assistant Sub-Inspector Tukaram Ombale was fatally injured while attempting to overpower Kasab and disarm him.
Kasab's arrest provided investigators with a surviving attacker who could be questioned about the planning and execution of the assault.
November 27, 2008: Security forces launch rescue operations
As the scale of the attacks became clear, Mumbai Police, the Army and the Navy's Marine Commandos (MARCOS) were deployed across the affected locations.
The NSG, India's elite counterterrorism force, was mobilised from its base in Manesar, Haryana. According to Chidambaram's parliamentary statement, the government alerted the force at approximately 11.30 pm on November 26, and around 200 personnel were airlifted to Mumbai that night. They were deployed at the affected locations in the early hours of November 27.
The NSG divided its teams to tackle the hostage situations at the Taj, Oberoi-Trident and Nariman House simultaneously. The operation was named Operation Black Tornado.
Gun battles continued inside the buildings as commandos attempted to rescue hostages and clear the premises. Hundreds of people were eventually rescued from the affected locations.
November 28, 2008: Operations at Oberoi and Nariman House end
On November 28, NSG commandos completed their operation at the Oberoi-Trident hotel, killing the two terrorists inside and rescuing those trapped there.
At Nariman House, commandos carried out an operation involving a helicopter-assisted entry onto the building's terrace. The two terrorists inside were eventually killed. Rabbi Gavriel Holtzberg, his wife Rivka Holtzberg and four guests who had been staying with them were killed during the siege. NSG commando Havildar Gajender Singh was also killed during the operation.
The siege at the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, however, continued.
During the operation at the Taj, NSG commando Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan was killed while leading a team attempting to rescue hostages trapped inside the hotel. He was posthumously awarded the Ashoka Chakra for his actions.
November 29, 2008: Taj operation brings attacks to an end
The final phase of the operation took place at the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, where the remaining terrorists were still fighting security personnel.
NSG commandos continued their search and clearance operation, moving through the hotel as gunfire and explosions were reported. The Supreme Court judgment in the Kasab case records that the last attacker was killed at approximately 9 am on November 29, bringing the three-day assault to an end.
By the time the operations ended, 166 people had been killed and 238 injured. Nine of the ten attackers had been killed, including Abu Ismail, who was shot dead by police at Girgaum Chowpatty. The remaining eight were killed during the security operations at the three principal hostage locations. Kasab was the only attacker captured alive.
What happened after the 26/11 attacks?
Kasab was tried in India and convicted for his role in the attacks. The Supreme Court upheld his death sentence, and he was hanged at Yerawada Central Jail in Pune on November 21, 2012.
The attacks prompted a major overhaul of India's security arrangements. The National Investigation Agency Act was enacted on December 31, 2008, leading to the establishment of the NIA as a central agency to investigate and prosecute terrorism-related offences.
The government also reviewed coastal security, expanded the deployment of coastal police stations and interceptor boats, and introduced measures to strengthen maritime surveillance and intelligence coordination. The government also established four NSG regional hubs in Mumbai, Chennai, Hyderabad and Kolkata, which became operational on June 30 and July 1, 2009, to improve the force's response time during emergencies.
The 26/11 attacks exposed major gaps in India's coastal surveillance, intelligence coordination and counterterrorism response. The subsequent establishment of the NIA, four NSG regional hubs and expanded coastal security infrastructure reshaped the country's approach to preventing and responding to terrorist attacks.

title: 18 Years After 26/11, Hafiz Saeed And Five Others Yet To Face Trial In India
description: The 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks trial against Zabiuddin Ansari alias Abu Jundal continues, while proclamation orders against six absconding accused, including Hafiz Saeed and Zaki-ur-Rehman Lakhvi, remain unserved.
author: Outlook News Desk
content:
- The 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks trial against Zabiuddin Ansari alias Abu Jundal is continuing in Mumbai
- Proclamation orders issued in July against six absconding accused remain unserved
- The accused include Hafiz Saeed, Zaki-ur-Rehman Lakhvi, Sajid Mir, Abu Alqama, Asim alias Abu Qahafa and Major Abdur Rehman Pasha
Eighteen years after the November 26, 2008, Mumbai terror attacks killed 166 people and left the city scarred, the pursuit of justice for several alleged perpetrators remains unfinished. While the trial against Zabiuddin Ansari alias Abu Jundal is underway, proclamation orders against six other accused, including Lashkar-e-Taiba chief Hafiz Saeed and commander Zaki-ur-Rehman Lakhvi, are yet to be served, months after a special court issued them in July this year.
The court is now hearing Jundal's case. In August and September, the prosecution told the court it had sought the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)'s help to serve the orders on the six absconding accused in the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks case.
Prosecution Response
Special Public Prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam said there has been no development in the execution of the proclamation orders against the wanted accused. He said the prosecution will ensure that they are punished on Indian soil.
"The prosecution will ensure that all those persons who facilitated the dastardly attacks would be punished on Indian soil," Nikam told PTI.
Nikam said non-bailable warrants and Interpol Red Corner notices had been issued through diplomatic channels against the absconding accused, whom he described as the main perpetrators and conspirators behind the attacks. "But I am sure that the Pakistan government will not respond as that country continues to be a haven for terrorists," Nikam said.
In August and September, the prosecution also told the court that it had asked the MHA to take the necessary steps, through Interpol, to serve the proclamation orders on the accused, who are believed to be in Pakistan. Nikam then told the court that, while procedural compliance was under way, the trial against the absconding accused would begin because Section 356 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023 permits criminal trials in absentia for absconding proclaimed offenders even when arrest does not appear imminent.
Absconding Accused Named
The absconding accused include Hafiz Saeed and Zaki-ur-Rehman Lakhvi, both identified in the case as Lashkar operatives. The other four are Sajid Mir, Abu Alqama, Asim alias Abu Qahafa and Major Abdur Rehman Pasha.
Their alleged roles in the attack were brought out by Ajmal Kasab and accused-turned-approver David Headley, PTI reported.
Jundal Trial Background
The proceedings against Jundal had stayed on hold since 2018 after a petition by government authorities over the handing over of certain documents to the accused. The trial restarted in November last year after clearance from the Bombay High Court.
Investigators said Jundal planned the attacks and trained the 10 Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorists who struck Mumbai on November 26, 2008, teaching them Hindi and key details of Mumbai's topography so they could blend in. Investigators also alleged Jundal played a key role as a handler of the terrorists.
Attack And Aftermath
The attacks claimed 166 lives, including six Americans and other foreigners. Ten heavily armed Pakistani terrorists entered the financial capital via the Arabian Sea on the night of November 26, 2008, and carried out a siege that lasted more than 60 hours at iconic and vital locations across the city.
Ajmal Kasab was the sole terrorist captured alive. A special court convicted him and sentenced him to death in 2010, and he was hanged at Pune's Yerwada Jail in November 2012.
Eighteen years on, the question of whether those accused of orchestrating the attacks will ever face trial on Indian soil remains unanswered.

title: Delhi AQI Stays 'Poor' At 220 As GRAP Stage II Continues Across NCR
description: Delhi’s air quality stayed poor at AQI 220 on Thursday morning, with three locations in the very poor band and GRAP Stage II continuing across Delhi-NCR to curb further pollution.
author: Outlook News Desk
content:
- Delhi’s citywide AQI stood at 220 at 7 am on Thursday, slightly below Wednesday’s 228
- Three locations in the capital slipped into the very poor category, with Anand Vihar at 327, DTU at 308 and North Campus at 302
- Sirsa in Haryana recorded the highest AQI in the country at 368, while several NCR cities also remained in the poor range
Delhi remained in the poor band on Thursday morning. The citywide AQI stood at 220, according to CPCB data, a touch lower than Wednesday’s 228.
Conditions stayed elevated across Delhi. Three locations slipped into the very poor band, while Sirsa in Haryana logged the country’s highest city-level AQI at 368, placing it in the very poor category, the CPCB data showed.
The wider NCR picture was also uneven. Several cities remained in the poor range on the CPCB scale, while Stage II of GRAP stayed in force across Delhi-NCR to prevent any further deterioration in air quality.
Delhi Monitoring Readings
Most stations stayed above 200.
Of the 59 monitoring stations in the capital, 56 had valid readings. Thirty-seven stations recorded AQI above 200, while three crossed 300 and entered the very poor category. PM2.5 was the main pollutant in Delhi’s average reading.
Anand Vihar had the city’s highest AQI at 327. Delhi Technological University (DTU) was next at 308 and North Campus, Delhi University, at 302. Pusa recorded 298, while ITO reported 296 and Burari Crossing 289.
A few sites fared better. Sri Aurobindo Marg posted the lowest AQI at 139, with Jharoda Kalan at 146 and Pusa (DPCC) at 147. IMD Lodhi Road stood at 148 and Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium at 153, all in the moderate band.
NCR Cities Report
The regional spread varied widely.
Meerut in Uttar Pradesh recorded the highest AQI in the NCR at 276. Ghaziabad and Greater Noida followed at 264 each. Panchgaon in Haryana reported 261, while Bhiwadi in Rajasthan recorded 246.
Dharuhera in Haryana reported 238. Manesar in Haryana and Gurugram both recorded 233. Noida stood at 228, just above Delhi’s 226.
Bahadurgarh reported 217 and Rohtak 211. Baghpat recorded 193, Bharatpur 192 and Sonipat 184. Faridabad reported 172, while Hapur stood at 162.
A few cities were markedly lower. Palwal recorded the lowest AQI in the region at 87, followed by Alwar at 112 and Panipat at 142.
National Extremes And Rules
Sirsa topped the national chart.
Sirsa in Haryana topped the list. In the CPCB’s 7 am data, it was the highest among 286 cities with valid readings, at 368 and in the very poor category. Anpara in Uttar Pradesh came next at 307, followed by Darbhanga in Bihar at 290.
Ballabgarh in Haryana recorded 289 and Gajraula in Uttar Pradesh 287. Sri Ganganagar in Rajasthan and Meerut in Uttar Pradesh both reported 276. Kaithal in Haryana recorded 273.
At the other end, Chikkaballapur in Karnataka recorded the lowest AQI at 19. Cuddalore in Tamil Nadu recorded 25 and Ramanagara in Karnataka 26. Gangtok in Sikkim reported 27, while Eloor in Kerala and Madikeri in Karnataka recorded 30 each.
Under the CPCB’s National Air Quality Index classification, readings between 0 and 50 are good, 51 and 100 satisfactory, 101 and 200 moderate, 201 and 300 poor, 301 and 400 very poor and 401 and 500 severe.
GRAP Stage II
Restrictions remain in place.
Stage II of the Graded Response Action Plan is still active across Delhi-NCR, the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) said. The steps cover more mechanised road sweeping, dust control and water sprinkling.
The response also includes stricter enforcement of dust-control norms at construction sites. The CAQM further informed that the steps are meant to encourage the use of public transport.
The CAQM dashboard lists Stage II as active, with the order effective from November 2. The measures are intended to prevent further deterioration in air quality across the region.
Secondary organic aerosols contributed 20.1 per cent, while secondary inorganic pollutants accounted for 15.8 per cent. Within the latter category, nitrates contributed 6.9 per cent, ammonia 5 per cent and sulphates 3.9 per cent.
Waste burning, including municipal, plastic, rubber-containing and e-waste burning, contributed 7.2 per cent, followed by firecrackers at 4.7 per cent, mixed combustion at 3.8 per cent, industrial emissions at 2.9 per cent and mineral dust and ash at 1.9 per cent.
The India Meteorological Department's Air Quality Early Warning System has forecast that Delhi's air quality is likely to remain in the 'poor' category from November 25 to 27 before deteriorating to the 'very poor' category on November 28 according to PTI.

title: 26/11 Anniversary: India Remembers 2008 Mumbai Attack Victims
description: For survivors and eyewitnesses, the psychological impact of the three-day siege remains deeply painful even after nearly two decades
author: Our Correspondent
content:
26/11 Anniversary: India Remembers 2008 Mumbai Attack Victims
For survivors and eyewitnesses, the psychological impact of the three-day siege remains deeply painful even after nearly two decades
Mumbai: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis is set to attend a ceremonial parade at the Mumbai Police Commissioner's office on Thursday to pay tribute to the security personnel and civilians killed in the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks. The event marks 18 years since the siege that claimed 166 lives.
On the anniversary of 26/11, Senior Advocate and Rajya Sabha MP Ujjwal Nikam noted that while India delivered a decisive judicial response, critical questions about the larger conspiracy behind the attacks remain unanswered.
"Nearly 18 years have passed, but we have still not been able to forget that day. A question continues to remain in the mind of every Indian: Who were those 10 terrorists? Why did they attack Mumbai? What did they want, and what were they trying to achieve? We gave them only one answer: we will respond to terrorism in such a way that no one dares to carry out another terror attack in our country," Nikam told ANI.
He expressed satisfaction over the execution of Mohammad Ajmal Amir Kasab but questioned whether those who planned and conspired to carry out the attacks had been brought to justice.
"I am happy that we hanged Mohammad Ajmal Amir Kasab. But another question remains: Have we been able to reach those who conspired to plan the attack? Have we been able to deliver justice to the 166 victims? If not, why?" he added.
The scars left by the tragic event continue to haunt survivors and the families who lost their loved ones. Bullet marks at Leopold Cafe and Nariman House, along with the bust of Assistant Sub-Inspector Tukaram Omble, who sacrificed his life while capturing Kasab, continue to serve as reminders of the gruesome attack.
For survivors and eyewitnesses, the psychological impact of the three-day siege remains deeply painful even after nearly two decades.
Mohammad Taufiq Shaikh, an eyewitness popularly known as 'Chhotu Chaiwala', whose alertness helped save lives at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), said memories of that night continue to haunt him and affect his sleep.
Recalling the horrific incident, Shaikh said he initially mistook the sound of gunfire for firecrackers, as an India-England cricket match was underway.
He recalled that after noticing people running in panic, he raised an alarm, locked a gate and alerted officials. However, a gunman soon entered and fired three bullets, one of which hit a table while another shattered glass.
Shaikh said he even called his family during the attack, fearing he would not survive.
Meanwhile, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar paid tribute to those who lost their lives in the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks and reiterated India's commitment to fighting terrorism.
"Remember innocent lives lost & salute the brave security personnel who made the supreme sacrifice during the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks. Committed to combating terrorism in all its forms & manifestations and bringing those involved to justice. Zero tolerance for terrorism," Jaishankar wrote on X.
This year marks 18 years since terrorists belonging to the Pakistan-backed Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) unleashed coordinated attacks across Mumbai, India's financial capital.
Commonly known as 26/11, the attacks were carried out by 10 terrorists who entered Mumbai by sea on the night of November 26, 2008. Over the course of four days, they killed 166 people and injured around 300 others.
The terrorists targeted several prominent locations, including the Taj and Oberoi hotels, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Nariman House, Cama Hospital, Metro Cinema and Leopold Cafe. These locations were reportedly selected to maximise the impact of the attacks, particularly on foreign nationals and Mumbai's workforce.
Nine terrorists were killed during the operation, while Kasab was captured alive.
In May 2010, Kasab was sentenced to death. He was subsequently hanged at a maximum-security prison in Pune in November 2012.

title: Saudi Arabia Downs Houthi Missiles and Drones Targeting Riyadh
description: Residents in northern and eastern Riyadh confirmed hearing the blast, with one saying their house windows "shook violently"
author: Our Correspondent
content:
Saudi Arabia Downs Houthi Missiles and Drones Targeting Riyadh
Residents in northern and eastern Riyadh confirmed hearing the blast, with one saying their house windows "shook violently"
RIYADH: Explosions echoed above Riyadh as Saudi armed forces reported on Thursday downing missiles and drones launched by Yemen's Houthis, just a day after the Iran-backed group claimed strikes on the capital.
	   Months into Saudi Arabia's renewed war with the Houthis, the kingdom has struggled to shield even its most sensitive infrastructure from attacks, with the fighters striking strategic facilities across the nation and prominent skyscrapers in the heart of Riyadh.
	   An explosion was heard around midnight (2100 GMT) in Saudi capital Riyadh, according to an AFP journalist and residents, after authorities issued an alert warning of a "hostile aerial threat", which was lifted shortly after.
	   Residents in northern and eastern Riyadh confirmed hearing the blast, with one saying their house windows "shook violently".
	   Saudi forces said air defences destroyed two ballistic missiles launched toward the capital by the Houthis, as well as a cruise missile in the western part of the country and a drone near Jeddah's port.
	   Turki al-Malki, the spokesman for the Saudi-led military coalition battling the Houthis, said no civilian injuries resulted from the debris of the intercepted drone.
	   The Houthis said Wednesday they had targeted the Saudi ports of Jeddah and Jazan in response to Saudi strikes on a Yemeni port controlled by the Iran-backed group.
	   The fighters had also claimed responsibility for attacks a day earlier on the Saudi capital that struck the tallest tower in its financial district, wounding 11.
	   In recent weeks the group has launched a barrage at Saudi targets including the financial district, airports, energy infrastructure and military sites.
	   The Saudi coalition has in turn been striking Houthi-held areas of Yemen in support of the internationally recognised government, which has been battling the Houthis for territory since a civil war reignited in July.
	   - Port strikes -
	   "We targeted operational capabilities at the port of Hodeida," the coalition posted to X on Wednesday, having earlier warned civilians to evacuate.
	   Hodeida is under Houthi control and is a key entry point for goods into Yemeni territory held by the group.
	   Houthi media outlet Almasirah confirmed on Wednesday morning Hodeida had been targeted and also reported new strikes later in the day, but did not provide details. No casualties or injuries were mentioned.
	   Almasirah added that Saudi forces had also attacked the area's international airport.
	   Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree early on Wednesday threatened to retaliate against Red Sea ports in Saudi Arabia if the coalition went ahead with strikes on Hodeida.
	   "The port of Jeddah, along with all other Saudi enemy ports along the Red Sea coast, will become targets for our forces should the enemy carry out its threats," he posted on Telegram.
	   - Symbolic target -
	   On the ground in Yemen, the Houthis were pressing their advance against government forces, forcing them to retreat. Houthi fighters are positioned just 60 kilometres (37 miles) from Aden, the government's main stronghold in the south.
	   A Yemeni military spokesman said this week that they were preparing Aden's defences for a potential attack.
	   On Wednesday, the Houthis claimed responsibility for the strike a day earlier on the Saudi capital's tallest skyscraper, also saying they struck the sprawling Ras Tanura refinery in the kingdom's oil-rich east.
	   On the Riyadh attack, Houthi spokesman Saree said it had been carried out in three phases, with the strikes hitting their targets "accurately". 
	   The assault on the capital struck its PIF tower, which houses the Saudi sovereign wealth fund. The building had already been targeted last Thursday and is one of several high-profile sites hit since fighting resumed in the summer.
	   Attacks on the PIF building are symbolic as the fund is driving efforts to diversify the oil-reliant Saudi economy -- a project that has been complicated by the Middle East war and Houthi strikes.
	   Qatar and Pakistan, who have been acting as mediators in efforts to end the wider regional war between Iran and the United States, both "strongly" condemned the attack on the building. 
( Source : AFP )

title: Book Review | Sonia Says It All Without Drama
description: She recalls, “Those gruesome sights are still vivid in my mind. On our flight home I could no longer hold back and wept with my face turned towards the window. My mind was racing: Had my own grief and trauma in 1984 overshadowed my mind when the very same brutalities had been visited upon Sikhs in Delhi?” Of course, the unrelenting hate brigade will dismiss this as an afterthought, a rationalisation. But she has stated her truth, leave it or take it
author: Parsa Venkateshwar Rao Jr
content:
Book Review | Sonia Says It All Without Drama
She recalls, “Those gruesome sights are still vivid in my mind. On our flight home I could no longer hold back and wept with my face turned towards the window. My mind was racing: Had my own grief and trauma in 1984 overshadowed my mind when the very same brutalities had been visited upon Sikhs in Delhi?” Of course, the unrelenting hate brigade will dismiss this as an afterthought, a rationalisation. But she has stated her truth, leave it or take it
Political journalists have been disappointed with the memoir of Sonia Gandhi. She did not reveal the secrets, some said. She failed to own up responsibility for the Sikh massacre in the wake of Indira Gandhi’s assassination was the outraged complaint of others. After reading the book, it becomes clear that there is enough and more about politics spread through the book, and she reveals them in the understated way that many have noticed but did not point to the evidence of in it. And there are the very personal observations, with their unmistakable political tones. And she remains factual throughout, on all the issues.
About the massacre of Sikhs, she writes: “The horror of those events, the violence and cruelty unleashed on those men, women, and children first came to me from accounts of friends who had given shelter to fleeing Sikhs, and from many Sikhs who had found refuge in our home… In my state of disorientation in those days, I had become empty of tears, benumbed by the experience of violence that had uprooted me. It was only some years later that I was able to process the enormity and horror of those events.” And that moment came in 1989 when she accompanied Rajiv Gandhi to Bhagalpur in the wake of the communal riot there, and saw the victims at the hospital. She recalls, “Those gruesome sights are still vivid in my mind. On our flight home I could no longer hold back and wept with my face turned towards the window. My mind was racing: Had my own grief and trauma in 1984 overshadowed my mind when the very same brutalities had been visited upon Sikhs in Delhi?” Of course, the unrelenting hate brigade will dismiss this as an afterthought, a rationalisation. But she has stated her truth, leave it or take it.
There was the vile campaign that in 2004, then President A.P.J. Abdul Kalam refused to swear her in as Prime Minister citing that there is no treaty between India and Italy which would have enabled a naturalised Indian in Italy to become the Prime Minister in Rome. Here, too, Sonia reveals the fact that in the first meeting with Kalam, with Manmohan Singh, he demanded the signatures of all the parties. And she cites his own autobiography where he said that he would have had no choice but to swear her in as Prime Minister. Sonia goes to admit frankly for the first time that she was torn between accepting the Prime Minister’s post and rejecting it. Her children, Rahul and Priyanka, were fiercely opposed to it because their grandmother and father were killed because they were Prime Ministers. Sonia does not take shelter behind the children’s opposition. She weighs in the other fact staring her in the face: “The BJP and its allies would for certain use my ‘foreign origin’ as an issue; they would stir up emotions and create havoc that would subsume every other good — of the past, and of the coming years.”
Belonging: A Journey of Love
By Sonia Gandhi
HarperCollins
pp. 526; Rs 1,299

title: Adilabad Honour Killing: Father Kills Daughter Over Love Affair
description: On November 23, Kailash questioned his daughter about why she was upset. During the conversation, Kalyani revealed her relationship with her cousin.
author: DC Correspondent
content:
Adilabad Honour Killing: Father Kills Daughter Over Love Affair
On November 23, Kailash questioned his daughter about why she was upset. During the conversation, Kalyani revealed her relationship with her cousin.
Adilabad: A man killed his 18-year-old daughter after she revealed that she was in love with her cousin, the son of her uncle. The incident took place in Umri village of Narnoor mandal in Adilabad district on Wednesday.
The deceased was identified as Kalyani (18). Her parents, Kailash and Sumitra, had fixed her engagement with another person.
On November 23, Kailash questioned his daughter about why she was upset. During the conversation, Kalyani revealed her relationship with her cousin.
Angered by her revelation, Kailash allegedly killed her while she was sleeping on November 24. He later hanged her body in another room to make it appear as a suicide.
Kalyani's mother, Sumitra, found her daughter hanging and raised an alarm. Hearing her cries, local residents rushed to the house.
According to reports, Kalyani's last rites were performed within three hours of the incident. Locals later informed the police, who reached the village and began an investigation.
During questioning, Kailash confessed to killing his daughter.

title: Modi: Opposition Wants to Cut OBC Quota, Give Reservation to Muslims
description: The prime minister said a legislation aimed at giving women adequate representation in legislative bodies was disallowed from being passed by one opposition party
author: PTI
content:
Modi: Opposition Wants to Cut OBC Quota, Give Reservation to Muslims
The prime minister said a legislation aimed at giving women adequate representation in legislative bodies was disallowed from being passed by one opposition party
New Delhi: Prime Minister Narendra Modi asserted that no force can stop the delivery of justice to women and blamed "one opposition party" for the defeat in Parliament of a delimitation-linked Constitution amendment bill, giving 33 per cent reservation to women.In a signed article that appeared in major newspapers on Thursday, Modi, without naming the Congress, also claimed that the biggest party in the opposition wants to reduce OBC reservation and bring Muslim reservations.
"The journey of our Constitution would be incomplete without recognising the remarkable women who helped shape it. But what happened earlier this year should fill our hearts with shame," he said.
The prime minister said a legislation aimed at giving women adequate representation in legislative bodies was disallowed from being passed by one opposition party, once again showing its "disdain for constitutional values".
"I assure the 'Nari Shakti' of India that no force can prevent us from ensuring that justice is done to them," he said.
Modi said Indian constitutional democracy has a clearly defined role for the opposition.
"Sadly, the leading opposition party seems to have become more of an 'Avrodh Paksh' (obstructionist) than a 'Virodh Paksh' (opposition)," he said.
The prime minister said the opposition should know that disrupting democratic processes is no substitute for discharging constitutional responsibilities.
The Constitution Amendment Bill sought to expand the Lok Sabha's strength from the existing 543 seats to a maximum of 850 through delimitation, paving the way for the implementation of 33 per cent reservation for women in Parliament and state legislatures ahead of the 2029 general elections.
The bill required a two-thirds majority in the Lok Sabha to pass. Due to the lack of numbers, the proposed legislation was defeated in April.
It is to be seen whether the government reintroduces the bill in the forthcoming session of Parliament.
In the article, the prime minister said that for decades, in several parts of India, particularly in tribal areas, Naxalites used the might of the gun to deny the poorest people the rights guaranteed to them by the Constitution.
Modi said the "successful elimination of Naxalism" this year is particularly heartwarming because, according to him, it has ensured that the poorest of the poor can finally exercise their constitutional rights without fear.
"Now, we are left only with 'Dimagi Naxals', far removed from the realities of our times but persistent in their efforts to derail our growth trajectory," he said.
The prime minister also said that it is "most appalling" that the biggest party in the opposition "wants to reduce OBC reservation and bring Muslim reservations", something the makers of the Constitution, notably Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar, were totally against. 
( Source : PTI )

title: Hyderabad Wedding Trip Ends in Tragedy, Four Killed in Anantapur
description: Police identified two of the deceased as Siddu and Lakshmi Prasad, both residents of Yadiki. The identities of the remaining two victims are yet to be established.
author: DC Correspondent
content:
Hyderabad Wedding Trip Ends in Tragedy, Four Killed in Anantapur
Police identified two of the deceased as Siddu and Lakshmi Prasad, both residents of Yadiki. The identities of the remaining two victims are yet to be established.
Anantapur: Four people were killed and eight others seriously injured after the vehicle in which they were travelling collided with a lorry near Rayalacheruvu in Yadiki mandal of Anantapur district in the early hours of Thursday.
The accident occurred when the passengers were returning to Tadipatri after attending a wedding in Hyderabad. The vehicle was travelling from Hyderabad towards Tadipatri when a lorry coming from the opposite direction rammed into it. The impact was so severe that the vehicle was completely mangled.
On receiving information, local residents and police rushed to the spot and launched rescue operations. The injured were shifted to a nearby hospital for treatment. The bodies of the deceased were extricated from the mangled vehicle and shifted to a hospital for postmortem examination.
Police identified two of the deceased as Siddu and Lakshmi Prasad, both residents of Yadiki. The identities of the remaining two victims are yet to be established.

UP Election 2027 LIVE: संविधान दिवस पर ओपी राजभर का अखिलेश यादव पर हमला, बोले- चुनाव से पहले ही खुद को खुदा समझने लगे सपाई
संविधान दिवस के मौके पर उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार के मंत्री और सुहेलदेव भारतीय समाज पार्टी (सुभासपा) के अध्यक्ष ओम प्रकाश राजभर ने समाजवादी पार्टी और अखिलेश यादव पर तीखा हमला बोला. उन्होंने कहा कि दो साल से संविधान की दुहाई देने वाले अखिलेश यादव बताएं कि क्या संविधान किसी को पटककर मारने का अधिकार देता है? क्या संविधान ने सपाइयों को किसी को पीटने का विशेष अधिकार दिया है? राजभर ने आरोप लगाया कि चुनाव से पहले ही सपा कार्यकर्ता खुद को खुदा समझने लगे हैं. उन्होंने कहा कि अखिलेश यादव ने एक ऐसे व्यक्ति को विधायकी का टिकट दिया है, जो मीडिया में खुलेआम पटककर मारने की धमकी दे रहा है. प्रतापगढ़ में भी सपाइयों पर कुर्मियों के साथ मारपीट और खुलेआम फायरिंग करने का आरोप लगाया. राजभर ने कहा कि अभी चुनाव आया भी नहीं है और सपाइयों की कथित गुंडागर्दी का यह हाल है. अगर गलती से सपा की सरकार बन गई तो गुंडागर्दी की हद पार हो जाएगी. उन्होंने आरोप लगाया कि सपा सरकार में गैर-यादव पिछड़ों और दलितों पर सबसे ज्यादा अत्याचार होते हैं.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: चिराग पासवान का कांग्रेस पर तंज, बोले- अपमानित होने के बावजूद गठबंधन में साथ रहना कांग्रेस की मजबूरी
उत्तर प्रदेश में कांग्रेस और समाजवादी पार्टी के बीच सीट बंटवारे को लेकर बातचीत के बीच केंद्रीय मंत्री और लोक जनशक्ति पार्टी (रामविलास) के प्रमुख चिराग पासवान ने कांग्रेस पर निशाना साधा है. उन्होंने कहा कि अगर गठबंधन में धर्म और गरिमा का पालन नहीं हो रहा है तो ऐसे गठबंधन का क्या मतलब है? कांग्रेस अगर अपमान का घूंट पीने के बावजूद सपा के साथ बनी हुई है तो इससे पता चलता है कि उसके पास अपनी कोई राजनीतिक जमीन नहीं बची है. उसके पास कोई दूसरा विकल्प नहीं है. एआईएमआईएम और आजाद समाज पार्टी के गठबंधन पर चिराग ने कहा कि तीसरे मोर्चे हमेशा कोशिश करते हैं, लेकिन सफल नहीं हो पाते. हालांकि, वे किसी न किसी गठबंधन को नुकसान पहुंचाने में जरूर कामयाब होते हैं. यूपी में अपनी पार्टी के गठबंधन की संभावनाओं पर उन्होंने कहा कि फिलहाल सभी 403 विधानसभा सीटों पर संगठन मजबूत करने की तैयारी चल रही है. गठबंधन को लेकर फैसला उचित समय पर लिया जाएगा.
UP Chunav & Samvidhan Divas Update: संविधान गौरव दिवस मनाएगी बीजेपी, सीएम योगी और ज्योतिरादित्य सिंधिया होंगे शामिल
भारतीय जनता पार्टी आज संविधान गौरव दिवस मनाएगी. इस मौके पर मुख्यमंत्री योगी आदित्यनाथ और केंद्रीय मंत्री ज्योतिरादित्य सिंधिया कार्यक्रम में शामिल होंगे. सुबह 10 बजे लोकभवन सभागार में आयोजित कार्यक्रम में मुख्यमंत्री योगी संविधान की उद्देशिका का पाठ करेंगे. इसके साथ ही डॉ. बीआर आंबेडकर मूर्ति विकास योजना के तहत सौंदर्यीकरण कार्यों का शुभारंभ भी करेंगे. विधानसभा चुनाव से पहले बीजेपी संगठन और सामाजिक स्तर पर अपनी पकड़ मजबूत करने में जुटी है. इसी क्रम में पार्टी के सभी लोकसभा और राज्यसभा सांसदों को मैदान में उतारा जाएगा. 29 नवंबर तक प्रत्येक सांसद एक शैक्षणिक संस्थान में संगोष्ठी आयोजित करेगा. इसके जरिए संविधान और सामाजिक मुद्दों पर संवाद किया जाएगा.
यूपी इलेक्शन 2027 लाइव: केसी त्यागी ने भी सपा-कांग्रेस गठबंधन पर उठाए सवाल
राष्ट्रीय लोक दल (आरएलडी) के नेता केसी त्यागी ने उत्तर प्रदेश में समाजवादी पार्टी और कांग्रेस के बीच सीट बंटवारे को लेकर चल रही खींचतान पर निशाना साधा है. उन्होंने कहा कि दोनों दल चुनाव नहीं, बल्कि अपने राजनीतिक भविष्य की लड़ाई लड़ रहे हैं. त्यागी के मुताबिक, कांग्रेस को लगता है कि वह सपा के बिना भी मजबूत रह सकती है. उन्होंने कहा कि यह चुनावी गठबंधन नहीं, बल्कि दोनों दलों के भविष्य को लेकर चल रही लड़ाई है.
UP Election 2027 LIVE: अखिलेश के 'सीट नहीं, जीत जरूरी' वाले बयान पर पंकज चौधरी का तंज
उत्तर प्रदेश बीजेपी अध्यक्ष पंकज चौधरी ने सपा-कांग्रेस गठबंधन को लेकर अखिलेश यादव के बयान पर निशाना साधा है. अखिलेश ने कहा था कि गठबंधन में सीटों की संख्या नहीं, बल्कि जीत महत्वपूर्ण है. इस पर पंकज चौधरी ने कहा कि उन्हें नहीं पता कि अखिलेश यह बात कांग्रेस को समझाना चाहते हैं या आम जनता को. उन्होंने कहा कि अखिलेश के ट्वीट के अंदाज से ही गठबंधन की स्थिति का अंदाजा लगाया जा सकता है.
यूपी चुनाव 2027 लाइव: भाजपा की दो दिवसीय सामाजिक संपर्क बैठक आज भी होगी आयोजित
भारतीय जनता पार्टी की ओर से आयोजित दो दिवसीय सामाजिक संपर्क बैठक के तहत आज भी विभिन्न कार्यक्रम होंगे. बैठक में ‘अनेक समाज, एक परिवार’ की भावना के साथ विभिन्न सामाजिक वर्गों के बीच संवाद पर जोर दिया जा रहा है. इसके जरिए सामाजिक समरसता को मजबूत करने और समाज के अलग-अलग वर्गों के साथ बेहतर संपर्क स्थापित करने की रणनीति पर चर्चा की जाएगी. साथ ही संगठन की मजबूती और सामाजिक सहभागिता बढ़ाने पर भी विशेष ध्यान दिया जाएगा.
UP Vidhan Sabha Chunav 2027 LIVE: सपा को नए वादों से पहले 2012 से 2017 के कामों का हिसाब देना चाहिए, बोले राकेश त्रिपाठी
समाजवादी पार्टी के 2027 विधानसभा चुनाव के घोषणापत्र को लेकर भाजपा ने निशाना साधा है. भाजपा प्रवक्ता राकेश त्रिपाठी ने कहा कि सपा को नए लोकलुभावन वादे करने के बजाय पहले 2012 से 2017 के बीच अपनी सरकार के कामकाज का हिसाब देना चाहिए. उन्होंने आरोप लगाया कि अखिलेश यादव के शासनकाल में बेरोजगारी भत्ता तो बांटा जाता था, लेकिन युवाओं के लिए रोजगार के पर्याप्त अवसर नहीं थे. उस समय प्रदेश में बेरोजगारी दर 17 फीसदी से अधिक थी. त्रिपाठी ने दावा किया कि योगी आदित्यनाथ सरकार में बेरोजगारी दर चार फीसदी से नीचे आई है और लोगों को रोजगार मिला है. उन्होंने कहा कि सपा के पास न कोई संकल्प है और न ही वह उत्तर प्रदेश का विकल्प है.
UP Chunav 2027 LIVE: सपा के घोषणापत्र में महिला सम्मान निधि और किसानों के भुगतान पर रहेगा जोर: आजम खान
समाजवादी पार्टी 2027 के विधानसभा चुनाव के लिए अपने घोषणापत्र में युवाओं, किसानों, महिलाओं, गरीबों और पीड़ित वर्गों को राहत देने वाले मुद्दों को शामिल करेगी. सपा प्रवक्ता आजम खान ने कहा कि घोषणापत्र में महिला सम्मान निधि, आउटसोर्सिंग नौकरियों में आरक्षण की हकमारी रोकने और गन्ना किसानों का जल्द भुगतान सुनिश्चित करने जैसे मुद्दे प्रमुख होंगे. उन्होंने कहा कि प्रदेश के युवा, किसान और आम जनता कई समस्याओं से परेशान हैं. घोषणापत्र के जरिए इन समस्याओं का समाधान पेश करने की कोशिश होगी. आजम खान के मुताबिक, पार्टी के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष अखिलेश यादव पीडीए के सामाजिक न्याय की स्थापना से जुड़े मुद्दों पर भी घोषणाएं करेंगे. यह घोषणापत्र प्रदेश को उत्तम प्रदेश बनाने का रोडमैप होगा.

title: पाकिस्तान-चीन की फटी रह जाएंगी आंखें, भारतीय सेना ने हाइवे पर ही उतार दिए हवाई जहाज, उड़ान भी भरी
description: भारतीय सेना और NHAI ने गुजरात में अमृतसर-जामनगर इकोनॉमिक कॉरिडोर पर हाइवे से विमानों की लैंडिंग और टेकऑफ कराया है. पहली बार आपात स्थिति के लिए यह ऐतिहासिक अभ्यास किया गया है. केंद्रीय मंत्री न‍ित‍िन गडकरी ने इसे सेना और एनएचएआई के बीच का बेहतरीन तालमेल बताया है.
author: प्रिया गौतम
content:
पाकिस्तान-चीन की फटी रह जाएंगी आंखें, भारतीय सेना ने हाइवे पर ही उतार दिए हवाई जहाज, उड़ान भी भरी
Written by:
Agency:News18India
Last Updated:
भारतीय सेना और NHAI ने गुजरात में अमृतसर-जामनगर इकोनॉमिक कॉरिडोर पर हाइवे से विमानों की लैंडिंग और टेकऑफ कराया है. पहली बार आपात स्थिति के लिए यह ऐतिहासिक अभ्यास किया गया है. केंद्रीय मंत्री न‍ित‍िन गडकरी ने इसे सेना और एनएचएआई के बीच का बेहतरीन तालमेल बताया है.
भारतीय सेना और एनएचएआई ने मिलकर इतिहास रच दिया है. अभी तक विमान हवाई पट्टी यानि रनवे पर ही टेकऑफ और लैंडिंग करते थे लेकिन पहली बार गुजरात में हाइवे पर विमानों की लैंडिंग कराई गई और इसी हाईवे से हवाई जहाजों ने उड़ान भी भरी. भारतीय सेना के 4 माइक्रोलाइट विमान इस एतिहासिक प्रदर्शन का गवाह बने हैं. यह देखकर भारत के पड़ोसी देशों को जरूर धक्का लगने वाला है क्योंकि इससे साफ होता है कि भारत अब आपात स्थिति में अपने किसी भी क्षेत्र में बिना रनवे के विमान उतारने में सक्षम है.
भारतीय सेना और एनएचएआई ने गुजरात में एक अनोखा कारनामा किया है. भारतीय सेना की ‘टीम माउंटेन ईगल्स’के चार माइक्रोलाइट विमानों ने अमृतसर-जामनगर इकोनॉमिक कॉरिडोर (NH-754A) पर सफलतापूर्वक लैंडिंग की और फिर उड़ान भी भरी.
बताते चलें कि यह प्रदर्शन गुजरात में हाईवे के किलोमीटर 946 से 949 के बीच किया गया है.सेना के ये विमान ‘Wings of Valour and Unity Expedition’ में हिस्सा ले रहे हैं.
केंद्रीय सड़क परिवहन मंत्री नितिन गडकरी ने इसे भारतीय सेना और NHAI के बीच बेहतर तालमेल का ऐतिहासिक उदाहरण बताया. उन्होंने कहा कि आधुनिक हाईवे सिर्फ यातायात और आर्थिक विकास के लिए ही नहीं, बल्कि सेना की रणनीतिक और ऑपरेशनल जरूरतों के साथ-साथ आपातकालीन परिस्थितियों में भी काम आ सकते हैं.

author: Divyanshi Singh
content:
Guna Teacher Harassment Case: गुना के कैंट में PM श्री गर्ल्स हायर सेकेंडरी स्कूल में पोस्टेड एक टीचर पर 12वीं क्लास की स्टूडेंट को अश्लील WhatsApp मैसेज भेजने और अकेले में मिलने का दबाव बनाने का आरोप है. स्टूडेंट का आरोप है कि टीचर ने एग्जाम में नंबर काटने की धमकी दी और उसे ऐसा करने के लिए मजबूर किया.स्टूडेंट की शिकायत और WhatsApp चैट मिलने के बाद, पुलिस ने आरोपी टीचर नरेंद्र कुशवाह के खिलाफ POCSO एक्ट और दूसरी धाराओं के तहत केस दर्ज करके उसे कस्टडी में ले लिया.
WhatsApp पर अश्लील मैसेज भेजना
स्टूडेंट ने अपनी शिकायत में बताया कि टीचर नरेंद्र कुशवाह कुछ समय से उसे WhatsApp पर लगातार अश्लील और आपत्तिजनक मैसेज भेज रहा था. वह उस पर अकेले में मिलने और बाहर घूमने जाने का दबाव बनाता था. आरोप है कि टीचर ने मैसेज में लिखा, “12 बजे मेरे साथ सो जाना…” और “यह कहकर आ जाना कि तुम्हारा बर्थडे है, मैं तुम्हें 8 बजे तक फ्री कर दूंगा.”
नंबर काटने और पढ़ाई को नुकसान पहुंचाने की धमकी
स्टूडेंट का आरोप है कि जब उसने टीचर की हरकतों का विरोध किया, तो उसने उसे एग्जाम में कम नंबर देने और उसकी पढ़ाई को नुकसान पहुंचाने की धमकी दी. आरोप है कि टीचर ने अपने पद का रौब दिखाते हुए दावा किया कि स्कूल में सब कुछ उसी के कंट्रोल में है और वही एग्जाम में नंबर देता है.
अधिकारियों से शिकायत
लगातार मिल रही धमकियों और परेशानी की वजह से स्टूडेंट मेंटल स्ट्रेस में थी. उसे अपनी पढ़ाई और भविष्य की चिंता थी. आखिर में, उसने अपनी मां को पूरी बात बताई. इसके बाद, उसकी मां ने डिस्ट्रिक्ट एजुकेशन ऑफिसर, स्कूल प्रिंसिपल, सुपरिटेंडेंट ऑफ पुलिस और संबंधित पुलिस स्टेशन इंचार्ज को लिखकर शिकायत दी. स्टूडेंट को डर है कि आरोपी टीचर ने स्कूल की दूसरी छात्राओं के साथ भी ऐसा ही किया होगा.
स्कूल में पर्दे लगाकर सीक्रेट जगह बनाई
शिकायत में, स्टूडेंट ने आरोप लगाया कि टीचर ने स्कूल कैंपस में पर्दे लगाकर एक अलग जगह बना ली थी. वह उस पर वहां बैठकर बात करने का दबाव डालता था. स्कूल के कुछ टीचरों ने दावा किया है कि टीचर को पहले भी एक स्टूडेंट के परिवार वालों ने पीटा था, जिसने कोचिंग क्लास के दौरान उसके साथ गलत व्यवहार किया था. अखिल भारतीय विद्यार्थी परिषद (ABVP) ने भी स्कूल प्रिंसिपल को एक मेमोरेंडम देकर आरोपी टीचर के खिलाफ सख्त कार्रवाई की मांग की है.
जांच के लिए DEO को शिकायत भेजी गई
स्कूल प्रिंसिपल संजय कुमार जैन ने बताया कि 12वीं क्लास की स्टूडेंट अपनी मां के साथ स्कूल में शिकायत लेकर आई थी. उसने बताया कि टीचर चिल्ड्रन्स डे से ही उससे चैट कर रहा था. शिकायत के साथ WhatsApp चैट की एक कॉपी भी भेजी गई है. शिकायत को जांच के लिए डिस्ट्रिक्ट एजुकेशन ऑफिसर को भेज दिया गया है.

title: Caught On CCTV: मेरठ होटल कांड: युवती को बंधक बनाने का आरोप, भागने पर बीच बाजार में पीटा; वीडियो वायरल
description: Meerut Hotel Case: मेरठ के आबूलेन स्थित होटल में गाजियाबाद की युवती को बंधक बनाने और मारपीट का आरोप लगा है. जानें पूरी घटना, पुलिस की कार्रवाई और होटल मैनेजमेंट की भूमिका.
author: Sujeet Kumar
content:
उत्तर प्रदेश के मेरठ से एक हैरान करने वाला मामला सामने आया है. शहर के आबूलेन बाजार स्थित एक होटल में गाजियाबाद की 24 वर्षीय युवती को कथित तौर पर बंधक बनाकर रखने और उसके साथ मारपीट करने का आरोप लगा है. युवती जब होटल से निकलकर भागने लगी तो आरोपी युवक सलमान ने बीच बाजार में उसका पीछा किया और उसे पकड़कर वापस होटल ले जाने की कोशिश की. इस घटना का वीडियो भी सोशल मीडिया पर चर्चा में है.
होटल से भागने की कोशिश पर बीच बाजार में मारपीट
मीडिया रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, घटना मंगलवार दोपहर की है. युवती होटल से बाहर निकलकर मदद के लिए चिल्लाने लगी. इसी दौरान सलमान नाम का युवक उसके पीछे पहुंचा और कथित तौर पर उसे सड़क पर गिराकर मारपीट करने लगा. आरोपी ने युवती को जबरन वापस होटल ले जाने की कोशिश की. युवती की आवाज सुनकर आसपास के दुकानदार और राहगीर मौके पर पहुंच गए. लोगों ने हस्तक्षेप कर युवती को आरोपी के चंगुल से छुड़ाया. भीड़ बढ़ने पर आरोपी होटल की छत की तरफ भागा और वहां से फरार हो गया.
युवती ने पुलिस को क्या बताया?
पुलिस और मीडिया रिपोर्ट्स के अनुसार, युवती गाजियाबाद की रहने वाली है और उसकी सलमान से पहले से जान-पहचान थी. दोनों करीब दो साल से एक-दूसरे को जानते थे. युवती का आरोप है कि सलमान उसे होटल में ले गया और चाकू की धमकी देकर कमरे में बंधक बनाकर रखा. उसने मारपीट और जान से मारने की धमकी देने की बात भी कही है. बताया गया है कि युवती के परिवार ने उसकी शादी कहीं और तय कर दी थी, जिसके बाद उसने सलमान से संपर्क कम कर दिया था.
उत्तर प्रदेश- मेरठ शहर के पॉश बाजार के एक होटल में गाजियाबाद की हिंदू लड़की को बंधक बनाकर रखा गया था. लड़की को होटल में लाने वाले सलमान को बिना ID के कमरा दिया गया. लड़की ने आज होटल से भागने की कोशिश की तो सलमान ने बीच बाजार उसे दौड़ाकर दबोचा और उसे उठाकर होटल ले जाने लगा. राहगीरों के दखल के बाद लड़की को छुड़ाया गया. पुलिस पहुंचने से पहले होटल स्वामी और मैनेजर ने सलमान को होटल से फरार कर दिया. पुलिस ने केस दर्ज किया है. हिंदूवादी संगठनों ने इस मामले में आरोपी सलमान के एनकाउंटर की मांग की है.
— Narendra Pratap (@hindipatrakar) November 24, 2026
होटल मैनेजमेंट पर भी उठे सवाल
इस मामले में होटल प्रबंधन की भूमिका भी जांच के दायरे में है. पुलिस ने होटल मैनेजर से पूछताछ की और एंट्री रजिस्टर की जांच की. शुरुआती जांच में युवती के होटल में ठहरने की एंट्री नहीं मिलने की बात सामने आई है. होटल में बिना उचित पहचान सत्यापन के कमरा देने और आरोपी को भागने में मदद करने के आरोपों की भी जांच की जा रही है.
हिंदू संगठनों ने की एनकाउंटर की मांग
घटना के बाद अखिल भारतीय हिंदू सुरक्षा संगठन के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष सचिन सिरोही ने पुलिस से आरोपी के खिलाफ सख्त कार्रवाई की मांग की. उन्होंने आरोपी के एनकाउंटर और होटल को सील करने की मांग भी उठाई है. हालांकि, किसी भी आरोपी के खिलाफ कार्रवाई कानून और न्यायिक प्रक्रिया के तहत ही होनी चाहिए.
पुलिस ने दर्ज किया मुकदमा
पुलिस ने युवती की शिकायत के आधार पर भारतीय न्याय संहिता (BNS) की संबंधित धाराओं में मुकदमा दर्ज किया है. पुलिस अधिकारियों के मुताबिक, युवती के बयान और होटल से जुड़े साक्ष्यों के आधार पर जांच की जा रही है. आरोपी की तलाश और होटल प्रबंधन की भूमिका की भी पड़ताल की जा रही है.

title: Delhi Crime: पार्टी के नाम पर कैफे में बुलाया, फिर अपने ही दोस्तों ने किया सामूहिक दुष्कर्म; प्रीत विहार में 22 साल की लड़की के साथ हैवानियत
description: Delhi Preet Vihar Cafe Gangrape Case :  पुलिस के मुताबिक, पीड़िता सभी आरोपियों को जानती थी. वह अपने जान-पहचान वालों के साथ पार्टी करने प्रीत विहार में सल्तनत नाम के कैफे में गई थी. एक अधिकारी ने बताया कि बीती रात कैफे में लड़की समेत कुल सात लोग आए थे. कैफे सोमवार रात करीब 11:30 बजे बंद हो गया था.
author: Divyanshi Singh
content:
Delhi Crime: दिल्ली के प्रीत विहार इलाके में 22 साल की एक लड़की के साथ गैंग रेप का मामला सामने आया है. आरोप है कि एक कैफे में पार्टी के दौरान दो युवकों ने उसके साथ रेप किया, जबकि वहां मौजूद कुछ और लोगों ने भी इसमें साथ दिया. पीड़िता की शिकायत के आधार पर पुलिस ने गैंग रेप समेत संबंधित धाराओं में केस दर्ज कर लिया है. इस मामले में दो महिलाओं समेत तीन आरोपियों को गिरफ्तार किया गया है. पुलिस टीमें बाकी आरोपियों की तलाश कर रही हैं.
पुलिस के मुताबिक, पीड़िता सभी आरोपियों को जानती थी. वह अपने जान-पहचान वालों के साथ पार्टी करने प्रीत विहार में सल्तनत नाम के कैफे में गई थी. एक अधिकारी ने बताया कि बीती रात कैफे में लड़की समेत कुल सात लोग आए थे. कैफे सोमवार रात करीब 11:30 बजे बंद हो गया था. हालांकि, ग्रुप में शामिल लोगों में से एक के पास चाबी थी. इसी चाबी का इस्तेमाल करके देर रात कैफे फिर से खोला गया और सभी लोग वहां पार्टी करते रहे.
देर रात तक चलती रही पार्टी
बताया जा रहा है कि कैफे में सभी ने शराब पी थी. इसके बाद, सुबह करीब 3:30 बजे सब लोग चले गए. थोड़ी देर बाद, महिला ने आरोप लगाया कि दो लड़कों ने उसके साथ गैंगरेप किया. पीड़िता का आरोप है कि वहां मौजूद दूसरे लोगों ने भी आरोपियों का साथ दिया. पुलिस के मुताबिक, पीड़िता कड़कड़डूमा के क्रॉस रिवर मॉल के एक कैफे में काम करती है. कुछ आरोपी भी उसी कैफे में उसके साथ काम करते हैं.
घटना के बाद, महिला ने पुलिस में शिकायत दर्ज कराई. मामले की गंभीरता को देखते हुए, पुलिस ने शिकायत के आधार पर जांच शुरू की. वे अब पार्टी में शामिल सभी लोगों की भूमिका की जांच कर रहे हैं. वे यह भी पता लगाने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं कि घटना के समय कैफे में क्या हुआ था और हर व्यक्ति की क्या भूमिका थी.
दो महिलाओं समेत तीन आरोपी गिरफ्तार
महिला की शिकायत पर, पुलिस ने गैंगरेप के आरोपों के तहत मामला दर्ज किया है. अब तक, दो महिलाओं और एक पुरुष समेत तीन आरोपियों को गिरफ्तार किया गया है. पुलिस बाकी आरोपियों की तलाश कर रही है.
पुलिस घटना से जुड़े तथ्यों और परिस्थितियों का पता लगाने के लिए आरोपियों से पूछताछ कर रही है. वे इस कथित घटना में शामिल लोगों की भूमिका और पार्टी के दौरान कैसे घटनाएँ हुईं, इसकी भी जाँच कर रहे हैं. अभी आगे की जाँच चल रही है. पुलिस का कहना है कि बाकी आरोपियों को पकड़ने की कोशिशें जारी हैं.

title: भाटी माइंस पुलिस की बड़ी कार्रवाई, अवैध शराब की भारी खेप के साथ एक आरोपी गिरफ्तार
