title: IndiGo Flight Diverts To Agartala After Passenger Falls Ill Mid-Air, Resumes Journey
description: National | An IndiGo flight travelling from Shanghai in China to Kolkata made an emergency landing at Maharaja Bir Bikram (MBB) Airport in Agartala on Tuesday morning after a passenger fell ill during the journey.
author: PratidinTime News Desk
content:
An IndiGo flight travelling from Shanghai in China to Kolkata made an emergency landing at Maharaja Bir Bikram (MBB) Airport in Agartala on Tuesday morning after a passenger fell ill during the journey.
According to reports, the flight landed at Agartala Airport at around 8:50 am following a medical emergency involving a passenger identified as Abhishek Singhal, a resident of Delhi. The passenger reportedly fell ill while the aircraft was en route to Kolkata, prompting the crew to divert the flight to Agartala to arrange immediate medical assistance.
Following the landing, medical assistance was arranged at the airport, and the passenger was shifted to ILS Hospital in Agartala for treatment.
The Airport Authority of India coordinated the emergency response to ensure that the passenger received timely medical attention.
According to the information available, Singhal was subsequently declared fit to travel after receiving medical attention. He later returned to the airport and boarded the same IndiGo flight.
The aircraft resumed its journey to Kolkata at around 10 am, following the brief halt in Agartala.
The emergency diversion was carried out to ensure that the passenger could receive medical care without delay. No further details regarding the nature of his medical condition were immediately available.
The incident highlights the emergency procedures followed by airlines when passengers require urgent medical attention during a flight.

title: India Tops Global List for YouTube Video Takedowns
description: India topped the global list for YouTube video removals in April-June 2026, with 34.4 lakh videos taken down, accounting for nearly 31 per cent of all videos deleted worldwide. |National | Top Stories|
author: DY365
content:
India Tops Global List for YouTube Video Takedowns
India topped the global list for YouTube video removals in April-June 2026, with 34.4 lakh videos taken down, accounting for nearly 31 per cent of all videos deleted worldwide.
New Delhi: In the second quarter of the year, i.e. between April and June 2026, India topped the list for YouTube video removals globally. A total of around 34.4 lakh videos were removed for breaking Community Guidelines in India.
The number is 28 percent more than the videos removed in the first quarter of the year. Interestingly, a total of 1.1 crore videos were deleted globally, out of which, videos from India accounted for 31 percent. The US held the second position in the list with 12.4 lakh videos removed, while Indonesia stands at third position with 9.2 lakh videos deleted.
The report also stated that child safety violations were responsible for 68.2 per cent of video removals worldwide. Most of the action was taken after automated systems detected the content, accounting for 98.6 per cent of the removed videos.
Separately, Google reported a sharp increase in requests from Indian government agencies and courts to remove online content. The number of such requests went up by 61 per cent during January-June 2026 compared to the previous six months.
Google received 4,006 requests from India, involving 65,091 items across its platforms. This placed India third globally, behind Russia and South Korea. YouTube received the highest number of requests, with 3,399 cases.
Police agencies sent 2,870 requests, while courts submitted 695. Defamation was the main reason mentioned in 2,130 requests.
Following these requests, Google removed 19,883 items for violating Indian laws and another 1,415 under its own rules. However, no action was taken on 19,402 items, while Google said there was not enough information to act on another 17,473.
The two reports provide different details about online content removal. YouTube's report focuses on videos that break its platform rules, while Google's report covers requests made by Indian authorities and courts to remove content from its services.

title: Bomb Threat Email Targets Mumbai Mayor's Office, Metro Stations, Amitabh Bachchan's Jalsa
description: Police are probing a threat email which says there will be blasts across the city, such as the Mayor office, metro stations and Bachchan's Jalsa I National I Top Stories
author: DY365
content:
Bomb Threat Email Targets Mumbai Mayor's Office, Metro Stations, Amitabh Bachchan's Jalsa
The email was received by the Mumbai mayor Ritu Tawde and municipal commissioner Ashwini Bhide on Thursday, the anniversary of the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks, sparking security fears
MUMBAI: The Mumbai police are probing a threat email which says there will be blasts across the city, covering areas such as the Mayor's office, metro stations and actor Amitabh Bachchan's Juhu bungalow Jalsa, a report by IANS said.
The email was received by the Mumbai mayor Ritu Tawde and municipal commissioner Ashwini Bhide on Thursday, the anniversary of the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks, sparking security fears.
The sender supposedly also cautioned about a blast at the Mayor's office and of grenade attacks in the city. The email also purportedly said that IED blasts might occur at Metro stations from November 27 till December 31, and claimed that explosives had been planted at various locations, including at Jalsa. It added that there may be attacks across Mumbai in the coming weeks.
The message, it said, also mentioned the Khalistan movement and organisations including the Khalistan National Army and the Babbar Khalsa. It reportedly included slogans related to the anti-Sikh riots of 1984 such as 'Khoon ka badla khoon', a threat against the Bachchan residence, and calls for revenge for the killings that had taken place during the riots.
The allegations haven't yet been independently confirmed, and officials will need to determine whether the threats are true. The message is being considered as a claim by the sender that doesn't, on its own, confirm there are bombs and an attack is imminent. Police haven't yet released a statement about the latest email.
Sequence of previous threats
Another email a few weeks ago named Jalsa and the Mayor's office.
According to police, the email sent to Tawde on October 23, and which was marked to Deputy Mayor Sanjay Ghadi, threatened to attack her office, the singer Diljit Dosanjh concert scheduled on November 27 and Bachchan's house. The Mumbai Police have lodged a non-cognisable offence in connection with threatening emails received by the Mayor's Office and an American school in the city.
Threat email sent to Mumbai mayor, Diljit Dosanjh concert, Amitabh Bachchan
On November 6 another email named Jalsa, the Bombay High Court and Mahalaxmi Racecourse. Police checked Jalsa after the warning, but nothing suspicious was found. A third email was received around November 12, this time naming Jalsa, the Mayor's office and Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, and yet again police and bomb squads found nothing suspicious.
It is uncertain if the Nov. 26 email has any connection to the previous emails. The previous emails did not contain the Khalistan references or the 1984 slogans seen in the latest email and police haven't said if they are investigating all of the emails.
Again the mentions of certain groups and the time-date selected for the e-mail have not been authenticated and it is not known if they identify the real author of the letter or if they were done to scare.
In the memory of the victims, every year, the anniversary of the November 26, 2008 attacks - among India's most violent terrorist incidents - is observed.
Further details are awaited.

title: Congress Leader Reflects on Rajiv Gandhi's Final Hours During 1991 Campaign
description: Recalling his association with former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi and the final hours he spent with him during the 1991 Lok Sabha election campaign, senior Congress leader V. Hanumantha Rao on Wednesday remembered a conversation in which Gandhi told him he was exhausted and wanted to rest before resuming his journey.
author: Sentinel Digital Desk
content:
HYDERABAD: Recalling his association with former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi and the final hours he spent with him during the 1991 Lok Sabha election campaign, senior Congress leader V. Hanumantha Rao on Wednesday remembered a conversation in which Gandhi told him he was exhausted and wanted to rest before resuming his journey.
Rao, who had worked closely with Rajiv Gandhi, recounted the interaction, saying the former Prime Minister had asked him not to bring anyone to meet him as he wanted to sleep.
Recalling the events of May 1991, Rao said Rajiv Gandhi was travelling as part of his election campaign and had several programmes scheduled in Tamil Nadu after arriving from Odisha.
“I was there when he came for the election campaign from Odisha to Seethakulam. Then there was a campaign in Vijayanagar, and he had a few programmes lined up in Chennai too. I was there at the airport with him,” Rao said. He recalled that Rajiv Gandhi had spoken to him about his political future during the journey.
“He told me, ‘Hanumath, we will work together after these parliamentary elections; I will make you the Chief Minister of Andhra’,” Rao said. Rao also narrated an incident involving a flight that Rajiv Gandhi was scheduled to take. According to him, Rajiv Gandhi was initially supposed to travel in a small aircraft, but the pilot informed them that technical problems had been detected and the flight could not take off.
Rao said Rajiv Gandhi, who was himself a trained pilot, inspected the situation before deciding to return to the guest house. “As soon as he sat in the vehicle, he said to me, ‘Hey Hanumath! I’m too tired; I want to sleep. Don’t bring anyone,” Rao recalled. He said that shortly afterwards, the pilot informed them that the aircraft was ready and they could resume their journey. Rajiv Gandhi then decided to return to continue his travel. (IANS)

title: Court Seeks CBI Reply on Bail Plea of NEET Paper Leak Accused Kulkarni
description: The Rouse Avenue court on Wednesday sought a reply from the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) on the bail application of PV Kulakarni.
author: Sentinel Digital Desk
content: NEW DELHI: The Rouse Avenue court on Wednesday sought a reply from the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) on the bail application of PV Kulakarni. Kulkarni has filed a bail application through Advocate Hemant Shah. He is in custody for a long time. It is submitted that the charges have been framed and the investigation has already been done. There is no use of keeping him behind the bar. Senior advocate V K Pathak appeared for the CBI along with the investigating officer. The regular matter has been listed on November 27. In its earlier order, the court observed that the accused had, in one way or another, shared or distributed confidential examination material on a large scale, resulting in its circulation across the country well before the scheduled examination. title: Netflix series ‘Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo’ is the latest flashpoint in India-Pak cultural ties
description: The All Indian Cine Workers Association has sought a ban on the upcoming show.
author: Tanya Shrivastava
content:
Netflix’s first Pakistani original series Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo has predictably run into controversy in India before its scheduled release on December 4. On November 24, the All Indian Cine Workers Association wrote to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, seeking a ban on the streaming of the show in India, PTI reported.
Describing Pakistan as a “terrorist country”, the association said that allowing Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo to be shown in India would hurt national sentiments. On Thursday, the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting asked Netflix to ensure that content originating in Pakistan was not streamed in India, The Indian Express reported.
The ministry also asked the platform to comply with its advisory dated May 8, 2025, which directed streaming platforms and digital intermediaries in India to discontinue Pakistani-origin content. However, the series is still listed on Netflix India, with the “Remind me” option active and the release date given as December 4.
Scroll has contacted Netflix to ask for a statement. This story will be updated if the platform responds.
Another Pakistani show that has run into controversy is Dar-e-Nijaat, which has legions of fans, especially among women, for its lead character Abu Bakar. Played by Sheheryar Munawar, Abu Bakar has been described as “ideal husband” material.
Dar-e-Nijaat devotees even recently organised a private screening in Delhi. But similar screenings at a restaurant in Bengaluru had to be cancelled after the events attracted criticism on social media.
Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo has been created and directed by Momina Duraid, who is behind several iconic Pakistani shows that are hugely popular in India as well, among them Humsafar and Zindagi Gulzar Hai. Her new show, Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo, is based on Farhat Ishtiaq’s 2013 Urdu novel of the same name. The Urdu-language show has a star-studded cast, including Fawad Khan, Mahira Khan, Hania Aamir and Sanam Saeed.
Fawad Khan and Mahira Khan are no strangers to the hostility that Pakistani actors have faced in India. They are among the Pakistani actors who were steadily building up parallel careers in Bollywood until tensions between India and Pakistan peaked in the mid-2010s.
Filmmaker Karan Johar was strafed for casting Fawad Khan in his productions Ae Dil Hai Mushkil and Kapoor & Sons in 2016 despite the attack by Jaish-E-Mohammed terrorists on an Indian Army base in Uri. That year, the Indian Motion Picture Producers Association passed a resolution asking its members not to work with Pakistani artists until relations between the two countries improved.
The Cine Owners Association also announced that it would not screen films featuring Pakistani actors in several states.
While there is no official ban on Pakistani artists working in India, various film industry associations have regularly led and implemented demands for a freeze on collaborations with artists from across the border.
In 2017, Mahira Khan, who made her Bollywood debut opposite Shah Rukh Khan in Raees, faced similar opposition. The same year, Saba Qamar appeared alongside Irrfan in Angrezi Medium.
After the Pulwama attack in February 2019, the All Indian Cine Workers Association announced a blanket ban on Pakistani actors and artists.
Notably, in October 2023, the Bombay High Court dismissed a petition seeking a complete ban on Indian citizens and companies hiring Pakistani artists. The court had said at the time that such a prohibition was a “retrograde step” for cultural harmony. It had also held that patriotism did not require enmity towards another country.
In 2024, Indian distributors in Punjab dropped a planned release of the Pakistani film The Legend of Maula Jatt, a reboot of the iconic Pakistani film Maula Jatt from 1979. The film’s cast included Fawad Khan and Mahira Khan.
Despite the proscriptions, Pakistani shows remain hugely popular in India. Classic and recent titles that are available on YouTube have a large enough fanbase to inspire watch parties and a social media trend called ‘Indian Moms After Watching Pakistanis Dramas’.
Instagram reels poke fun at Indian viewers who have picked up Urdu expressions such as “Mashallah” or wonderful, “takalluf” or formality, and “masla” or problem, after watching these shows.
The appetite for Pakistani content is unlikely to abate. Indian audiences continue to follow Pakistani actors, but in productions made on the other side of the border rather than in films and shows in which they could have worked together.
Indians have become part of the audience for Pakistani shows, defying the fractious politics between the nations and the efforts of non-governmental organisations to impose unofficial censorship.

title: Readers’ comments: India’s unscientific inclinations are due to caste
description: Responses to articles in Scroll.in.
author: Scroll
content:
I read this article thoroughly and understood that the problem is how the Indian education system is irrational and unscientific when it comes to learning (“Harsh Mander: India’s new age of unreason goes against centuries of scientific temper, rationalism”). Last year, when I was a trainee at a village school in Balaghat, I observed some worrying behaviour.
1) School management committee members assemble to eat snacks without discussing pressing issues;
2) Students have stopped asking questions in the classroom as they are heavily dependent on tuition classes for scoring in exams while rote learning has discouraged learners
3) Children with special needs are treated as if they are not even human
4) Sanskrit is prioritised over the mother tongue
5) Science and maths are neglected since teachers as busy in election and Census work, and online work.
Indian society will never accept science since it throttles brahmanical supremacy that creates hierarchy and casteism. To get rid of this irrationality in society, casteism and monopoly over education must end. – Mayur Wahane
Sonia Gandhi’s book
As a citizen, I have always given her the benefit of doubt as we Indians respect women who suffer personal tragedies (“‘Belonging’: Sonia and Rajiv Gandhi’s love story has all the makings of a great romance novel”). But there are several factual errors in this book. How did Sonia Gandhi watch the demolition of the Babri masjid live? The Godhra carnage, when a train compartment of volunteers from returning from Ayodhya was set on fire in 2002, provoked a violet response. But Sonia Gandhi only remembered what suited her political narrative. – Sindhu Sarma
Poor civic sense
An excellent article with a balanced perspective that was brave enough to point out much that is wrong with our current leadership (“Uncivic sense: Entitled behaviour starts from the top – India’s leaders must set a better example”). We need more of such articles, though they usually preach to the converted, unfortunately. – Malini White.
***
Much said right, but a whole lot of rubbish too. But then with Scroll and its politics, what else to expect? Indian society has always been feudal and casteist. Our early “leaders” were the same. We are now slowly starting to dismantle historical institutions of privilege.
With money, new institutions of privilege are coming up just as quickly. We are not a democratic society. In a democratic society, leaders pick up norms of behaviour from the people. They reflect the norms of society: “Yatha Praja, tatha Raja”. In a feudal society, people follow their leaders: “Yatha Raja tatha Praja”. – Atul Chandra
Anti-India articles
There is nothing like that (“US Australian embassy posts map showing India as only ‘partly free’”). The present government treats all patriotic Indians without any discrimination on their caste or religion. Such rumors are spread by some unpatriotic elements funded by enemy countries who want to create unrest here so that the democratically-elected government can be overthrown. – Satish Kumar
***
A US-funded organisation is as fair as the Trump administration and CIA. What about the brutality by the US police against common Black citizens? This is like throwing stones while living in a glass house. Western media has always had this holier than thou attitude and arrogance. In India, we live side by side: Hindus, Muslims and Christians. Freedom doesn’t mean allowing arson and looting. – Srinivasa Kharidehal
OCIs can’t have same rights as Indian citizens
I disagree with the author about the Overseas Citizen Card holders having the same rights as the citizens of India (“In Modi’s India, only ‘good’ OCIs are welcome”). Just as OCIs don’t have any duties enjoined to Indian Citizens in the Constitution, they can’t claim any equality with us. The OCI card is just a liberal version of the Indian visa. All the restrictions applying to foreigners must apply to OCIs, though at liberal terms. They definitely don’t have any right to protest against while in India. – Shanker
***
If that is the case then why did the courts keep silent when Narendra Modi openly participated in election propaganda in the US favouring Donald Trump (“HC says OCI cardholders don’t have right to protest, asks actor Imran Khan to apologise”)? – Pradeep Khanna
Literary festivals and awards
This is a beautiful piece which brings together history, culture and the celebration of literature (“Why the small town of Almora has instituted a literature festival”). It is a refreshing and knowledgeable piece of work which dives deep into the history of Almora, distinguishing it as more than a tourist destination. – Abhilasha Singh
***
I found this article informative and interesting. Almora has a rich cultural and historical heritage. I believe that the Almora Literature Festival is a great initiative to preserve Kumauni culture, folk traditions, and local literature. Such festivals can also encourage young people to learn about their roots and appreciate their cultural identity. It is important to preserve our traditions for future generations. – Priyanka Bahuguna
***
Literary awards for books must match the cash component with prestige (“The New India Foundation announces the shortlist for 2026 Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay NIF Book Prize”). The Nobel Prize for literature, comes with 12 million in Swedish kronor and global prestige, but it is for a body of work. The Booker Prize awards £50,000 cash, split between author and translator. The Pulitzer Award carries a $15,000 cash prize. But Indian literary awards, like the Sahitya Akademi award, come with just Rs 50,000 Rs 1 lakh cash with a shawl. Some like Jnanpith Award were recently increased to Rs 11 lakh cash. – Denis de souza
Growing up in Delhi
This was a long read but fun (“Mukul Kesavan: Growing up in Lutyens’ Delhi – an urban history in anecdotes”). As a born and brought up Dilliwala, the article resonated. Its piercing self-awareness is bracing. That he and I were also classmates at St Stephen’s only added to the delight of reading. I too remember noticing at that time that there were very few – not more than one or two per section, and sometimes none – Muslims. I also felt that Muslims were traditionalists while Hindus had embraced modernity, taking great risks of christianising and westernising in the process.
– Rajiv Chaudhri

title: Top Lashkar-e-Taiba commander Lateef Bhat killed in encounter in J&K's Kulgam
description: Security forces in Kulgam trapped wanted Lashkar-e-Taiba commander Lateef Bhat on Wednesday. Despite officers offering him an opportunity to surrender, Bhat refused, following a gunfight linked to a previous CRPF attack.
author: Onmanorama Staff
content:
Top Lashkar-e-Taiba commander Lateef Bhat killed in encounter in J&K's Kulgam
Mail This Article
Srinagar: Top Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) commander Lateef Bhat was killed in an encounter with security forces in Kulgam district of Jammu and Kashmir on Wednesday, officials confirmed to PTI.
Security forces had earlier offered Bhat an opportunity to surrender after trapping him during an encounter in Zangalpora village in the Devsar area of south Kashmir. However, he refused to surrender and opened fire after entering a mosque around 2.45 am, Kulgam Senior Superintendent of Police Anayat Ali said.
The police had made repeated appeals to Bhat to surrender, including through a video call and a phone provided to him inside the cordoned-off area. Ali said he had personally spoken to the terrorist for a considerable time, urging him to give up arms and pointing out that he was still young and had his whole life ahead of him. However, Bhat refused to comply.
Security forces were exercising maximum restraint to minimise damage to the mosque while following standard operating procedures (SOPs), the SSP said before the operation concluded.
Ali described Bhat's killing as one of the biggest successes for security forces in 2026. He said Bhat had joined the LeT on November 18, 2025, and was heavily self-radicalised. He was allegedly receiving instructions from across the border to disrupt peace, tourism and the economy through attacks.
The encounter began early Wednesday following credible intelligence inputs received by the Jammu and Kashmir Police. Security forces launched a coordinated cordon-and-search operation in Zangalpora village, trapping Bhat inside the cordoned-off area.
The encounter comes two days after Umar Nisar Dar, one of the terrorists allegedly involved in the November 11 attack on CRPF personnel in Kulgam, was killed in a gunfight near the Laru bypass in the same district on Monday. Bhat had managed to escape from the encounter site.
Both Bhat and Dar are believed to have carried out the November 11 attack on a CRPF post, in which three paramilitary personnel were injured.
Following specific intelligence inputs, security forces had launched a focused search operation in the area. While Dar was killed on Monday, security personnel continued extensive searches in the surrounding areas to track down Bhat. Contact with Bhat was re-established during searches early Wednesday, triggering a fresh exchange of fire.
According to officials, Dar had allegedly provided shelter and logistical support to Bhat for nearly six months. The duo had also conducted reconnaissance before carrying out the attack on the CRPF post.
Dar, a former breadmaker who had been reported missing by his family, was allegedly associated with The Resistance Front (TRF), an offshoot of the Pakistan-based LeT.

title: UP Election 2027: Rs 25,000 for women, Muslim and OBC Deputy CMs in Chandrashekhar Azad, Asaduddin Owaisi's poll pitch
description: UP Election 2027: Chandrashekhar Azad and Asaduddin Owaisi promise Rs 25,000 for women, Muslim and OBC Deputy CMs, jobs and social justice if voted to power
author: DNA Web Team
content:
INDIA
UP Election 2027: Chandrashekhar Azad and Asaduddin Owaisi promise Rs 25,000 for women, Muslim and OBC Deputy CMs, jobs and social justice if voted to power
Ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, the Samajik Parivartan Morcha, led by Azad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) chief Chandrashekhar Azad and AIMIM president Asaduddin Owaisi, has outlined its political and electoral agenda. The party promised greater representation for marginalised communities, financial assistance for women and a renewed focus on education, employment and social justice.
At a rally in Lucknow on Constitution Day, Azad, who has been projected as the alliance's chief ministerial candidate, announced a series of promises targeting women, Muslims and backward communities. The alliance has also positioned itself as an alternative to the BJP and the Samajwadi Party ahead of the crucial Assembly elections.
One of the biggest announcements made by Chandrashekhar Azad was a proposed direct benefit transfer of Rs 25,000 to every woman. Taking a swipe at rival parties, Azad said that if another political party offered women Rs 20,000, his alliance would provide Rs 25,000 instead.
He also addressed questions about the source of funding for the proposed scheme. Azad claimed that the Uttar Pradesh government spends around Rs 7,000 crore on publicity and self-advertisement by the Chief Minister. He promised to redirect this money towards women through direct bank transfers.
However, the alliance has not yet provided a detailed framework explaining the eligibility criteria, frequency of payments or implementation of the proposed scheme.
Political representation for the Muslim community is another major component of the alliance's electoral pitch. Announcing the proposal, Azad said a leader from the Muslim community would be appointed Deputy Chief Minister if the alliance forms the government.
Using the name 'Abdul' as a reference to the Muslim community, he said Muslims would no longer be confined to supporting political parties but would become part of the government's decision-making structure.
"Abdul will become Deputy Chief Minister; Abdul will not lay carpets for anyone anymore; he will sit alongside Chandrashekhar Azad," he said.
The announcement also reflects Owaisi's long-standing argument that Muslim voters should seek a greater share in political representation rather than merely supporting parties that claim to represent secular interests.
Alongside the proposed Muslim Deputy Chief Minister, Azad promised another Deputy Chief Minister from the most backward or backward communities. The announcement is central to the alliance's attempt to consolidate Dalit, Muslim and OBC voters under a common political platform.
By promising two Deputy Chief Minister positions to leaders from these communities, the Morcha is pitching political representation as one of its key priorities.
Azad also made education a central part of his attack on the BJP-led Uttar Pradesh government. He alleged that more than 25,000 schools had been shut down in the state over the past decade and accused the government of failing to provide quality education to economically weaker sections.
He also alleged that a post-matric scholarship scheme for backward-class students had been discontinued. While these claims formed part of his criticism of the incumbent government, the alliance has not yet announced a detailed education policy or a specific roadmap for reopening schools.
Employment and economic opportunities for young people also featured prominently in Azad's speech.
He alleged that the state had failed to introduce an adequate industrial policy, forcing young people to migrate to other states in search of jobs.
He further accused the government of discontinuing the Finance and Development Corporation for backward classes, which was intended to help members of these communities access loans and start their own businesses.
The alliance has called for better employment opportunities and economic empowerment, although detailed proposals on industrial development, job creation and financial assistance are yet to be outlined.
At the rally, Azad also led the gathering in raising demands for better schools, hospitals, employment opportunities, women's safety and empowerment.
He called for an administration that prioritises public welfare and the rule of law.
However, these remain broad political commitments, with the alliance yet to spell out specific schemes, funding allocations or implementation timelines.
Constitutional protection and social justice were other major themes of the rally, held on Constitution Day. Azad accused the BJP of attempting to change the Constitution and said the Morcha would oppose any such move.
He also argued that justice should be delivered through the Constitution drafted under Dr BR Ambedkar's leadership rather than through bulldozer action or encounters.
Owaisi, meanwhile, targeted the BJP and RSS, accusing them of working against the constitutional principles of liberty, equality, fraternity and justice.

title: Tirupati temple gets 121kg diamond-studded gold jewellery worth Rs 206 crore; 25% of children suffer malnutrition in Andhra Pradesh
description: Malnutrition is improving, but still a big challenge for children and women in India.
author: Anshika Pandey
content:
INDIA
Malnutrition is improving, but still a big challenge for children and women in India.
In a rare act of devotion, a Chennai-based Jain couple donated gold jewellery worth Rs 206 crore to Lord Venkateswara at the Tirupati temple on Thursday. The donation was made in the presence of Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu.
Vardhaman and Radhika Jain handed over 121 kg of diamond-studded gold jewellery to TTD priests at Tirumala, in one of the biggest offerings ever made to the temple. The couple said they donated after receiving divine inspiration, a gesture that reflects deep faith and has drawn wide attention for its value.
Speaking after the ceremony, CM Naidu thanked the couple and called the donation an extraordinary expression of faith. "Donating gold ornaments worth Rs 206 crore to Lord Venkateswara is an exceptional act. The Jain couple have come forward with this offering out of their deep devotion and faith in the deity. I consider myself fortunate to have been part of this historic occasion," he said.
According to Naidu, Tirumala represents devotion and faith, a custom that dates back to the period of Sri Krishnadevaraya. He described how the temple was enhanced with priceless contributions throughout ages by monarchs like as the Pallavas, Cholas, Cheras, Pandyas, Mysore and Maratha kings. Sharing a personal experience, Naidu recalled surviving the Alipiri bomb attack. He said, "Lord Venkateswara gave me a new lease of life. It was His blessings that saved me."
Naidu asked TTD to preserve the temple's holiness and concentrate on the environment, Vedic customs, and cow conservation. While urging the rich to support society like the Jain couple, he revealed plans for the 'Vruksho Govindam' project, improved temple infrastructure, 5,000 new temples in Andhra Pradesh, and stronger annadanam, healthcare and education.
Child malnutrition in India has improved but remains high. Stunting in children under five fell from 31.2% in NFHS-5 (2019-21) to 25% in NFHS-6 (2023-24), and underweight declined from 29.6% to 23.1%, helped by better maternal care and immunisation. However, wasting was 16.1% in NFHS-5; only 9.3% of children aged 6-23 months got an adequate diet, and anaemia still affects around 59-63% of young children and about 59% of women aged 15-49.

title: Why has Mumbai Police issued Lookout Circulars against CJP leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka? What happens next?
description: According to reports citing Mumbai Police officials, LOCs have been issued against Dipke and Ranka in connection with the October protest FIR.
author: DNA Web Team
content:
INDIA
According to reports citing Mumbai Police officials, LOCs have been issued against Dipke and Ranka in connection with the October protest FIR.
Mumbai Police have issued Lookout Circulars (LOCs) against Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke and co-convenor Ashutosh Ranka in connection with a protest held at Mumbai's Shivaji Park on October 2. The development comes days after another party leader, Saurav Das, was stopped from travelling to the United Kingdom at Delhi airport after immigration officials flagged a lookout circular against him.
The action has brought the party's protest, the police case and the separate legal proceedings involving Das under scrutiny.
The case dates back to October 2, when CJP organised a protest at Shivaji Park in Mumbai's Dadar area, despite Mumbai Police refusing permission for the gathering.
The protesters were demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Police had denied permission for the event, citing restrictions on holding gatherings at Shivaji Park and the requirement for necessary civic approvals.
Following the protest, Shivaji Park police station registered an FIR on October 3 against the organisers and 400-500 unidentified participants.
The case invoked Sections 189 and 223 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), relating to unlawful assembly and disobedience of an order issued by a public servant. Relevant provisions of the Maharashtra Police Act were also invoked.
According to reports citing Mumbai Police officials, LOCs have been issued against Dipke and Ranka in connection with the October protest FIR. The circulars were also issued against Das in relation to the same case.
A senior police officer told The Indian Express that the action was taken because authorities apprehended that the leaders might leave the country.
A Lookout Circular is an alert circulated to immigration authorities at airports, seaports and land borders. Depending on the instructions issued, it can be used to track a person or prevent them from leaving or entering the country.
Das was stopped by immigration officials at Indira Gandhi International Airport on November 23, shortly before boarding a London-bound flight. He was scheduled to attend events at Oxford University and other educational institutions in the UK.
Das subsequently approached the Delhi High Court, challenging the action and alleging that he was not informed about the LOC before being stopped.
During the November 26 hearing, Additional Solicitor General Chetan Sharma informed the court that Mumbai Police had requested the LOC against Das.
Separately, the Centre also cited discrepancies in his passport records, including details concerning his place of birth, schooling, address and parentage.
The Delhi High Court has sought a response from the Centre on Das's petition and listed the matter for December 9. His lawyer, senior advocate Akhil Sibal, questioned the procedure followed by authorities and sought a copy of the LOC.
The legal proceedings will determine the next steps in Das's challenge, while the police case connected to the October 2 protest remains a separate matter.

title: 25% टैरिफ लगाकर फंसेंगे ट्रंप? भारत के पास अमेरिका को जवाब देने के 5 रास्ते
description: अमेरिका की ट्रंप सरकार ने भारतीय सामान पर 25 प्रतिशत तक अतिरिक्त टैरिफ लगाने का प्रस्ताव दिया है। इससे नई दिल्ली पर दबाव बढ़ा है। ऐसे में सवाल उठता है कि अमेरिका को जवाब देने के लिए भारत के पास क्या-क्या विकल्प है। आइये जानते हैं...
author: Devendra Kasyap
content:
Explainer: 25% टैरिफ लगाकर फंसेंगे ट्रंप? भारत के पास अमेरिका को जवाब देने के 5 रास्ते
अमेरिका की ट्रंप सरकार ने भारतीय सामान पर 25 प्रतिशत तक अतिरिक्त टैरिफ लगाने का प्रस्ताव दिया है। इससे नई दिल्ली पर दबाव बढ़ा है। ऐसे में सवाल उठता है कि अमेरिका को जवाब देने के लिए भारत के पास क्या-क्या विकल्प है। आइये जानते हैं...
अमेरिका की ट्रंप सरकार ने भारतीय सामान पर 25 प्रतिशत तक अतिरिक्त टैरिफ लगाने का प्रस्ताव देकर नई दिल्ली को एक नई और गंभीर चुनौती दे दी है। संयुक्त राज्य व्यापार प्रतिनिधि कार्यालय (USTR) की 25 नवंबर की घोषणा ने दोनों देशों के बीच पहले से चल रहे व्यापार तनाव को फिर से बढ़ा दिया है। अमेरिका का कहना है कि भारत की मैन्युफैक्चरिंग नीति, बाजार तक पहुंच और कथित रूप से अतिरिक्त उत्पादन क्षमता को लेकर चिंताएं हैं।
अमेरिका ने 25 प्रतिशत तक के टैरिफ रेट का प्रस्ताव रखा है। हालांकि इसमें एक शर्त भी जोड़ी गई है। अगर भारत जांच के दौरान उठाई गई चिंताओं को दूर करने के लिए अमेरिका के साथ एक आपसी (रेसिप्रोकल) व्यापार समझौता कर लेता है, तो यह अतिरिक्त टैरिफ दर 17 प्रतिशत तक कम की जा सकती है।
दूसरी ओर भारत ने अतिरिक्त क्षमता के आरोपों को साफ तौर पर खारिज कर दिया है। वाणिज्य और उद्योग मंत्रालय ने कहा है कि भारत ने पूरी जांच प्रक्रिया के दौरान लगातार यह स्पष्ट किया है कि उसके किसी भी क्षेत्र में 'स्ट्रक्चरल अतिरिक्त क्षमता' नहीं है। मंत्रालय ने भारत-अमेरिका द्विपक्षीय व्यापार समझौते को जल्द से जल्द पूरा करने की अपनी प्रतिबद्धता भी दोहराई है।
फिर भी, भारत के पास सिर्फ रक्षात्मक रुख अपनाने के अलावा कई व्यावहारिक विकल्प मौजूद हैं। आइये जानते हैं कि भारत के पास अब क्या-क्या विकल्प मौजूद हैं, और किस तरह जवाब दे सकता है…
जवाबी टैरिफ
भारत का सबसे सीधा तरीका यह हो सकता है कि वह कुछ चुनिंदा अमेरिकी सामानों पर ज्यादा शुल्क लगा दे। इससे भारतीय बाजार में बेचने वाले अमेरिकी निर्यातकों को नुकसान होगा। भारत ने पहले भी ऐसा किया है। जून 2019 में भारत ने 28 अमेरिकी उत्पादों पर जवाबी टैरिफ लगाए थे। तब अमेरिका ने भारत को मिलने वाली ट्रेड सुविधाएं वापस ले ली थीं और भारतीय स्टील व एल्युमीनियम पर अतिरिक्त शुल्क बनाए रखा था।
इन उत्पादों में बादाम, अखरोट, सेब, चना, दाल, बोरिक एसिड और कुछ रसायन शामिल थे। मकसद था कि अमेरिका के उन क्षेत्रों पर असर पड़े जिनका वहां राजनीतिक और व्यावसायिक महत्व है। भारत ने सितंबर 2023 में छह व्यापार विवादों के बड़े समझौते के बाद ये शुल्क हटा दिए थे। ऐसा जवाब देना संभव है, लेकिन इसमें जोखिम भी है। अमेरिकी निर्यातकों को ज्यादा लागत का सामना करना पड़ सकता है। साथ ही मशीनरी, तकनीक और कृषि उत्पादों के लिए अमेरिका पर निर्भर भारतीय कंपनियों पर भी असर पड़ सकता है। नई टैरिफ लड़ाई बातचीत को और मुश्किल बना सकती है।
मामला विश्व व्यापार संगठन तक ले जाएं
भारत अमेरिका के प्रस्तावित कदमों को विश्व व्यापार संगठन में चुनौती दे सकता है। तर्क यह हो सकता है कि एकतरफा व्यापार प्रतिबंध अंतरराष्ट्रीय नियमों का उल्लंघन करते हैं। अमेरिका 1974 के ट्रेड एक्ट के सेक्शन 301 का इस्तेमाल कर रहा है। यह कानून अमेरिका को उन तरीकों की जांच करने और कार्रवाई करने की अनुमति देता है जिन्हें वह गलत या भेदभावपूर्ण मानता है।
भारत सवाल उठा सकता है कि क्या बिना बहुपक्षीय नियमों का पालन किए घरेलू कानून से अतिरिक्त शुल्क लगाना सही है। भारत और अमेरिका पहले भी स्टील, एल्युमीनियम, सोलर उत्पादों और अन्य मुद्दों पर एक-दूसरे को WTO ले जा चुके हैं। 2023 में छह विवाद बातचीत से सुलझाए गए थे। हालांकि WTO का रास्ता न तेज है और न आसान। इसके विवाद निपटान प्रणाली में समस्याएं हैं क्योंकि अपीलेट बॉडी काम नहीं कर रही।
व्यापार समझौते को बातचीत के हथियार के रूप में इस्तेमाल करें
सबसे व्यावहारिक विकल्प है कि चल रही द्विपक्षीय व्यापार समझौते की बातचीत का इस्तेमाल किया जाए। भारत और अमेरिका बाजार तक पहुंच बढ़ाने और व्यापार बाधाएं कम करने के लिए समझौते पर काम कर रहे हैं। 25 प्रतिशत और सशर्त 17 प्रतिशत के बीच का अंतर भारत के लिए बातचीत में एक अतिरिक्त मुद्दा बन सकता है। भारत टैरिफ में राहत, संवेदनशील क्षेत्रों के लिए छूट, निर्यातकों के लिए ज्यादा निश्चितता और एकतरफा कार्रवाई से सुरक्षा की मांग कर सकता है। वह अमेरिकी बाजार में अपने सामान और सेवाओं के लिए बेहतर पहुंच भी मांग सकता है। भारत सरकार पहले ही कह चुकी है कि व्यापार संबंधी चिंताएं आपसी बातचीत से सुलझानी चाहिए। चुनौती यह होगी कि कृषि और डेयरी जैसे संवेदनशील क्षेत्रों से समझौता किए बिना समझौता हो।
निर्यात बाजारों में विविधता लाएं और अमेरिका पर निर्भरता घटाएं
अमेरिका भारत के सबसे बड़े व्यापारिक साझेदारों में से एक है। इसलिए अमेरिकी मांग को पूरी तरह बदलना मुश्किल है। लेकिन यूरोपीय संघ, ASEAN, अफ्रीका, पश्चिम एशिया और लैटिन अमेरिका के साथ संबंध मजबूत करने से भारतीय निर्यातकों के पास ज्यादा विकल्प आ सकते हैं।
ब्रिटेन और EFTA देशों के साथ हाल के व्यापार समझौते, और अन्य साझेदारों के साथ चल रही बातचीत, निर्यात आधार बढ़ाने के मौके देते हैं। भारत घरेलू मांग बढ़ाने, क्रेडिट सहायता, लॉजिस्टिक्स सुधार और बाजार विविधता कार्यक्रमों के जरिए निर्यातकों की मदद भी बढ़ा सकता है। इससे अमेरिकी टैरिफ का असर तुरंत खत्म नहीं होगा, लेकिन लंबे समय में एक बाजार पर बहुत ज्यादा निर्भर रहने का जोखिम कम हो सकता है।
रणनीतिक और कूटनीतिक साझेदारी के जरिए अमेरिका को चुनौती दें
भारत इस मुद्दे को उन देशों के सामने भी उठा सकता है जो अमेरिका की इसी तरह की जांच का सामना कर रहे हैं, और मिलकर कूटनीतिक जवाब दे सकता है। 25 नवंबर की USTR कार्रवाई में 14 अर्थव्यवस्थाएं शामिल हैं, जिनमें चीन, जापान, दक्षिण कोरिया, वियतनाम, बांग्लादेश और कई यूरोपीय व दक्षिण-पूर्व एशियाई देश हैं। भारत G20, WTO और अन्य बहुपक्षीय मंचों के जरिए पारदर्शी व्यापार नियमों की वकालत कर सकता है और संरक्षणवादी नीतियों का विरोध कर सकता है। वह चीन का विकल्प ढूंढ रहे देशों के साथ व्यापार और निवेश साझेदारी भी मजबूत कर सकता है।

title: अभिजीत दीपके और आशुतोष रांका पर भी लगा दिया गया सौरभ दास वाला ‘बैन’, नहीं छोड़ सकते देश
description: कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के तीनों बड़े नेताओं अभिजीत दीपके, सौरभ दास और आशुतोष रांका के खिलाफ लुकआउट नोटिस जारी किया गया है।
author: Sudhir Jha
content:
अभिजीत दीपके और आशुतोष रांका पर भी लगा दिया गया सौरभ दास वाला ‘बैन’, नहीं छोड़ सकते देश
कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के तीनों बड़े नेताओं अभिजीत दीपके, सौरभ दास और आशुतोष रांका के खिलाफ लुकआउट नोटिस जारी किया गया है।
कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी (सीजेपी) के नेताओं की मुश्किलें बढ़ गईं हैं। सीजेपी सह-संयोजक सौरभ दास के अलावा अभिजीत दीपके और आशुतोष रांका के खिलाफ भी लुकआउट नोटिस जारी किया गया है। इसका मतलब है कि सीजेपी के तीनों बड़े नेताओं के देश छोड़ने पर फिलहाल 'बैन' लग गया है।
इंडिया टुडे की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक,मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त (सीईसी) ज्ञानेश कुमार के खिलाफ मुंबई के शिवाजी पार्क में 2 अक्टूबर को बिना इजाजत किए गए विरोध प्रदर्शन को लेकर दर्ज एफआईआर के सिलसिले में लुकआउट सर्कुलर जारी किया गया है। दीपके और रांका के खिलाफ लुकआउट नोटिस की बात ऐसे समय पर सामने आई है जब गुरुवार को ही दिल्ली हाई कोर्ट में बताया गया कि सौरभ दास के खिलाफ लुकआउट सर्कुलर जारी किया गया है।
लुकआउट सर्कुलर (एलओसी) एक अलर्ट है जो भारतीय आव्रजन चेकपॉइंट्स जैसे अंतरराष्ट्रीय एयरपोर्ट, बंदरगाहों और सीमाओं पर मौजूद चेकपॉइंट्स पर भेजा जाता है। जब यह किसी व्यक्ति के नाम जारी किया जाता है तो इसका मतलब होता है कि वह देश से बाहर नहीं जा सकता है।
क्या हुआ था 2 अक्टूबर को?
सीजेपी नेताओं ने मुंबई पुलिस की ओर से अनुमति नहीं दिए जाने के बाद भी सीईसी ज्ञानेश कुमार के खिलाफ शिवाजी पार्क में जुटान किया था। प्रदर्शन के बाद सीजेपी नेताओं ने मुंबई पुलिस की तारीफ की थी और दिल्ली पुलिस पर तंज कसा था कि उन्हें सीख लेनी चाहिए। हालांकि बाद में मुंबई पुलिस ने प्रदर्शन के आयोजकों और 400-500 अज्ञात प्रदर्शनकारियों के खिलाफ एफआईआर दर्ज की गई। पुलिस ने बीएनएस की धारा 189 और 223 के तहत केस दर्ज किया। अब इसी मामले में लुकआउट सर्कुलर जारी करने की बात भी सामने आई है।
सौरभ दास को लंदन जाने से रोका गया, अदालत में आई एलओसी वाली बात
सीजेपी के सह-संयोजक सौरभ दास को सोमवार देर रात लंदन जाने से रोक दिया गया। बुधवार को विदेश मंत्रालय ने सौरभ दास के पासपोर्ट में कुछ विसंगतियों की शिकायत मिलने के बात कही। गुरुवार को दिल्ली हाई कोर्ट में सीजेपी नेता की याचिका पर सुनवाई के दौरान केंद्र सरकार ने बताया कि सौरभ दास के खिलाफ एलओसी जारी किया गया है। सुनवाई के दौरान केंद्र सरकार के वकील ने कहा कि दास के खिलाफ एलओसी जारी करने के लिए महाराष्ट्र पुलिस की ओर से अनुरोध किया गया था और यह 22-23 नवंबर की दरमियानी रात को जारी किया गया था। दूसरी तरफ सौरभ दास को अपने पासपोर्ट में कथित विसंगतियों का जवाब देना है और इसको लेकर साक्ष्य पेश करने होंगे। केंद्र सरकार के वकील ने दलील दी कि पासपोर्ट में बताई गई कथित विसंगतियों का दास की नागरिकता पर असर पड़ सकता है।

title: फौजी पिता ने बेटे की शादी को बनाया यादगार, राजगढ़ में हेलीकॉप्टर से लाए दुल्हन
description: Helicopter Wedding: पाटन खुर्द से आलमपुर (बापची) तक हेलीकॉप्टर से पहुंचे दूल्हा-परिजन, दुल्हन की विदाई भी हेलीकॉप्टर से, दोनों गांवों में उमड़ी भीड़।
author: Shailendra Sharma
content:
groom bride helicopter wedding, बेटे प्रशांत के साथ पिता बबलू सिंह चौहान व दूल्हा-दुल्हन (Source-Patrika)
Rajgarh Helicopter Wedding: बेटे की शादी को यादगार बनाने के लिए एक पिता ने ऐसा इंतजाम किया, जो क्षेत्र में चर्चा का विषय बन गया है। मामला मध्यप्रदेश के राजगढ़ जिले के पचोर के पाटन खुर्द का है, यहां रहने वाले फौजी बबलू सिंह चौहान के बेटे प्रशांत की बारात गुरुवार को हेलीकॉप्टर से आलमपुर (बापची) पहुंची। सुबह हेलीकॉप्टर पाटन खुर्द में उतरा, जहां से दूल्हा प्रशांत सहित परिजन सवार होकर विवाह स्थल के लिए रवाना हुए। हेलीकॉप्टर को देखने के लिए गांव में सुबह से ही लोगों की भीड़ जुटने लगी थी।
हेलीकॉप्टर से लाए दुल्हन
पाटन खुर्द से हेलीकॉप्टर से दूल्हा प्रशांत आलमपुर (बापची) पहुंचा जहां वैवाहिक रस्में संपन्न होने के बाद दूल्हा प्रशांत दुल्हन को विदा कराकर हेलीकॉप्टर से ही अपने गांव पाटन खुर्द लेकर आया। बारात के हेलीकॉप्टर से पहुंचने और दुल्हन की विदाई भी हेलीकॉप्टर से होने का नजारा दोनों गांवों में आकर्षण का केंद्र बना रहा। हेलीकॉप्टर को उतरते और उड़ान भरते देखने के लिए ग्रामीण, युवा और बच्चे बड़ी संख्या में जुटे। कई लोगों ने इस खास पल को मोबाइल कैमरों में कैद किया। हेलीकॉप्टर से आई बारात पूरे जिले में चर्चा का विषय बनी हुई है।
फौजी पिता बबलू सिंह चौहान ने बताया कि वो बेटे प्रशांत की शादी को यादगार बनाना चाहते थे इसलिए उन्होंने हेलीकॉप्टर से बारात ले जाने और दुल्हन की विदाई का इंतजाम किया। शादी को खास बनाने की इस पहल ने समारोह को अलग पहचान दी। हेलीकॉप्टर की आवाजाही और आयोजन के दौरान उमड़ी भीड़ को देखते हुए प्रशासन की ओर से भी सुरक्षा एवं व्यवस्थाओं को लेकर तैयारी की गई। हेलीकॉप्टर के उतरने और उड़ान भरने वाले स्थान पर लोगों की आवाजाही व्यवस्थित रखने तथा सुरक्षा व्यवस्था बनाए रखने के इंतजाम किए गए, जिससे आयोजन शांतिपूर्ण तरीके से संपन्न हुआ।

title: Bemetara: 13 दिन की नवजात बच्ची के साथ अनशन पर बैठीं BJP पार्षद, सरकारी जमीन पर कब्जे का आरोप
description: Chandni Roshan Dutta: बेमेतरा में सरकारी जमीन पर अतिक्रमण के आरोप को लेकर भाजपा पार्षद चांदनी रोशन दत्ता 13 दिन की नवजात बच्ची के साथ नगर पालिका के सामने आमरण अनशन पर बैठ गई हैं। उन्होंने कार्रवाई होने तक अनशन जारी रखने की बात कही है।
author: Shradha Jaiswal
content:
Hindi News / Chhattisgarh / Bemetara / Bemetara: 13 दिन की नवजात बच्ची के साथ अनशन पर बैठीं BJP पार्षद, सरकारी जमीन पर कब्जे का आरोप
Bemetara: 13 दिन की नवजात बच्ची के साथ अनशन पर बैठीं BJP पार्षद, सरकारी जमीन पर कब्जे का आरोप
Chandni Roshan Dutta: बेमेतरा में सरकारी जमीन पर अतिक्रमण के आरोप को लेकर भाजपा पार्षद चांदनी रोशन दत्ता 13 दिन की नवजात बच्ची के साथ नगर पालिका के सामने आमरण अनशन पर बैठ गई हैं। उन्होंने कार्रवाई होने तक अनशन जारी रखने की बात कही है।
Bemetara: 13 दिन की नवजात बच्ची के साथ अनशन पर बैठीं BJP पार्षद(photo-patrika)
Bemetara: छत्तीसगढ़ के बेमेतरा में सरकारी जमीन पर अतिक्रमण का मामला गरमा गया है। वार्ड क्रमांक 08 की भाजपा पार्षद चांदनी रोशन दत्ता अपनी महज 13 दिन की नवजात बच्ची को लेकर नगर पालिका कार्यालय के सामने आमरण अनशन पर बैठ गई हैं। पार्षद ने नेशनल हाईवे-30 से लगी करोड़ों रुपये की बेशकीमती शासकीय जमीन पर कब्जे का आरोप लगाया है। उनका कहना है कि इस मामले में दो बार शिकायत करने के बावजूद नगर पालिका प्रशासन ने कोई कार्रवाई नहीं की। अब उन्होंने अतिक्रमण हटने तक अनशन जारी रखने का ऐलान किया है।
BJP Councillor Protest: नेशनल हाईवे-30 से लगी सरकारी जमीन पर कब्जे का आरोप
दरअसल, बेमेतरा नगर पालिका क्षेत्र के वार्ड क्रमांक 08 की पार्षद चांदनी रोशन दत्ता ने दौलत राजपूत, नीरज चांडक और अवधेश विश्वकर्मा पर नेशनल हाईवे-30 से लगी शासकीय जमीन पर अतिक्रमण करने का आरोप लगाया है। पार्षद के मुताबिक, सड़क से लगी इस जमीन की कीमत करोड़ों रुपये है। उन्होंने दावा किया है कि जमीन के सरकारी होने से संबंधित दस्तावेज भी उनके पास मौजूद हैं।
दो बार शिकायत के बाद भी कार्रवाई नहीं होने का दावा
पार्षद चांदनी रोशन दत्ता का कहना है कि उन्होंने सरकारी जमीन पर अतिक्रमण के मामले में पहले भी दो बार नगर पालिका प्रशासन से शिकायत की थी। इसके बावजूद अब तक कोई ठोस कार्रवाई नहीं हुई। प्रशासन की कथित अनदेखी से नाराज होकर उन्होंने नगर पालिका कार्यालय के सामने आमरण अनशन शुरू कर दिया है। इस दौरान वह अपनी 13 दिन की नवजात बच्ची को भी साथ लेकर बैठी हैं।
अतिक्रमण हटाने की मांग, अनशन जारी रखने का ऐलान
पार्षद ने मांग की है कि नेशनल हाईवे-30 से लगी शासकीय जमीन पर किए गए कथित अवैध निर्माण और बनाई गई दीवारों को तत्काल हटाया जाए। उन्होंने स्पष्ट किया है कि जब तक जमीन से अतिक्रमण नहीं हटाया जाता, तब तक उनका आमरण अनशन जारी रहेगा।
नगर पालिका प्रशासन की प्रतिक्रिया का इंतजार
इस पूरे मामले में फिलहाल नगर पालिका प्रशासन की ओर से कोई आधिकारिक प्रतिक्रिया सामने नहीं आई है। अब देखना होगा कि पार्षद के आमरण अनशन और सरकारी जमीन पर अतिक्रमण के आरोपों को लेकर प्रशासन क्या कदम उठाता है और मामले में कार्रवाई कब तक होती है।

title: Nitin Gadkari Enjoys Bengali Jhalmuri With Suvendu Adhikari At Kolaghat, Video Goes Viral
description: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari enjoys Bengali jhalmuri with West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari at an NHAI event in Kolaghat, where he launches 22 highway projects worth Rs 8,700 crore.
author: Swastika Sruti
content:
Nitin Gadkari Enjoys Bengali Jhalmuri With Suvendu Adhikari At Kolaghat, Video Goes Viral
Union Minister of Road Transport and Highways, Nitin Gadkari, savored a platter of popular street food from West Bengal called Jhal Muri, in company of Chief Minister of West Bengal, Suvendu Adhikari, at an NHAI program at Kolaghat, Purba Medinipur district on Thursday.
In his social media post, Gadkari uploaded a video of the incident where he could be seen eating the street delicacy along with a conversation with a street vendor. In addition, the Union Minister had thanked CM Suvendu Adhikari for providing the popular snack at the program.
AI-generated summary, reviewed by editors
In his post, the minister wrote, "During the NHAI program at Kolaghat, Purba Medinipur, West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari has arranged 'jhalmuri'. I relished the snack along with him."
The video is drawing attention to the popular street food from West Bengal that includes puffed rice, green chillies, spices and much more.
 पश्चिम बंगाल के कोलाघाट, पूर्व मेदिनीपुर में राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के कार्यक्रम के दौरान मुख्यमंत्री श्री @SuvenduWB जी ने झालमुड़ी की व्यवस्था की थी। उनके साथ झालमुड़ी का आनंद लिया।#झालमुड़ी #WestBengal https://t.co/505aRIFvtU
— Nitin Gadkari (@nitin_gadkari) November 26, 2026
Nitin Gadkari And Suvendu Adhikari Enjoy Jhalmuri At Kolaghat
During Gadkari and Adhikari's visit to the Kolaghat district, the programme involved their enjoyment of the local snack.
Jhalmuri is one of the most popular street snacks in Bengal. Jhalmuri is usually made through a mixture of puffed rice and chopped onions, green chilies, mustard oil, spices and more. The vendor usually makes the dish as per the customer's choice.
In his video, Gadkari was seen enjoying the snack in conversation with the vendor. Gadkari later posted about the same on social media stating that the West Bengal Chief Minister had arranged it for him.
PM Modi Had Also Stopped For Jhalmuri During Bengal Election Campaign
Gadkari's jhalmuri moment also brings back memories of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to West Bengal during the Assembly election campaign in April.
During his campaign visit to Jhargram, Modi made an unscheduled stop at a local stall and enjoyed jhalmuri. The moment attracted considerable attention on social media and became one of the widely discussed visuals from his campaign.
The snack has since featured in another high-profile political moment in the state, this time involving Gadkari and Adhikari.
Gadkari Launches 22 Highway Projects Worth Rs 8,700 Crore
Apart from the food moment, the NHAI programme at Kolaghat focused on road infrastructure development in West Bengal. Gadkari launched 22 national highway projects involving a combined investment of Rs 8,700 crore. He also announced a larger road development plan worth Rs 1 lakh crore for the state.
The projects are part of the Centre's efforts to expand and improve road connectivity in West Bengal.

title: WhatsApp Users Get New Feature To Schedule Messages Even When Phone Is Switched Off
description: WhatsApp is rolling out a message scheduling feature that lets users set a date and time to send text messages, photos and videos in individual and group chats.
author: Madhuri Adnal
content:
WhatsApp Users Get New Feature To Schedule Messages Even When Phone Is Switched Off
WhatsApp is working on a feature that will let users decide when a message should reach the recipient, instead of sending it immediately. The new option will allow users to draft messages and set a date and time for their delivery.
Announcing the update on November 25, the Meta-owned messaging platform described scheduled messages as one of the features users had been asking for. Messages can be set to go out between 10 minutes and 14 days after they are scheduled.
AI-generated summary, reviewed by editors
The feature may be useful for people who want to send birthday wishes at midnight, remind someone about an appointment or share a work-related message without having to be online at the time of delivery.
Users will be able to schedule messages in both personal and group conversations. The option will also support photos and videos, not just text. WhatsApp has not confirmed whether the feature will be extended to Channels.
The rollout will take place globally over the coming weeks. Users may have to wait until the update reaches their devices before they can start scheduling messages.
With this addition, WhatsApp is catching up with messaging services such as Telegram and Signal, which already allow users to schedule messages.
The announcement comes shortly after Kunal Shah took over as the platform's CEO. Shah has spoken about making WhatsApp easier to use, adding more artificial intelligence features and expanding its fintech offerings.
India remains WhatsApp's biggest market, with more than 500 million users. Globally, the platform has a user base of over three billion.
In an earlier statement, Shah said the company had been listening to users to understand what they expected from the app. He said the focus was on helping people stay connected and making it easier for them to get things done through WhatsApp.
How to schedule a message on WhatsApp
Once the feature is available on your phone, make sure you have installed the latest version of WhatsApp. You can then schedule a message by following these steps:
Open WhatsApp and enter the individual or group chat where you want to send the message.
- Type the message.
- Press and hold the send button.
- Select the date and time at which you want the message to be delivered.
- Confirm your choice.
The message will be delivered at the selected time and will appear in the recipient's chat like any other WhatsApp message.
Users will also be able to check their scheduled messages in one place. If they change their mind, they can delete a message before it is sent.
There is no need to keep the phone switched on until the scheduled delivery time. WhatsApp says the message will still reach the recipient at the chosen time even if the sender's phone is switched off or its battery runs out.
Privacy protection will also remain in place. Scheduled messages will use WhatsApp's end-to-end encryption, which means only the sender and recipient can read their contents. WhatsApp will not be able to read them either.

title: Bihar News: Rajgir Zoo & Nature Safari to Receive Prestigious SKOCH Award for Eco-Tourism and Innovation
description: Bihar's Rajgir Zoo and Nature Safari receive the SKOCH Award for sustainable eco-tourism and governance innovation, highlighting conservation and environmental education.
author: Oneindia Staff
content:
Bihar News: Rajgir Zoo & Nature Safari to Receive Prestigious SKOCH Award for Eco-Tourism and Innovation
Bihar's Rajgir Zoo and Nature Safari are honoured with the SKOCH Award for sustainable eco-tourism and governance innovation. The facilities integrate conservation, biodiversity education, and modern technology to enhance visitor experience while protecting wildlife.
Patna, Nov 26:* Bihar's efforts in eco-tourism and wildlife conservation are set to receive another major national recognition. Rajgir Zoo and Nature Safari will be honoured with the prestigious SKOCH Award for its initiatives in sustainable eco-tourism and innovation in governance. The award will be presented at a ceremony in New Delhi on December 19, 2026.
The achievement will bring further recognition to the state's efforts to promote tourism alongside environmental conservation under the leadership of Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary.
AI-generated summary, reviewed by editors
The government has made a unique effort to ensure that Rajgir Zoo and Nature Safari are not confined to tourism and entertainment. They are also integrated with wildlife conservation, biodiversity and environmental education.
Spread across approximately 191.12 hectares, Rajgir Zoo Safari is Bihar's first zoo safari, inaugurated on February 16, 2022. Separate safari zones have been developed for lions, tigers, bears, leopards and herbivorous animals. Facilities such as an exotic aviary, a 180-degree theatre and an open-air theatre have also become major attractions for visitors.
A unique blend of adventure and nature
Rajgir Nature Safari, spread across approximately 550 hectares, offers visitors an exciting experience amidst nature. Facilities developed here include a glass skywalk bridge, a suspension bridge, zipline, sky biking, a butterfly park, a medicinal plant garden and a cactus garden. These activities promote tourism while also creating awareness about nature and environmental conservation.
Modern technology strengthens management
Modern technology is being used extensively at the zoo and nature safari to ensure visitor convenience and wildlife safety. Facilities such as QR code-based ticketing, slot management, real-time GPS tracking of safari vehicles, a central control room and CCTV surveillance have been implemented. Digital storytelling and interactive platforms are also used to educate visitors about biodiversity and wildlife conservation.
In recognition of the effective use of technology, Zoo Safari Director Ram Sundar M was conferred the "Best Use of Technology" award in September.
Eco-tourism visitors rise over two years
According to data from the Environment, Forest and Climate Change Department, the number of tourists visiting eco-tourism destinations across Bihar increased from 55.20 lakh in 2022-23 to 74.90 lakh in 2024-25. Over the same period, visitors to Rajgir Nature Safari rose from approximately 1.59 lakh to 3 lakh.
This growth reflects the rising popularity of Bihar's eco-tourism destinations and the success of initiatives that combine tourism development with environmental conservation.
