title: E20 Petrol Row: Karnataka Seeks Transparency in Ethanol Blending
description: Karnataka flags excess ethanol in petrol, questions E20 fuel standards and demands greater transparency from the Centre and oil companies.
author: Sujay B.M.
content:
The ongoing tussle between the Karnataka government and oil marketing companies (OMCs) over the exact quantum of ethanol being blended in petrol is the latest chapter in the crucial debate over E20 fuel (a blended fuel containing 80 per cent petrol and 20 per cent ethanol).
A controversy erupted on November 6, when Karnataka’s Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Minister Rizwan Arshad claimed that 11 of the 14 samples tested at a lab certified by National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL) and the International Organisation for Standardisation (ISO) exceeded the stipulated 20 per cent ethanol level, with one sample even containing as much as 31.2 per cent ethanol.
In response, Indian Oil Corporation Ltd (IOCL), Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL), and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd (HPCL) brushed off the claims, saying they were “not supported by testing conducted in accordance with the prescribed statutory and technical procedures”.
The OMCs alleged that the testing had been conducted at a third-party laboratory, and not one specified under the Control Order. They also claimed that the certificates did not provide the complete technical details necessary to independently verify the reported ethanol content.
In a strong rebuttal on November 9, Arshad said that the State government had followed the IS 17021:2018 standard cited by the OMCs for testing ethanol content. He noted that the State government had provided 63 samples to the OMCs’ own laboratories and sought the percentage of ethanol blend in each sample.
In an exclusive interview with Frontline, published on November 13, Arshad said that the OMCs did not give a “clear answer” on the issue of the percentage of ethanol blended for any of the 63 samples.
He said: “That made us suspicious. What options were left with us? We had to collect more samples as per the law, [samples that were] also jointly collected by all three parties, duly signed in the proforma. The testing was conducted by an NABL-accredited third-party lab. The result was that ethanol up to 31.2 per cent was being blended.”
While Congress leader Rahul Gandhi picked up the issue and questioned Prime Minister Narendra Modi about the quantity of ethanol in petrol, the Congress-led UDF government in Keralam followed in Karnataka’s footsteps, ordering a similar investigation to ascertain the quantity of ethanol in petrol.
Minister’s demands from Centre
In his latest move, Arshad wrote to Union Petroleum and Natural Gas Minister Hardeep Singh Puri on November 18, recollecting the recent developments, and placed five demands before him.
They include displaying the actual percentage of ethanol blend in every petrol pump and bill, providing an option to choose between pure petrol, E10, and E20 until vehicles are fully compatible with higher blends, establishing a third-party mechanism to randomly test fuel quantity, and creating a dedicated fund to compensate consumers whose vehicles undergo damage due to usage of petrol with ethanol levels above the prescribed limits.
Speaking to Frontline, Bhamy Shenoy, a petroleum industry veteran and founding-working president of Mysuru Grahakara Parishat, said that the ethanol level depended on the part of the tank from which the fuel was drawn.
He said: “Since water and ethanol are heavier than petrol, they sink to the bottom. So, ethanol quantity at the top will be much lower, while it will have to be higher at the bottom. Since the nozzle goes to the bottom of the tank, samples need to be taken from the top, middle, and bottom to test ethanol content.”
He added that the issue could be resolved only through neutral, third-party testing by reputed institutes such as the Indian Institute of Science or the Indian Institute of Technology.
While allegations of over-blending act as the tipping point, the larger controversy revolves around whether E20 petrol is needed in its current form. The controversy began in 2025 itself, when widespread blending of 20 per cent ethanol in fuel began. The government faced outrage for having advanced its earlier plan of implementing E20 by 2030 by five years.
Since vehicles compatible with E20 petrol were being produced only from 2023 onwards, concerns grew that earlier vehicles may face trouble, including mileage issues and increasing frequency of vehicular repair. (Vehicles produced from 2008 are E10 compliant, while those produced before 2008 are built for pure petrol.)
In a press release on August 12, 2025, the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas defended the 20 per cent blending of ethanol, saying it benefited the rural economy, eliminating sugar cane arrears and improving the viability of maize cultivation. “More income to farmers has not only contributed to furthering their well-being but has also helped decisively tackle the challenge of suicides by farmers. It may be recalled that in areas like Vidarbha, farmer’ suicides were widespread a few years ago,” the release said.
In June 2026 there were complaints over a drop in vehicle efficiency that raised suspicions over the usage of E20 fuel. On July 28, the Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers (SIAM) wrote to the Union Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, raising concerns over E20 fuel.
SIAM letter and retraction
In a letter, which Frontline accessed, SIAM said: “SIAM members are observing huge increases in the issues in customer vehicle parts and replacement (like fuel injectors, duel pump, EGR valve, exhaust and parts that are in direct contact with fuel or engine emission gases). Investigations of field failure vehicle parts reveal the failure is due to corrosion or wear caused by high chloride presence which is traced to the fuel used. Deposits in failed parts also have shown presence of chlorides (sic).”
Pointing out that chloride is “highly detrimental” to engine parts, SIAM explained that including chloride limits in fuel specifications and implementing quality control was imperative to avoid chloride-related failures in customer vehicles.
However, SIAM retracted this move within a week and withdrew its earlier communication on August 4.
In a public clarification, SIAM said: “The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas has also instituted 3 ppm guidelines for chloride/sulphur as a precautionary measure for all ethanol being blended into the petrol supply chain. All of these steps fully meet the needs of the automobile industry. Further, we understand from OMCs that checks have been instituted, including water ingress testing about 8-12 times a day in over 87,000 outlets and after each instance of rain near petrol pumps.”
It added: “There is no cause for concern arising from the matter reported as these issues have been routinely addressed over the past several decades between the auto industry and OMCs.”
Critics accused the Central government of pressuring SIAM into withdrawing its earlier objections. On Instagram, the political analyst Tehseen Poonawalla accused the Central government of trying to “hide this letter” and attempting to take down everything from the Internet, including news reports about this letter.
A major concern about the entire controversy of implementing the E20 policy five years ahead of schedule has been the lack of discussions, either in Parliament or in public forums.
Industry opinion
An oil industry veteran, who spoke to Frontline on the condition of anonymity, said that a major push for ethanol could result in a clash between the sugar, alcohol, and automobile industries.
He said: “In principle, ethanol blending in petrol has been accepted, and Brazil is the global leader in this. While E20 has been mandated in India, there are allegations of extra mixing, resulting in the consumer getting a raw deal. We need a discussion between the affected parties on the pros and cons of this policy decision. If any side stands to suffer, they must be informed about it in advance.”
Stating that there are concerns on side effects, potential engine issues, and extra wear and tear, the veteran sought a white paper on the entire issue. It is widely considered that biofuels are necessary at a time when oil is becoming more expensive and there are geopolitical risks in gaining access to it.
The practice is also expected to lower emissions and support the agricultural sector. In fact, the ethanol blended petrol (EBP) programme that was initiated in 2002-2003 by the Atal Bihari Vajpayee-led NDA government was subsequently expanded by the UPA government that succeeded it.
The latest controversy revolves around the incompatibility of a majority of existing vehicles with E20 petrol and the need to develop physical infrastructure in petrol pumps to ensure proper supply of E20 fuel.
“We are not against blending ethanol with petrol. However, engines should be able to digest ethanol-inclusive petrol. Petrol pumps must possess the required infrastructure to disburse such fuel,” Rizwan told Frontline.
Shenoy argued that cellulosic ethanol, which is prepared from cornstalks, grasses, miscanthus, bamboo, or woodchips should be prioritised over corn ethanol.
Gadkari under scanner
Within the ruling NDA government, Union Minister of Road Transport and Highways Nitin Gadkari of the BJP has arguably been the biggest ambassador of the current E20 policy. During the 14th Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) Bioenergy Summit held on November 17, Gadkari batted for ethanol blending in fuel.
In a post on X, the Minister said: “Addressed the 14th CII #Bioenergy Summit, highlighting how scaling bioenergy can drive cleaner energy, reduce fossil fuel dependence, boost farmer incomes, create rural jobs, and unlock value from agricultural waste.”
During the KPMG ENRich 2026 Conference at New Delhi in November, the Minister announced the commercial launch of the 100 per cent ethanol powered Toyota Innova Hycross and urged major automobile manufacturers to adopt flex-fuel engines. However, critics have slammed Gadkari’s push for ethanol from a seat of power as a “conflict of interest”, pointing out that his children are top executives and major shareholders in companies producing ethanol.
While his elder son Nikhil Gadkari is managing director of CIAN Agro Industries & Infrastructure Ltd, his younger son Sarang Gadkari is a director of Manas Agro Industries and Infrastructure Ltd.
“Nitin Gadkariji was promoting ethanol and speaks more about ethanol than the Petroleum Minister himself. Let him propagate ethanol and its advantages. However, his own children are running ethanol-producing factories, and he as a Minister is promoting it. There is some sort of a conflict of interest here,” Rizwan told Frontline.
Speaking to Frontline, Poonawalla said that ethanol is the “biggest scam” in India, adding that the huge number of ethanol distilleries in Karnataka and Maharashtra had contributed to the ongoing drought situation in both States.
On the Centre’s claim that sugarcane farmers benefit from increased ethanol blending, Poonawalla said: “Sugarcane farmers didn’t get any money from ethanol. In fact, Karnataka’s sugarcane farmers are on the streets. By growing water-intensive sugarcane, they have harmed India’s food security. We are now importing more oil and pulses and even sugar, a commodity which India used to export. So, we are not saving foreign reserves.”
Global ethanol blending trends
Across the world, ethanol blending has been in vogue for decades. As many as 19 European Union countries, including France, Germany, Belgium, Denmark, Poland, the Czech Republic, and Estonia, and non-EU countries like the United Kingdom and Norway, have rolled out the E10 policy.
However, the leading global practitioner of blending ethanol with fuel is Brazil. It began ethanol blending in 1931, mandating a minimum of 5 per cent blending, extendable up to 10 per cent.
Following the oil crisis in 1973 that exposed Brazil’s vulnerability in the energy sector, the Proalcool policy was rolled out in 1975, ramping up the ethanol blending percentage to 20-22 per cent. Currently, Brazil uses E32 petrol (blending 32 per cent anhydrous ethanol with 68 per cent petrol). Alongside, it also supplies E100 (95 per cent ethanol and 5 per cent water) fuel.
The policy has been successful as Brazil uses flex-fuel vehicles that can run on different types of fuel, which consumers decide based on a number of factors.
In his letter to Puri, Rizwan also highlighted the concerns surrounding the quantity of petrol being dispensed at fuel stations. Of the 5,946 retail outlets in Karnataka, 805 were inspected, and 768 required recalibration. Of the 3,071 nozzles tested, 2,618 showed deviation from their rated accuracy. A total of 101 outlets were found dispensing beyond the maximum permissible error and were booked, and fines totalling Rs.6.66 lakh were collected.
The Minister also took severe exception to Notification GSR 905(E) dated December 18, 2025, which doubles the mandatory verification interval for petrol and diesel dispensers from 12 months to 24 months, meaning that a faulty meter may now go unchecked for up to two full years. He said that the existing annual cycle itself was “barely adequate”.

title: Did Facebook work with USAID to bring about ‘regime change’ in India during Covid-19: Here is what analysis of internal documents revealed
description: The sinister behind-the-scene association of Facebook and the US government in implementing/ facilitating its influence campaigns in countries like India cannot be ignored, especially if we take into the account the political developments during the Covid-19 pandemic. | OpIndia News
category: Editor's picks, Featured, News Reports, Politics
author: OpIndia Staff
content:
On Thursday (26th November), the co-founder of Wikipedia, Larry Sanger, informed that he has transformed the files of the now-defunct United States Agency for International Development (USAID) into a searchable database.
The controversial US government agency, which is responsible for regime change operations and civil discontent in foreign countries, has 23 documents that make direct references to India.
OpIndia went through these files and found that many of them highlight collaboration with Facebook for carrying out ‘activities’ in India between February 2020 and June 2021. Coincidentally, it was the same period when the country was faced with the deadly COVID-19 pandemic.
While a plain reading of the documents can give the impression that Facebook or USAID wanted to carry out relief work in India, the activites of these organisations reveal a different picture.
Facebook-IEFS workshop targeting Indian minorities, tribals and ‘marginalised castes’
One of the documents [pdf] that OpIndia unearthed through Larry Sanger’s searchable USAID database talked about a partnership between Facebook and International Foundation for Electoral Systems (IFES).
They jointly conducted 8 workshops involving 150 Non-governmental Organisations (NGOs) in 12 Indian States as part of Facebook’s Trusted Partner Program.
A few targets mentioned in the document include ‘minorities’, ‘tribals’, ‘marginalised castes’, ‘artists’ and ‘media.’ Interestinly, these are the groups that are often used to exploit fault lines and create social unrest.
To add to it, the workshop focused on countering what they dubbed as ‘disinformation’, ‘hate speech’ and ‘hate spin.’ It may be recalled how social media platforms resorted to brazen censorship during the pandemic to counter alternate beliefs, opinions and ideologies.
Information about this collaboration between IFES and Facebook was featured in the ‘USAID Asia Presentation.’
UNICEF Covid-19 influence campaign with Facebook as collaborator
Another document [pdf] accessed by OpIndia through Larry Sanger’s searchable USAID database was titled ‘Scaling up COVID-19 emergency prevention and response efforts in India.’
A funding of $2 million (roughly ₹18.5 crores) was provided to the UNICEF (United Nations Children’s Fund) between June 2021 and July 2022 for its operations in India.
“The current COVID-19 emergency in India is being exacerbated by widespread mis/dis-information and associated stigma and discrimination causing social divides,” the document claimed.
The aim of the year-long project was described as “intensifying efforts to strengthen COVIDprevention behaviors, dispel myths, associated stigma and dis/misinformation related to COVID-19 disease.”
One of the strategies outlined in the document was to “train a variety of stakeholders for the implementation of communications actions in both urban and rural areas such as frontline workers, Self Help Groups, faith-based organizations, youth networks.“
Other strategies include onboarding tribal leaders, artists federations and cultural groups. The USAID document highlighted a window of opportunity to collaborate with Facebook to ‘influence behaviours’ through intensive social media campaigns.
It noted, “Using social media tools for field level capacity building will help enhance reach and impact…Actively monitor social media and mainstream media to identify any misinformation and clarify sources for authentic information…Track rumors through social media and interactive media (radio call-in shows, hotlines, interactive voice and response (IVR) etc) to inform and shape the Government of India communication strategy on vaccines.“
Email exchanges show Facebook interested in funding USAID effort
A document [pdf], accessed by OpIndia, showed email exchanges between USAID’s Deputy Assistant Administrator, Anjali Kaur and Facebook officials Ajit Mohan and Brian Rice.
“FB as a company is very open to making a contribution,” the email dated 26th April 2021 read. The subject of the mail was – “Connecting the dots between FB US policy team and USAID.” There were discussions about send oxygen plants, tankers and genome kits to India.
While at the outset it appears as a collaboration for Covid-19 relief work in India, it must be noted that Facebook founder Mark Zuckerberg conceded to to assisting the Biden-Harris administration in weaponising political censorship to curtail free speech on its platforms during the COVID-19 pandemic.
The sinsiter behind-the-scene association of the tech giant and the US government in implementing/ facilitating its influence campaigns in countries like India cannot be ignored, especially if we take into the account the political developments at that time (which are discussed later in the report).
In another set of email exchanges [pdf] between USAID official Satish Menon and Facebook officials, he informed, “The REVIVE Alliance is supporting the informal sector whose livelihoods are impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic, with a focus on women and youth. The REVIVE Alliance facilitates skills development, technical assistance, vocational skills, business training, and market linkages to complement the financial support…Launched in October 2020 by Samhita-Collective Good Foundation and supported by USAID, Omidyar Network India, Michael & Susan Dell Foundation, British High Commission, the United Nations Development Programme India.”
USAID trained Indian youth and explored partnership with Facebook
OpIndia also accessed a note [pdf] from USAID database, through Larry Sanger’s website, that proposed training Indian youth between August 2021 and August 2024.
A sum of $10 million -15 million was earmarked for the project, which was to be implemented through JHPIEGO (Johns Hopkins Program for International Education in Gynecology and Obstetrics).
The goal of the influence campaign was stated as follows – “Support the Young people of India to realize their full potential by making informed and responsible decisions for their health and wellbeing.”
The USAID note highlighted opportunities to partner with Facebook on an ‘Adolescent/young people Innovation platform’.
It claimed, “The needs identified through the youth voices will inspire the ideation of solutions. We can also co-fund the winning innovative solutions that address the needs of adolescents/young people. The innovation platform will aim to demonstrate new ideas/solutions or scale up existing ones…Youth voices will inform and guide the platform on solutions that meet their needs.”
Later, the US government agency highlighted how it can collaborate with the tech giant to build ‘leadership skills’ for youths. “While youth led advocacy will help to understand youth needs and enhance their voices in decision making, this would also ensure that the youth are given the skills and the opportunity to enhance their employability and decision making skills.”
Facebook and its anti-India activities during Covid-19 era
In February 2020, the central government issued fresh guidelines for social media and OTT platforms. One of the most significant provisions of these guidelines was that if the social media platforms did not comply with the provisions prescribed in the guidelines, it would attract penal provisions as per the Information Technology Act.
Facebook attempted to sidestep the guidelines as much as they could. OpIndia investigation had found that it had no grievance officer, as required by the Indian law (besides one on paper). There was no human intervention as far as resolving grievances are concerned and when users raised a complaint, they were encountered with an automated response.
At that time, a Facebook spokesperson had claimed, “We aim to comply with the provisions of the IT [Information Technology] rules and continue to discuss a few of the issues which need more engagement with the government. Pursuant to the IT Rules, we are working to implement operational processes and improve efficiencies.”
While Facebook continued to flout Indian laws, it engaged in blatant political censorship at the directions of the Joe Biden-led US government. Content posted by non-left handles were subject to arbitrary restrictions, not just in the US but also in India.
An image allegedly quoting a French Nobel Laureate on #COVID19 vaccines is circulating on social media The claim in the image is #FAKE. #COVID19 Vaccine is completely safe Do not forward this image #PIBFactCheck https://t.co/DMrxY8vdMN
— PIB Fact Check (@PIBFactCheck) May 25, 2021
This reached its zenith during the pandemic when Facebook removed a post uploaded by PIB Fact-Check, the fact-checking arm of the Press Information Bureau of the Government of India. The post had debunked the claim, attributed to French Nobel Laureate Luc Montagnier that people getting vaccinated against COVID-19 will die in the following two years.
Facebook not only deleted the post but even went to the extent of warning the PIB account of permanent suspension if such a post is made again. The PIB officials then reached out to the IT Ministry, who contacted Facebook officials. It was after such a high-level intervention that the original post was restored.
During the Covid-19 pandemic, social media activists had also shared stories on how their pro-BJP content was censored by Facebook.
In September 2020, an investigation by Sharyl Atkinson of RealClearInvestigations hadrevealed that 18 of the 20 members of the oversight board proposed by Facebook had ties to far-left billionarie George Soros.
Helle Thorning-Schmidt, former Prime Minister of Denmark, Catalina Botero-Marino, Afia Asantewaa Asare-Kyei and Sudhir Krishnaswamy were some of the members on the oversight board with ties to George Soros. Earlier that year, George Soros had declared a war against nationalists and nationalism, including Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
Tawakkol Karman, one of the members of the Facebook Oversight Board, turned out to be a member of the terrorist outfit Muslim Brotherhood.
USAID and its controversial projects in India
In February 2025, the Elon Musk-led Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) announced that it was saving US taxpayers money by cancelling projects abroad. One of them was about strengthening ‘voter turnout’ in India.
A sum of $21 million (~₹182 crore) was set aside by federal US agencies for the project. DOGE confirmed the matter in a tweet. Later, US President Donald Trump further confirmed the figures during a speech in Miami.
He had said, “And $21 million for voter turnout in India. Why are we caring about India turnout? We got enough problems. We want our own turnout, don’t we? Can you imagine all that money going to India?”
US taxpayer dollars were going to be spent on the following items, all which have been cancelled: – $10M for "Mozambique voluntary medical male circumcision" – $9.7M for UC Berkeley to develop "a cohort of Cambodian youth with enterprise driven skills" – $2.3M for "strengthening independent voices in Cambodia" – $32M to the Prague Civil Society Centre – $40M for "gender equality and women empowerment hub" – $14M for "improving public procurement" in Serbia – $486M to the “Consortium for Elections and Political Process Strengthening,” including $22M for "inclusive and participatory political process" in Moldova and $21M for voter turnout in India – $29M to "strenghening political landscape in Bangladesh" – $20M for "fiscal federalism" in Nepal – $19M for "biodiversity conversation" in Nepal – $1.5M for "voter confidence" in Liberia – $14M for "social cohesion" in Mali – $2.5M for "inclusive democracies in Southern Africa" – $47M for "improving learning outcomes in Asia" – $2M to develop "sustainable recycling models" to "increase socio-economic cohesion among marginalized communities of Kosovo Roma, Ashkali, and Egypt"
— Department of Government Efficiency (@DOGE) February 15, 2025
Donald Trump added, “I wonder what they think when they get it. Now, it’s a kickback scheme. You know, it’s not like they get it and they spend. They kick it back to the people that sent it. I would say in many cases, anytime you have no idea what we’re talking about, that means there’s a kickback because nobody has any idea what’s going on there.”
There was evidently public uproar over the revelation, given that the controversial USAID had been trying to carry out regime change operations both in India and Bangladesh.
The United States Agency for International Development (USAID) had spent $7,50,000 to supposedly alleviate loneliness among migrant workers in the country. An article about the same was published on the USAID website. It was titled ‘Alleviating Loneliness Among Migrant Garment Workers in India.’
The date of publication read 20th December 2024 although the link had been archived multiple times since 2021. The article claimed –
“More than 30 percent of India’s population are internal economic migrants who move from rural to urban areas for work, but lose important support networks when away from their homes. This separation may cause feelings of loneliness and social isolation among India’s millions of young migrants, and affect their health and ability to earn an income. Evidence suggests that social isolation and loneliness can have sweeping negative consequences ranging from a reduced sense of well-being and happiness to impairments in cognitive function, physical health, and even mortality. Workplace programs that address workers’ mental health may help to increase worker satisfaction, retention, and productivity, benefitting both the workers and the companies that employ them, but evidence is scarce.“
USAID and George Soros connection
In March 2017, the Heritage Foundation published a report detailing how USAID worked in close association with far-left billionaire George Soros during the Obama administration to promote its ‘radical agendas’ in several countries.
The report stated, “…Evidence is emerging that during the past eight years, Soros, his Open Societies Foundations (OSF), and their many smaller affiliates have received U.S. taxpayer money through USAID and that USAID has made the OSF the main implementer of its aid.“
It may be recalled that George Soros, who worked with USAID, had been eyeing a colour revolution in India.
In February 2023, the far-left billionaire exploited the Adani-Hindenburg controversy and launched a scathing attack on the Indian government.
He claimed, “Modi and business tycoon Adani are close allies. Their fate is intertwined…Adani Enterprises tried to raise funds in the stock market, but it failed. Adani is accused of stock manipulation and his stock collapsed like a house of cards.
Soros accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi of crony capitalism. “Modi is silent on the subject, but he will have to answer questions from foreign investors and in parliament,” he added.
The Hungarian-American billionaire also said that the ‘shakedown’ caused to the Indian markets due to the Hindenburg Research report will result in ‘much needed institutional reforms’ and ‘democratic revival’.
George Soros and his vicious ecosystem of NGOs, activists and journalists had been trying to prove PM Modi as an ‘electoral autocrat’ who needed to be ousted for the ‘greater good’ of this country. And it has been a work in progress for a long time.
In January 2020, the American billionaire committed $1 billion to start a global university to “fight nationalists” and climate change, calling them twin challenges that threaten the survival of our civilization.
While speaking at the World Economic Forum in Davos, Soros pledged to fund a university project to battle the erosion of civil society in a world increasingly ruled by “would-be and actual dictators” and climate change.
Soros also claimed that the “biggest and most frightening setback” was in India, as he accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi of “creating a Hindu nationalist state.”
The Hungarian-American billionaire has several intellectuals on his payroll, including the former PM Manmohan Singh’s daughter Amrita Singh. Not to forget the curious case of ‘author’ and ‘social activist’ Harsh Mander who had been at the forefront of creating civil unrest during the Anti-CAA protests.
He and his NGO Karwan-e-Mohabbat had been very active in the demonstrations held at Shaheen Bagh. “From now on, the decision will not come from the Supreme Court or Parliament. We saw what the Supreme Court did in Ayodhya, NRC and Kashmir matters,” he was heard saying in a viral video.
Harsh Mander had threatened, “The SC has failed to honour secularism, equality and humanity. We will try fighting there too, but, the decision will not happen in the Supreme court nor Parliament, it has to be made in the streets.”
At one point, he had even vowed to register himself as a Muslim if the Citizenship Amendment Act was passed. Harsh Mander had also sought the arrest of BJP leader Kapil Mishra.
It may be recalled Shaheen Bagh was masterminded by Sharjeel Imam, an Islamist who urged Indian Muslims to cut off North East India from the rest of the country.
In 2018, George Soros-funded NGO, Sherpa attempted to thwart India’s defence deal with France and stall the delivery of Rafale fighter jets.
Moreover, Open Society Foundations (OSF) run by the billionaire had funded the Socio-Legal Information Centre (SLIC), which had been active in seeking the repeal of the sedition law currently used against anti-India elements.
In September 2019, George Soros also met Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan shortly after US President Donald Trump attended Narendra Modi’s ‘Howdy Modi’ event in Houston, Texas.
George Soros had been unabashed in his attempt to fuel a dangerous anti-India narrative through media and ‘civil society. Organisations funded by him played a key role in creating chaos and unrest under the pretext of anti-farm law protests.
In 1999, the Open Society Foundation began activities in India by providing scholarships and fellowships to pursue studies and research at Indian colleges. Through the OSF, George Soros made significant contributions towards the spread of instability in India.
The Hungarian-American billionaire has also tried to use international institutions, which are funded by him, including Freedom House and V-Dem (Varieties of Democracy) Institute to tarnish the image of India at a global level.
Coincidentally, Freedom Home is a ‘prime partner‘ of the United States Agency for International Development (USAID).

title: Bengaluru Tunnel Project Rerouted Away From Historic Lalbagh Garden Following Fierce Public Opposition
description: The Karnataka government has formally shelved the proposal to acquire six acres of Lalbagh Botanical Garden for Bengaluru's p
author: Arjun Brij
content:
News Brief
Arjun Brij
Nov 26, 2026 | Updated 10:00 PM GMT+5:30
Save & read from anywhere!
Bookmark stories for easy access on any device or the Swarajya app.
The Karnataka government has formally shelved the proposal to acquire six acres of Lalbagh Botanical Garden for Bengaluru's proposed 17.6 km tunnel road project.
Greater Bengaluru Development Minister Krishna Byre Gowda confirmed the alignment of the Hebbal to Silk Board tunnel would be changed to bypass the historic garden, following fierce opposition from citizens, environmentalists and political parties.
Bengaluru Smart Infrastructure Ltd (B-SMILE) is now surveying alternative locations for the tunnel road's entry and exit points, with two possible routes near Siddapura and Wilson Garden under consideration.
The minister told reporters that surveys of the alternative alignments are underway and will be finalised soon.
The original alignment required approximately six acres inside Lalbagh for entry and exit facilities and a launch site for the tunnel boring machine.
The decision follows months of public protests under the "Save Lalbagh" campaign, which peaked in August 2026 when thousands formed a human chain around the iconic Lalbagh Rock.
The government had also withdrawn the Karnataka Parks Conservation Amendment Bill after opposition accused it of facilitating the diversion of park land for infrastructure projects.
Concerns were raised about potential damage to the garden's three-billion-year-old Peninsular Gneiss rock formation.
Gowda clarified that whilst the change in alignment could increase the overall project cost due to a longer route, there would be no increase in toll charges.
The state government has asked the Chief Secretary to negotiate with the Adani Group, the lowest bidder for construction, to manage costs.
The government plans to contribute around Rs 7,000 crore towards the project, which will connect Esteem Mall near Hebbal with the Central Silk Board junction.
BJP MP Tejasvi Surya welcomed the realignment as a partial victory for citizens but raised broader concerns about the tunnel road's impact on public transport and other heritage sites like Hebbal Lake.
The final alignment decision is expected after feasibility studies are completed and stakeholder consultations conclude.

title: Rs 500 Fine Awaits Motorists Overstaying 15-Minute Limit At Pune Airport From 1 December
description: Pune Airport will enforce a strict 15-minute time limit for vehicles using its designated pick-up and drop-off lanes from 1st
author: Arjun Brij
content:
News Brief
Arjun Brij
Nov 26, 2026 | Updated 04:40 PM GMT+5:30
Save & read from anywhere!
Bookmark stories for easy access on any device or the Swarajya app.
Pune Airport will enforce a strict 15-minute time limit for vehicles using its designated pick-up and drop-off lanes from 1 December, with motorists exceeding the prescribed duration facing a penalty of Rs 500.
The 15-minute window includes five minutes of dwell time to facilitate passenger boarding and alighting.
Airport authorities took the decision after observing that several vehicles remain in the lanes longer than necessary, with some motorists waiting or parking for extended periods.
The airport has implemented the system on a trial basis during November to familiarise motorists with the new arrangement.
Automatic Number Plate Recognition cameras at entry and exit points will capture vehicle registration details and images, enabling the system to automatically calculate the time spent by each vehicle in designated lanes.
Exit boom barriers will remain closed until violators pay the fine.
A committee constituted to examine the issue approved the restriction to improve traffic discipline and ensure efficient utilisation of available kerbside space.
A designated payment facility will be provided within the pick-up and drop-off area to avoid congestion at the exit gate.
The airport handles approximately 30,000 arriving and departing passengers daily, with congestion particularly noticeable during evening peak hours along Airport Road.

title: India Tops Global YouTube Takedowns With 34.4 Lakh Videos Removed In Three Months
description: India accounted for the largest number of YouTube video takedowns in the world in the April-June 2026 quarter, with 34.4 lakh videos uploaded from the
author: Arun Dhital
content:
News Brief
Arun Dhital
Nov 26, 2026 | Updated 03:29 PM GMT+5:30
Save & read from anywhere!
Bookmark stories for easy access on any device or the Swarajya app.
India accounted for the largest number of YouTube video takedowns in the world in the April-June 2026 quarter, with 34.4 lakh videos uploaded from the country removed, according to YouTube's latest Community Guidelines Enforcement Report.
The number marked a 28 percent jump over the January-March quarter and made up close to 31 percent of the 1.1 crore videos YouTube pulled down globally for breaching its rules. The United States came next with 12.4 lakh removals, ahead of Indonesia at 9.2 lakh.
Child safety violations were behind 68.2 percent of removals worldwide, and 98.6 percent of the deleted videos were first picked up by automated detection tools. YouTube determines a video's country of origin from the uploader's IP address, but discloses reasons for removal only at the global level, with no country-specific split.
A separate dataset, Google's Transparency Report, showed that Indian government agencies and courts sent 61 percent more content removal requests in January-June 2026 than in the previous six months. India filed 4,006 requests covering 65,091 items, placing it third globally after Russia and South Korea.
YouTube drew the most requests among Google services, at 3,399. Police agencies made 2,870 of India's requests, or nearly 72 percent, while courts accounted for 695. Defamation was the most common ground, cited in 2,130 requests.
Acting on India's requests, Google took down 19,883 items for breaching local laws and another 1,415 for violating its own policies. It took no action on 19,402 items and said it lacked sufficient information to act on 17,473 others.
The two reports measure different things. YouTube's covers videos removed for breaking platform rules, while Google's tracks requests from authorities and courts to remove content across its services.

title: बिसलेरी का पानी: क्या भरोसा करना होगा समझदारी?
description: NL Saransh investigates chemicals found in Bisleri bottled water and the 14-month probe that led to FSSAI approval for legal action
author: विकास जांगड़ा
content:
बिसलेरी कह रही है कि उसका पानी बिल्कुल सुरक्षित है. लेकिन सवाल ये है कि आखिर ये केमिकल पानी में पहुंचे कैसे?
भारत के खाद्य सुरक्षा और मानक प्राधिकरण यानि (FSSAI) को बिसलेरी के पानी के एक सैंपल में तय सीमा से ज्यादा ब्रोमेट मिला. जब दोबारा जांच हुई तो फिर इसमें पॉलीन्यूक्लियर एरोमैटिक हाइड्रोकार्बन (पीएएच) का भी पता चला. अब मामला इतना आगे बढ़ा कि 22 नवंबर को एफएसएसएआई ने कंपनी के खिलाफ मुकदमा चलाने की मंजूरी दे दी.
हालांकि, बिसलेरी कह रही है कि उसका पानी बिल्कुल सुरक्षित है. लेकिन सवाल ये है कि आखिर ये केमिकल पानी में पहुंचे कैसे? इनसे हमारी सेहत को क्या खतरा है? या इसके पीछे कोई और वजह है?
इन सभी सवालों के जवाब जानने के लिए देखिए ये सारांश.

title: Mumbai Jeweller Received Rs 10 Crore Extortion Threats Before Store Firing
description: Police in Mumbai suspect a recent firing incident at a jewellery store in Mahim is connected to a Rs 10 crore extortion attempt. The shop owner, Bharat Jain, reportedly received multiple threatening messages and calls last month, including a direct demand for money and death threats, but dismissed them as spam and did not report them to the police. Two unidentified assailants fired three rounds at the store before fleeing, with no injuries reported.
author: Text Feed
content:
Mumbai police are investigating a firing at a Mahim jewellery store, suspecting a connection to a Rs 10 crore extortion plot after the owner reportedly ignored multiple death threats and demands for money last month.
Key Points
- A firing incident at PC Jain Jewellers in Mahim, Mumbai, is suspected to be linked to a Rs 10 crore extortion attempt.
- Shop owner Bharat Jain received multiple threatening WhatsApp messages and calls last month, including a direct demand for Rs 10 crore and death threats.
- Jain initially ignored the threats, assuming they were spam, and did not report them to the police.
- Two unidentified motorcycle-borne assailants fired three rounds at the store on Wednesday evening, causing no injuries.
- Investigators believe the firing was an intimidation tactic to pressure Jain into paying the extortion amount.
A firing incident targeting a jewellery store in Mumbai is suspected to be linked to a Rs 10 crore extortion attempt and the shop owner received multiple threatening messages last month, but chose to ignore them, police said on Thursday, citing preliminary investigation.
Two unidentified motorcycle-borne assailants wearing helmets fired three rounds at the store of PC Jain Jewellers in Mahim on Wednesday evening before fleeing towards Bandra. No one was hurt in the firing.
Jeweller Ignored Repeated Extortion Threats
According to the police, the shop owner, Bharat Jain, had allegedly been receiving repeated threats through WhatsApp messages and phone calls over the past one month. However, assuming the messages were spam, he ignored them and did not approach the police.
During the investigation, police found that Jain had received threatening communications on three separate occasions before the firing incident.
On October 18, Jain received a call from an unknown number. After he did not respond, a threatening message was sent to him in the evening, warning that he would be shot. On October 24, he received another message stating, "Ready rakhna, chamatkar hoga".
The final threat, sent on October 31, reportedly included a direct demand for Rs 10 crore along with a death threat, according to police.
The final message allegedly read: "Ramji, zyada dimaag mat chala, teri janam kundli hai. Z-Plus security bhi laga rakh, paisa tujhe dena hoga. Yamraj ji ko dekhna hai toh theek, nahi toh 10 crore dena hoga".
The message warned Jain that even if he had Z-Plus security, he would still have to pay the demanded amount or face fatal consequences.
Since the threats originated from unknown mobile numbers, the shop owner initially dismissed them as spam and did not lodge a police complaint.
Police Probe Intimidation Tactic
Investigators suspect the firing was intended to intimidate Jain and pressurise him into paying the Rs 10 crore extortion amount.
Police are scanning CCTV footage from surrounding areas for clues to crack the case. Technical surveillance is also being used to identify and trace the two assailants who fled after the attack.

title: How Haryana STF Busted Major Cannabis Smuggling Ring
description: Haryana Police's Special Task Force (STF) seized approximately 371 kilograms of cannabis, valued at Rs 70 lakh, from a truck in Gurugram. Two alleged drug smugglers from Rajasthan were arrested, who were transporting the consignment from Odisha for supply in Rajasthan.
author: Text Feed
content:
Haryana Police's Special Task Force has made a significant breakthrough, seizing 371 kilograms of cannabis worth Rs 70 lakh and arresting two individuals in Gurugram, disrupting a major inter-state drug smuggling operation.
Key Points
- Haryana STF's central unit seized around 371 kilograms of cannabis, valued at approximately Rs 70 lakh, from a truck in Gurugram.
- The interception occurred late Wednesday evening on Sohna-Ballabgarh Road near Sancholi village, based on a tip-off.
- Two individuals, Sajjan and Ram Singh from Churu, Rajasthan, were arrested on the spot.
- Preliminary interrogation revealed the consignment originated from Odisha and was intended for supply in Rajasthan.
- Police are actively investigating to uncover the full smuggling network involved in this operation.
The central Unit of Haryana Police's Special Task Force (STF) seized around 371 kilograms of cannabis, worth around Rs 70 lakh, from a truck near a village here and arrested two alleged drug smugglers, an official said on Thursday.
STF Intercepts Drug Consignment
The STF intercepted the vehicle on Sohna-Ballabgarh Road in Sancholi village, located near the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway, late Wednesday evening based on a tip-off.
Two individuals -- Sajjan and Ram Singh, both residents of Churu in Rajasthan -- were arrested on the spot.
Preliminary interrogation revealed that the accused had brought the consignment from Odisha and intended to supply it in Rajasthan. The STF team is now working to uncover the links within the smuggling network, the official said.
Giving operational details, he said the STF's central unit received information that a large consignment of narcotics was being transported in a truck. Acting on the input, the team set up a checkpoint near Sancholi village late Wednesday evening and intercepted a truck bearing a Rajasthan registration number.
A search of the vehicle led to the recovery of 371.680 kilograms of cannabis hidden in 19 sacks.
An FIR has been registered against Sajjan and Ram Singh at Sohna Sadar police station, the official said.
"We are questioning the accused to trace the entire chain from the supplier in Odisha to the network in Rajasthan that was to receive the delivery," said a senior police officer.

title: Dewas Spurious Liquor Case: 16 Held, AI Used To Make Hooch
description: Police in Dewas, Madhya Pradesh, have arrested two more individuals, bringing the total to 16, in connection with a spurious liquor case that locals claim has led to over 10 deaths. One accused reportedly used artificial intelligence to devise a method for manufacturing the illicit alcohol.
author: Text Feed
content:
Authorities in Dewas, Madhya Pradesh, have made 16 arrests in connection with a deadly spurious liquor case, revealing that one accused allegedly leveraged artificial intelligence to produce the illicit alcohol.
Key Points
- Two more individuals have been arrested in the Dewas spurious liquor deaths case, bringing the total number of arrests to 16 on Thursday.
- Jitendra Malviya and Rahul Giri Goswami are suspected of being part of the local hooch distribution network.
- Locals allege over 10 deaths occurred between September 27 and November 25 due to consuming spurious liquor, though the administration has not confirmed these figures.
- One arrested accused, Ajay Rathore, reportedly used artificial intelligence to find a method for manufacturing fake liquor at home.
- Rathore procured chemicals from Indore and mixed the spurious liquor with genuine alcohol before selling it locally.
Two more people have been arrested in the alleged spurious liquor deaths case in Madhya Pradesh's Dewas district, taking the number of those held to 16, police said on Thursday.
Spurious Liquor Network Uncovered
Jitendra Malviya and Rahul Giri Goswami were suspected to be part of the local hooch distribution network, Kotwali police station house officer (SHO) Shashikant Chaurasia said.
Another two suspects named in the case are still absconding, he said.
Locals have claimed that more than 10 people died after consuming spurious liquor in Chandana, Binjana and adjoining areas between September 27 and November 25. However, the administration has not confirmed these deaths.
"One of the arrested accused, Ajay Rathore, used artificial intelligence (AI) to find a method to manufacture fake liquor at home, and procured chemicals from a private firm in Indore to prepare it. The accused mixed spurious liquor with genuine liquor and sold it locally," the official said.

title: Sheena Bora Murder Case: Indrani Mukerjea Denies Meeting Daughter On Day Of Alleged Murder
description: Indrani Mukerjea denied meeting her daughter Sheena Bora on April 24, 2012, the day the prosecution alleges Bora was murdered. Indrani also rejected allegations involving Skype calls, scouting a body-disposal location and instructions to kill Sheena and Mikhail. Sanjeev Khanna and Peter Mukerjea denied the allegations against them.
author: Charul Shah Joshi
content:
Mumbai, November 26, 2026: Indrani Mukerjea on Thursday told the court that she had not met her daughter Sheena Bora on April 24, 2012, the day the prosecution alleges she murdered Bora with the help of her driver Shyamvar Rai and former husband Sanjeev Khanna.
According to the prosecution, former INX Media CEO Indrani, her ex-husband Sanjeev Khanna and Rai allegedly murdered Sheena on April 24, 2012.
The prosecution alleged that Indrani, with the help of Khanna and Rai, also attempted to kill Sheena's brother Mikhail on the same day, but he managed to escape. The three allegedly later burnt and dumped Sheena's body in Raigad.
Accused Confronted With Rai's Testimony
On Wednesday, the court confronted three accused, Indrani, her former husband Peter Mukerjea and Khanna, with the testimony of Rai, who was allegedly involved in the murder but later turned approver.
Indrani was asked about Rai's claim that her secretary, Kajal Sharma, had instructed him to open a Skype account at Indrani's behest. Rai further claimed that Indrani had used Skype calls to give him instructions regarding the alleged conspiracy to kill Sheena and Mikhail.
Indrani denied all the allegations, saying she had never spoken to Rai over Skype.
Rai claimed that after arriving in India, Indrani asked him to hire a car and accompanied him to scout for a spot to allegedly dispose of Sheena and Mikhail's bodies. After finalising the location, Indrani allegedly spoke to Peter. Indrani dismissed the allegations as false and denied making the call.
Indrani Denies Meeting Sheena
Besides, Indrani also denied having allegedly purchased medicines — alleged to be sedatives to mix in water and give to Sheena — and later meeting Sheena on April 24, 2012.
Also Watch:
Indrani denied the allegations, saying she never met Sheena that day.
Khanna claimed he had never met Sheena and saw Mikhail only when the latter deposed before the court during the trial. Peter claimed he knew nothing and was abroad at the time in question.

title: Farmers From Four Villages In MP’s Kukshi Demand New Electricity Grid, Improved Power Supply And Immediate
description: Farmers from four villages in MP’s Kukshi demanded improved electricity supply, a new grid, repairs to low-hanging wires and transformer relocation to prevent financial losses and accidents. Meanwhile, the forest department trapped a leopard in Mogra village after four months of sightings. Residents reported five more leopards nearby, prompting calls for heightened vigilance and caution.
author: FP News Service
content:
Kukshi (Madhya Pradesh): Farmers and residents of Nanoda, Dhulsar, Nimbol and Deshwalya under Kukshi tehsil have submitted a memorandum to the superintending engineer of Madhya Pradesh West Zone Electricity Distribution Company in Dhar, seeking solutions to persistent electricity problems.
They demanded a new electricity grid at Nanoda, citing that its distance of around 18 km from the Lohari grid causes low voltage, frequently damaging farmers' motor pumps and resulting in financial losses. They also demanded that officials connect Nimbol to the Lohari grid instead of Chikhalda.
The memorandum highlighted dangerous low-hanging electricity wires at two to three locations in Deshwalya and sought their immediate repair. Farmers also demanded the relocation of a transformer in Kolgaon near the Uri River, which becomes surrounded by water when the Sardar Sarovar reservoir fills. Bharatiya Kisan Sangh office-bearers urged officials to take prompt action. They also demanded an inquiry into allegedly false cases against farmers in Dahi.
Leopard trapped in Mogra after four months of sightings
After creating panic among residents of Mogra village in Kukshi tehsil for the past four months, a leopard was trapped near the village's large pond. The forest department had installed the cage two days ago. The move was followed by a request from social worker Sonu Chauhan to the collector and commissioner during a Jan Vishwas Abhiyan camp in Bagh.
The forest department's rescue team shifted the leopard to a safe location at 10 am on Thursday. Meanwhile, residents have reported the presence of five additional leopards, including two adults and three cubs, near the new pond.
Chauhan urged residents of Mogra, Bhimpura, Khedli and Bamanbardi villages to remain vigilant, avoid venturing out alone at night and immediately report leopard sightings to the forest department.

title: ‘Crocodile Tears’: Harshvardhan Sapkal Slams BJP At Congress’ Samvidhan Bachao Rally In Thane
description: Congress organised a Samvidhan Bachao Rally in Thane, accusing the BJP-led government of undermining constitutional rights and democratic institutions. Maharashtra Congress president Harshvardhan Sapkal demanded Devendra Fadnavis' resignation from the Home portfolio following a Pune court assault, while senior leaders raised allegations of electoral manipulation.
author: Fariyal Sayyed
content:
Thane, November 26, 2026: Accusing the BJP-led Central Government of undermining the Constitution and weakening democratic institutions, the Congress party organised a massive ‘Samvidhan Bachao Rally’ in Thane on Monday, calling for the protection of constitutional rights and democratic values.
The rally was attended by Maharashtra Congress in-charge Dr Sirivella Prasad, state president Harshvardhan Sapkal, Legislative Council group leader Satej Patil, former minister Balasaheb Thorat, Naseem Khan, MPs Chandrakant Handore, Shobha Bachhav and Praniti Shinde, MLA Bhai Jagtap, Muzaffar Hussain and several other senior leaders and party workers.
The rally began with tributes to Mahatma Jyotiba Phule and Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar, followed by Sapkal administering a pledge to protect the Constitution.
Prasad Raises Concerns Over Constitutional Rights
Addressing the gathering, Dr Sirivella Prasad alleged that the Modi-Shah government was attempting to take away the rights guaranteed to citizens by the Constitution. He said the Constitution safeguards equality, individual liberty, freedom of expression and voting rights.
"The Constitution given to the country by Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar is under threat. If the Constitution is protected, the country will be protected," Prasad said.
Sapkal Targets BJP And RSS
State Congress president Harshvardhan Sapkal launched a sharp attack on the BJP, alleging that its claims of defending the Constitution were hypocritical. Referring to the RSS's historical ideological position, he alleged that the organisation had favoured the Manusmriti over the Constitution.
"The BJP, which gives importance to the Manusmriti and 'Bunch of Thoughts', is now expressing concern for the Constitution. This is nothing but crocodile tears," Sapkal said.
He also criticised the Maharashtra government over the deteriorating law and order situation, alleging that Thane had witnessed serious political and constitutional developments in the past few years.
Sapkal Demands Fadnavis' Resignation
Reacting to an assault on a person within the premises of a court in Pune, Sapkal questioned the state's law and order situation and demanded the resignation of Deputy Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis from the Home portfolio.
"Criminals are operating without fear of the law. Devendra Fadnavis has failed as Home Minister and should accept moral responsibility for the situation and resign," he said.
Also Watch:
Congress Leaders Call For Protecting Democracy
Legislative Council group leader Satej Patil said the rally was organised in Thane to highlight the need to protect democracy, referring to the political developments in the state three to four years ago. He also accused the BJP of electoral manipulation and said governments must function strictly in accordance with the Constitution.
Senior leader Balasaheb Thorat said the Constitution upholds equality and fraternity, but alleged that the BJP government was weakening these principles. He said Congress had taken to the streets to protect democracy and demanded an end to alleged electoral manipulation.
Former minister Naseem Khan also alleged that constitutional rights were under threat and said Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge and Rahul Gandhi were leading the fight to safeguard democracy.
MP Chandrakant Handore, MP Praniti Shinde, MLA Bhai Jagtap and Muzaffar Hussain also criticised the BJP government during the rally.

title: Umesh Patil : आईसमान काकींचा अवमान करणे, ही महाराष्ट्राची राजकीय संस्कृती नाही, उमेश पाटील यांचा रोहित पवारांवर निशाणा
description: राष्ट्रवादी काँग्रेसचे मुख्य प्रवक्ते उमेश पाटील यांनी रोहित पवार यांच्यावर निशाणा साधला आहे. "आईसमान काकींचा अवमान करणे, ही महाराष्ट्राची राजकीय संस्कृती नाही", अशा शब्दांत उमेश पाटील यांनी रोहित पवारांना सुनावलं आहे.
author: Chetan Patil
content:
राष्ट्रवादी काँग्रेसचे मुख्य प्रवक्ते उमेश पाटील यांनी रोहित पवार यांच्यावर निशाणा साधला आहे. "आईसमान काकींचा अवमान करणे, ही महाराष्ट्राची राजकीय संस्कृती नाही", अशा शब्दांत उमेश पाटील यांनी रोहित पवारांना सुनावलं आहे.
मुंबई : राष्ट्रवादी काँग्रेस शरदचंद्र पवार पक्षाचे आमदार रोहित पवार यांनी पुण्यातील गुन्हेगारीच्या घटनांवर भाष्य करताना पुण्याच्या पालकमंत्रीपदाबाबत वक्तव्य केलं होतं. त्यांनी केलेल्या वक्तव्यावर भाजपचे नेते तथा मंत्री चंद्रशेखर बावनकुळे यांनी टीका केली. तसेच इतर नेत्यांनीदेखील टीका केली. यानंतर रोहित पवारांनी आपल्या वक्तव्यावर स्पष्टीकरण दिलं. आपल्याला कुणाचं मन दुखावण्याचा हेतू नव्हता. उपमुख्यमंत्री सुनेत्रा पवार यांचं मन दुखावलं असेल तर आपण त्यांची माफी मागतो. पण आपण चुकीचे काही बोललो नाहीत, असंदेखील रोहित पवार म्हणाले. रोहित पवारांच्या या वक्तव्यावरुन राष्ट्रवादी काँग्रेसचे मुख्य प्रवक्ता उमेश पाटील यांनी त्यांच्यावर निशाणा साधला आहे. "रोहीतजी, माफी मागायची आणि त्याचवेळी ‘मी चुकीचं बोललो नाही’ असंही म्हणायचं, मग नेमकी माफी कशाची मागितली? माफी मागून वक्तव्य मागे घेता येईल; पण त्या शब्दांनी केलेला अपमान, दुखावलेल्या भावना आणि त्याची दाहकता पुसता येत नाही. सुनेत्रावहिनींबद्दल बोलताना राजकीय टीका आणि व्यक्तिगत अवमान यांच्यातील मर्यादा ओलांडल्या गेल्या आहेत. सार्वजनिक जीवनात वावरणाऱ्या महिलांविषयी बोलताना शब्दांचे भान आणि जबाबदारी असणे हे लोकप्रतिनिधीचे कर्तव्य आहे. स्व. यशवंतराव चव्हाणांच्या सुसंस्कृत राजकारणाचा वारसा सांगताना आपल्या बोलण्यातून आणि आचरणातूनही त्या संस्कारांचे दर्शन घडले पाहिजे", असं उमेश पाटील म्हणाले.
उमेश पाटील नेमकं काय म्हणाले?
"वैचारिक विरोधाच्या नावाखाली आईसमान काकींचा अवमान करणे, ही महाराष्ट्राची राजकीय संस्कृती नाही! सुनेत्रावहिनी या केवळ लोकनेते अजितदादांच्या पत्नी नाहीत; त्या माजी खासदार असून आज राज्याच्या उपमुख्यमंत्री आहेत. अजितदादांच्या सामाजिक आणि राजकीय वाटचालीत त्यांच्या सहचारिणी म्हणून त्या खंबीरपणे उभ्या राहिल्या आहेत. अजितदादांनी स्वतः सुनेत्रावहिनींना राजकारणात संधी दिली, त्यांच्या नेतृत्वावर विश्वास दाखवला, याचाही विसर पडू नये", अशा शब्दांत उमेश पाटील यांनी सुनावलं. "अजितदादांच्या कार्यशैलीचा गौरव करण्यासाठी सुनेत्रावहिनींच्या कार्यक्षमतेला कमी लेखण्याची आवश्यकता काय? अजितदादा हयात नसताना त्यांच्याबद्दल आदर व्यक्त करायचा आणि त्यांच्याच अर्धांगी असलेल्या स्वत:च्या काकीचा अपमान करायचा, हा दुटप्पीपणाचा संस्कार कुठून आला?", असे सवाल उमेश पाटील यांनी केले. "राजकीय निर्णयांवर जरूर टीका करा. प्रशासनातील त्रुटींवर प्रश्न उपस्थित करा. आकडेवारीच्या आधारे सरकारला जाब विचारा. पण एखाद्या महिलेच्या नेतृत्वक्षमतेवर व्यक्तिगत टिप्पणी करणे आणि नंतर सशर्त माफी मागणे, यामुळे शब्दांची जबाबदारी संपत नाही. ‘वाईट वाटलं असेल तर माफी मागतो; पण मी चुकीचं बोललो नाही’, या भूमिकेत चूक स्वीकारल्याचे नेमके कुठे दिसते?", असादेखील सवाल त्यांनी केला. "माफीची प्रामाणिकता केवळ शब्दांतून नव्हे, तर आचरणातून सिद्ध होत असते. राजकीय पदांपेक्षा संस्कार मोठे असतात. राजकीय मतभेदांपेक्षा नात्यांची प्रतिष्ठा मोठी असते. आणि राजकीय संघर्षापेक्षा महिलांचा सन्मान मोठा असतो. राजकारणात विरोध असावा, अवमान नव्हे! वैचारिक संघर्ष असावा, व्यक्तिगत द्वेष नव्हे! राजकीय महत्त्वाकांक्षेपेक्षा महाराष्ट्राच्या सुसंस्कृत राजकारणाची परंपरा मोठी आहे", असं उमेश पाटील रोहित पवारांना उद्देशून म्हणाले.
लेखकाबद्दलचेतन पाटीलचेतन पाटील महाराष्ट्र टाइम्स ऑनलाइनमध्ये डिजीटल कंटेट प्रोड्यूसर म्हणून कार्यरत आहेत. ते महाराष्ट्र टाइम्स ऑनलाइन इथे सेकंड शिफ्ट इंचार्ज म्हणून जबाबदारी सांभाळत आहेत. महाराष्ट्र, देश, विदेश, राजकीय, क्रीडा, मनोरंजन अशा विविध बीटच्या बातम्या लिहिण्याचा त्यांना अनुभव आहे. एखादी मोठी बातमी कमी वेळात सर्वात आधी ब्रेक करण्याचं त्यांचं कसब आहे. ब्रेकिंग आणि महत्त्वाच्या बातम्या कमी वेळात लिहून ते अपलोड करण्यात ते पारंगत आहेत. पण कुठलीही बातमी ब्रेक करताना तिची सत्यता पडताळणी केल्याशिवाय ते ती बातमी पुढे जाऊ देत नाहीत. पत्रकार म्हणून त्या बातमीची शहानिशा करणं ही आपली प्राथमिक जबाबदारी असल्याचं चेतन पाटील मानतात.
डिजीटल पत्रकारितेच्या या अवाढव्य मोठ्या विश्वावात पत्रकाराने एक माणूस म्हणून योग्य जबाबदारी पार पाडणं जास्त आवश्यक आहे. त्यामुळे केवळ क्लिकबेट हेडिंग करुन वाचकांची दिशाभूल न करता पत्रकारितेचं नैतिक मूल्य अंगीकारण्यावर त्यांचा भर असतो. त्यामुळे कोरोना संकट काळ असले, विधानसभा, लोकसभा किंवा स्थानिक स्वराज्य संस्थांच्या निवडणुकीचा काळ असेल, एकनाथ शिंदे यांचं शिवसेनेतील बंड असेल, शिवसेना आणि राष्ट्रवादी काँग्रेस पक्षांचा न्यायालयीन खटला असेल, भारत-पाकिस्तान युद्धजन्य स्थिती असेल, भारत-चीन सीमेवरील गलवान खोऱ्यातील संघर्ष असेल, दिल्लीच्या सीमेवरील शेतकऱ्यांचं आंदोलन असेल, त्यानंतर शेतकऱ्यांच्या आंदोलनाला आलेलं हिंसक वळण असेल, महाराष्ट्रात मराठा समाजाचे नेते मनोज जरांगे पाटील यांचं आंदोलन असेल, मराठा आरक्षणाचे आंदोलन असेल, कष्टकरी आणि शेतकऱ्यांची विविध आंदोलने असतील, विविध सामाजिक आणि राजकीय घटना असतील, ते त्या घटनांचं वृत्तांकन करताना पत्रकारितेच्या नैतिक मुल्यांचं अतिशय काटेकोरपणे पालन करण्याचा प्रयत्न करतात.
चेतन पाटील यांना पत्रकारितेत जवळपास 9 वर्षांचा अनुभव आहे. पत्रकारितेचं पदवी शिक्षण घेत अतानाच त्यांना भिवंडी महापालिका निवडणूक काळात एका पॉलिटीकल पीआर कंपनीसोबत काम केल्याचा अनुभव आहे. त्यानंतर लोकमत, न्यूज 24, जय महाराष्ट्र, आपलं महानगर, न्यूज 18 लोकमत, टीव्ही 9 मराठी अशा नामांकीत वृत्त संस्थांमध्ये काम केल्याचा अनुभव आहे. आपलं महानगरमध्ये काम करत असताना त्यांनी यूट्यूबवर आयपीएलच्या मोसमात महिनाभर विश्लेषणाचे व्हिडीओ बनवले होते. तसेच ते महाराष्ट्र टाइम्स ऑनलाईन इथेदेखील विविध राजकीय घडामोडींचे विश्लेषण करणारे व्हिडीओ बनवत असतात.
चेतन पाटील यांनी लिहिलेल्या अनेक बातम्यांचा पॉझिटिव्ह इम्पॅक्ट झाला आहे. त्यांच्या एका बातमीमुळे धुळे बस स्टॅण्डवर फिरणाऱ्या एका निराधार वृद्ध महिलेला खूप मोठी मदत झाली होती. महाविकास आघाडी सरकारने सीबीएसई आणि आयसीएसई बोर्डातील शाळांमध्ये मराठी भाषेचं शिक्षण सक्तीचं केलं होतं. पण कोरोना काळानंतर अचानक या निर्णयावर घुमजाव केल्याचं बघायला मिळालं होतं. त्यावेळी चेतन पाटील यांनी 'आपुल्याच घरात हाल सोसते मराठी' या मथळ्याखाली बातमी लाहिली होती. ही बातमी महाराष्ट्र एकीकरण समितीने रिट्विट करत मोठा मुद्दा उपस्थित केला होता. अखेर या मुद्द्यावरुन वातावरण तापल्यानंतर तत्कालीन शालेय शिक्षण मंत्र्यांना यावर स्पष्टीकरण द्यावं लागलं होतं. निर्णय मागे घेतला नसून काही वर्ष मराठी भाषेचे श्रेणीतून गुण दिले जातील, असं त्यांनी स्पष्ट केलं होतं. जीआर काढताना अधिकाऱ्यांकडून चूक झाल्याचं त्यांनी स्पष्ट केलं होतं.
चेतन पाटील यांनी लिहिलेल्या बातमीमुळे गडचिरोली येथील सीमाभागातील स्थानिक नागरिकांचा पाण्याचा प्रश्न सुटला होता. त्या भागातील स्थानिकांना पिण्याचं पाणी आणण्यासाठी खूप पायपीट करावी लागत होती. चेतन पाटील यांना स्थानिक पत्रकारांनी या घटनेची माहिती दिल्यानंतर त्यांनी खोलवर सविस्तर विषयाची माहिती गोळा करत बातमी केली होती. त्यांच्या या बातमीची दखल तत्कालीन मुख्यमंत्र्यांनी घेतली होती. विशेष म्हणजे बातमी प्रकाशित केल्यानंतर अवघ्या 15 दिवसांनी त्या भागातील नागरिकांच्या पाण्याचा प्रश्न सुटल्याची बातमी चेतन पाटील यांनी केली होती.
चेतन पाटील यांनी कल्याणच्या नामांकीत बिर्ला महाविद्यालयातून BMM (Bachelor Of Mass Media in Journalism) म्हणजेच पत्रकारितेतून पदवी शिक्षण घेतलं आहे. त्याआधी त्यांचं दहावीपर्यंतचं शिक्षण हे कल्याणच्या रॉयल हायस्कूल इथे झालं आहे. शालेय जीवनात त्यांना मराठी, हिंदी आणि गणित विषयाची विशेष गोडी होती. त्यांना लहानपणापासून कविता वाचनाचा छंद होता. त्यांनी अकरावी आणि बारावीचं शिक्षण हे विज्ञान शाखेतून केलं. पण बारावीनंतर त्यांना पत्रकारितेची वाट खुणावू लागली. त्यामुळे त्यांनी कल्याणच्या बिर्ला महाविद्यालयातून पत्रकारितेतून पदवी शिक्षण घेतलं.
महाविद्यालयीन शिक्षण घेत असताना त्यांनी विविध उपक्रमांमध्ये भाग घेतला आहे. त्यांना नाट्य आणि चित्रपट क्षेत्राविषयी नेहमीच आकर्षण राहिलं आहे. त्यामुळे त्यांनी महाविद्यालयीन शिक्षण घेत असताना जलरंग तापी नाट्य संस्थेसोबत अहिराणी आणि मराठी नाटकांमध्ये काम केलं आहे. त्यांनी राज्य नाट्य स्पर्धेत सहभाग घेतला आहे. त्यांनी 'नटसम्राट' नाटकात केलेल्या बूट पॉलिश करणाऱ्या राजाची भूमिका खूप गाजली होती. त्यावेळी त्यांच्या अभिनयाचं खूप कौतुक झालं होतं.
चेतन पाटील यांना कविता लिहिण्याचा आणि त्या सादर करण्याचा देखील छंद आहे. तसेच ज्येष्ठ आणि दिग्गज कवींच्या गाजलेल्या कविता सादर करण्याची देखील त्यांना आवड आहे. चेतन पाटील यांनी लिहिलेल्या 'भगतसिंग' कवितेची निवड ही ८९ व्या अखिल भारतीय मराठी साहित्य संमेलनात कवी कट्टा कार्यक्रमात वाचनासाठी झाली होती. चेतन पाटील यांचं आतापर्यंतचं आयुष्य खूप संघर्षमय आणि खडतर असल्यामुळे ते फार संवेदनशील आहेत. त्यामुळे संवेदनशील बातम्या हाताळताना ते अशा बातम्यांना न्याय देण्याचा पूरेपूर प्रयत्न करतात.... आणखी वाचा
संभाषण सुरू करा

title: बाळासाहेबांना जमलं, उद्धव ठाकरेंच्या काळात पाटी कोरी; 'भोपळा' फोडण्यासाठी शिंदेंची जोरदार तयारी
description: बाळासाहेबांना केवळ एकदा जमलेली किमया करून दाखवण्यासाठी एकनाथ शिंदेंच्या शिवसेनेनं कंबर कसली आहे. विशेष म्हणजे ही किमया उद्धव ठाकरेंना एकदाही साधता आलेली नाही.
author: Kunal Gavankar
content:
बाळासाहेबांना केवळ एकदा जमलेली किमया करून दाखवण्यासाठी एकनाथ शिंदेंच्या शिवसेनेनं कंबर कसली आहे. विशेष म्हणजे ही किमया उद्धव ठाकरेंना एकदाही साधता आलेली नाही.
लखनऊ: उपमुख्यमंत्री एकनाथ शिंदे यांच्या शिवसेनेनं राज्याबाहेर विस्तार करण्याची तयारी सुरू केली आहे. पुढील वर्षी होणाऱ्या उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभा निवडणुकीसाठी शिवसेनेनं कंबर कसली आहे. पक्ष उत्तर प्रदेशात जवळपास ३० जागा लढवण्याची तयारी करत असल्याची माहिती शिवसेनेचे राष्ट्रीय सचिव अभिजीत अडसूळ यांनी दिली. शिवसेना उत्तर प्रदेशात विधानसभा निवडणूक लढवण्याची तयारी करत असल्याचं पक्षाचे प्रवक्ते आनंद दुबे यांनीही सांगितलं. भाजपच्या नेतृत्त्वातील एनडीएचा भाग म्हणून निवडणूक लढवू, अशी आशा त्यांनी व्यक्त केली. 'पक्षविस्तार व्हावा असं प्रत्येक पक्षाला वाटत असतं. अधिकाधिक राज्यांमध्ये निवडणूक लढवण्याची सगळ्याच पक्षांची इच्छा असते. राष्ट्रीय पक्ष व्हावं, असं कोणत्या पक्षाला वाटणार नाही?', असा सवाल दुबे यांनी उपस्थित केला.
उत्तर प्रदेशातील शिवसेनेच्या अस्तित्वाकडेही दुबे यांनी लक्ष वेधलं. १९९० च्या दशकात उत्तर प्रदेशात शिवसेनेचा उमेदवार निवडून आला होता. पवन पांडे शिवसेनेच्या तिकिटावर विजयी झाले होते. हिंदू हृदयसम्राट बाळासाहेब ठाकरे यांच्या आशीर्वादानं पक्षानं त्यावेळी उत्तर प्रदेशात आपलं अस्तित्व दाखवून दिलं होतं. आता आमचे नेते तोच वारसा पुढे नेत आहेत, असं दुबे यांनी सांगितलं. उत्तर प्रदेशात किती आणि कोणत्या जागा लढवायच्या, याचा निर्णय पक्ष नेतृत्व घेईल, असंही दुबे म्हणाले. उत्तर प्रदेशात शिवसेनेची ताकद किती? १९९१ मध्ये अकबरपूर मतदारसंघातून शिवसेनेचे पवन पांडे विजयी झाले होते. उत्तर प्रदेशातील ते शिवसेनेचे आतापर्यंतचे एकमेव आमदार ठरले आहेत. पुढील निवडणुकीत त्यांचा पराभव झाला. बाळासाहेबांच्या नेतृत्त्वात शिवसेनेनं उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभेत खातं उघडलं नव्हतं. पण त्यानंतर शिवसेनेच्या उमेदवाराला एकदाही विजयी टिळा लागला नाही. बाळासाहेब ठाकरेंनंतर शिवसेनेची धुरा उद्धव ठाकरेंकडे आली. या कालावधीत भाजप सोबत युती असताना शिवसेनेनं अनेकदा उत्तर प्रदेशात स्वबळ आजमावलं. पण शिवसेनेची पाटी कोरीच राहिली. शिवसेनेच्या मतांचा टक्का ०.१० पर्यतच राहिला. शिवसेनेच्या उमेदवारांची अनामत रक्कम जप्त होत गेली. त्यामुळे उद्धव ठाकरेंना एकदाही न जमलेली किमया एकनाथ शिंदेंना जमणार का, उत्तर प्रदेशात शिवसेना खातं उघडणार का, याबद्दल अनेकांना उत्सुकता आहे.
लेखकाबद्दलKunal Gavankarकुणाल गवाणकर हे महाराष्ट्र टाइम्स ऑनलाइनमध्ये प्रिन्सिपल डिजिटल कंटेट प्रोड्युसर पदावर कार्यरत आहेत. मे २०२२ पासून ते मटा ऑनलाईनमध्ये काम करत आहेत. प्रिंट, टीव्ही आणि डिजिटल अशा तिन्ही माध्यमांचा एकत्रित १४ वर्षांचा अनुभव त्यांच्या गाठिशी आहे. राजकारण, समाजकारण, गुन्हेगारी यासारख्या विविध विषयांवरील बातम्यांचं लेखन करण्याचा अनुभव आहे. आंतरराष्ट्रीय घडामोडी आणि त्यासंदर्भातील बातम्या यावरही त्यांचा हातखंडा आहे.
पत्रकारितेतील अनुभव
बीएमएमचं शिक्षण घेत असताना सकाळ वृत्तपत्रातून त्यांनी बातमीदारीला सुरुवात केली. वयाच्या १९ व्या वर्षी ते सकाळमध्ये अंशकालीन बातमीदार म्हणून रुजू झाले. शहरातील मुलभूत समस्या, लोकांना दैनंदिन जीवनात भेडसावणाऱ्या अडचणी यावर त्यांनी वृत्तांकन केलं. त्यांनी केलेल्या बातम्यांमुळे काही समस्या सुटण्यास मदत झाली. मुंबईच्या दहिसर येथील गोदावरी ही मराठी माध्यमाची शाळा बंद होणार होती. त्यामुळे गरीब घरातील मुलांच्या शिक्षणाचा प्रश्न निर्माण झाला. हा प्रश्न त्यांनी बातमीच्या माध्यमातून मांडला. त्यामुळे ही शाळा वाचली. त्याबद्दल तिथल्या शिक्षकांनी 'सकाळ'चं कौतुक केलं होतं.
मालाडमधील एका खासगी संस्थेला दहिसरमध्ये नाममात्र दरात रुग्णालयासाठी दिलेली जागा, तिथे त्यांनी नियम मोडून खासगी वापरासाठी, श्रीमंत रुग्णांसाठी केलेली व्यवस्था, त्या रुग्णालयाचं दोन आमदारांनी केलेलं उद्घाटन, या सगळ्याबद्दल सखोल माहिती देणारी वृत्तमालिका विशेष गाजली. आमदारांनी सार्वजनिक निधीचा खासगी इमारतींमध्ये केलेला वापर, नियम धाब्यावर बसवून केलेली कामं या बातम्यांचीदेखील विशेष चर्चा झाली. जनतेचे प्रश्न मांडण्याचं काम त्यांनी सातत्यानं केलं.
'जय महाराष्ट्र' च्या माध्यमातून २०१३ मध्ये टीव्ही मीडियात पाऊल टाकलं. सुरुवातीला फास्ट न्यूजच्या बुलेटिनची जबाबदारी सांभाळली. त्यानंतर जनरल बुलेटिन प्रोड्युसर म्हणून काम केलं. 'मोहीम' या प्राईम टाईममधील विशेष कार्यक्रमासाठी प्रोड्युसर म्हणून काम पाहिलं, २०१४ च्या लोकसभा निवडणुकीशी संबंधित कार्यक्रमांचं संकलन केलं.
टीव्ही ९ मराठी वृत्तवाहिनीत स्पेशल पॅकेज लिहिण्याची जबाबदारी पार पडली. स्पेशल रिपोर्ट या प्राईम टाईम शोचा प्रोड्युसर म्हणून काम केलं. एकाच विषयाचे विविध पैलू प्रेक्षकांना उलगडून सांगण्याचं कौशल्य या शोमधून त्यांनी आत्मसात केलं.
लोकसत्ताच्या माध्यमातून त्यांनी २०१६ मध्ये 'डिजिटल' क्षेत्रात पदार्पण केलं. महाराष्ट्र, देश आणि आंतरराष्ट्रीय बातम्या करण्याची जबाबदारी त्यांना मिळाली. मुंबईसह महत्त्वाच्या निवडणुकांशी संबंधित बातम्या, त्यांचं विश्लेषण करण्याची संधी त्यांनी इथे मिळाली. डिजिटल माध्यमात पहिल्यांदाच न्यूजरुम बुलेटिनचा प्रयोग झाला. त्यात त्यांनी अनेकदा सूत्रसंचालनाची भूमिका बजावली. २०१७ मध्ये 'लव्ह डायरीज' नावाची प्रेमकथांना समर्पित असलेली मालिका सुरु करण्यात आली. त्यातील अनेक कथा त्यांनी लिहिल्या होत्या. या मालिकेतील बऱ्याचशा कथांचं कौतुक झालं.
लोकमत डिजिटलमध्ये त्यांनी २०१८ ते २०२२ अशी चार वर्षे काम केलं. लोकसभा, विधानसभा निवडणूक, प्रचारसभा, निकाल यांचं विश्लेषण करण्याची संधी त्यांना मिळाली. पाच राज्यांच्या निवडणुकांशी संबंधित बातम्या, निकालांचं विश्लेषण करण्याची, घडामोडींचे विविध कंगोरे उलगडून वाचकांपुढे ठेवण्याची जबाबदारी त्यांनी पार पाडली. जोक सेक्शनपासून ते अमेरिकेच्या व्हिसाशी संबंधित मालिकेपर्यंत सर्वदूर मुशाफिरी करण्याची संधी त्यांना इथे मिळाली. आकर्षक मथळ्यांमुळे त्यांच्या बातम्या वाचकांच्या पसंतीस उतरल्या.
२०२२ पासून महाराष्ट्र टाइम्ससाठी काम करताना त्यांनी राज्य ते राष्ट्रीय स्तरावरील राजकारण, समाजकारण, गुन्हेगारी, क्रीडा या क्षेत्रातील बातम्यांना प्राधान्य दिलं. बातमी मागील बातमी वाचकांपर्यंत पोहोचवण्याचा प्रयत्न सातत्यानं केला. घडामोडींचं विश्लेषण करणारे लेख त्यांनी लिहिले. एकनाथ शिंदे यांचं बंड, राष्ट्रवादी काँग्रेसमधील फूट, त्यामुळे बदललेलं राजकारण या नाट्यमय घडामोडींवर त्यांनी विस्तृत लिखाण केलं. सखोल माहिती घेऊन घडामोडींचं विश्लेषण करण्याची जबाबदारी त्यांनी समर्थपणे पार पाडली. घटनांमागील रंजक घडामोडी, वर्तमानातील बातम्यांची पार्श्वभूमी, त्यांचे होणारे परिणाम, सत्ताकारणासाठी सुरु असलेले शह-काटशह यावर त्यांनी सविस्तर लिखाण केलं. भाजपचे माजी खासदार आणि वरिष्ठ नेते किरीट सोमय्या यांना भ्रष्टाचाराच्या मुद्द्यावरुन रोखठोक सवाल करणारा त्यांचा व्हिडीओ समाज माध्यमांवर विशेष गाजला.
शैक्षणिक पात्रता
कुणाल गवाणकर यांनी २०१३ मध्ये पाटकर महाविद्यालयातून बीएमएमची पदवी संपादन केली. शालेय आणि बारावीपर्यंतचं शिक्षण दहिसरमधील शैलेंद्र एज्युकेशन सोसायटीत झालं. विद्यार्थीदशेत असतानाच त्यांना लिखाणाची गोडी लागली. मराठी भाषेवर प्रभुत्व असल्यानं त्यांनी निबंध स्पर्धेत अनेक पारितोषिकं जिंकली. बारावीच्या बोर्ड परीक्षेमेध्ये मराठी विषयात कनिष्ठ महाविद्यालयातून सर्वाधिक गुणांनी उत्तीर्ण होण्याचा मान त्यांनी पटकावला. त्यानंतर त्यांनी पत्रकारिकेचं शिक्षण घेतलं. शिक्षण घेत असतानाचा त्यांनी या क्षेत्रात काम करण्यास सुरुवात केली होती.... आणखी वाचा

title: सर्वोच्च न्यायालयाचा रीलबाज, कंटेट क्रिएटर्सना झटका; संरक्षणासंदर्भात महत्त्वाची टिप्पणी
description: सरन्यायाधीश ज्ञानेश कुमार यांना पदावरून हटवण्याची मागणी करत दिल्लीत आंदोलनाची हाक देण्यात आली होती. त्यावेळी अनेक कंटेट क्रिएटर्स आंदोलनस्थळी पोहोचले होते. त्यांच्या सुरक्षेसंदर्भात न्यायालयानं महत्त्वाची टिप्पणी केली आहे.
author: Kunal Gavankar
content:
सरन्यायाधीश ज्ञानेश कुमार यांना पदावरून हटवण्याची मागणी करत दिल्लीत आंदोलनाची हाक देण्यात आली होती. त्यावेळी अनेक कंटेट क्रिएटर्स आंदोलनस्थळी पोहोचले होते. त्यांच्या सुरक्षेसंदर्भात न्यायालयानं महत्त्वाची टिप्पणी केली आहे.
नवी दिल्ली: सर्वोच्च न्यायालयानं कंटेट क्रिएटर्स , रील बनवणारे आणि मान्यता प्राप्त पत्रकार यांच्यातील सीमारेषा स्पष्ट केली आहे. मुख्य निवडणूक आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार यांच्या विरोधात आंदोलनाशी संबंधित प्रकरणावेळी न्यायालयानं याबद्दल भाष्य केलं. स्वयंघोषित पत्रकारांना मान्यता प्राप्त पत्रकारांप्रमाणे संरक्षण मिळणार नाही, असं न्यायालयानं म्हटलं. मुख्य निवडणूक आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार यांच्या विरोधात दिल्लीत आंदोलन सुरू असताना पत्रकारांसोबत गैरवर्तन झाल्याचे प्रकार घडले. यासंदर्भातील प्रकरणावर सर्वोच्च न्यायालयात सुनावणी झाली. मान्यता प्राप्त पत्रकारांप्रमाणेच स्वंयघोषित पत्रकारांना सुरक्षा मिळेल, हे गरजेचं नाही, अशी टिप्पणी न्यायमूर्ती जॉयमाल्या बागची यांनी केली.
सर्वोच्च न्यायालयाची टिप्पणी रील तयार करणाऱ्या आणि कंटेट क्रिएटर्ससाठी झटका मानला जात आहे. सध्याच्या घडीला कंटेट क्रिएटर्सची संख्या वाढली आहे. त्यांच्या कार्यपद्धतीवर दिल्ली पोलिसांनीही प्रश्न उपस्थित केले आहेत. 'आंदोलनांचं वार्तांकन करणाऱ्या मान्यता प्राप्त पत्रकारांना संरक्षण दिलं जातं. तसंच संरक्षण आम्हालाही मिळावं, असा दावा रील बनवणाऱ्या आणि कंटेट क्रिएटर्सना करता येणार नाही,' असं दिल्ली पोलिसांनी आधीच म्हटलं आहे. '(एका पत्रकाराला) दर्जा स्वत:हून दिला जाणारा नाही. तुम्ही वर्तमानपत्राचे पत्रकार आहात, तुम्ही मान्यता (प्रेस काऊन्सिलच्या अंतर्गत) प्राप्त पत्रकार आहात. जर तुम्ही वृत्तपत्र, टीव्ही चॅनलचे पत्रकार आहात, तर त्या हिशोबानं तुम्ही मान्यता प्राप्त आहात. तुम्ही एक ऑनलाईन पत्रकारही असू शकता. तुम्ही नोंदणीकृत पत्रकारही असू शकता. पण आता आपण एक असा काळ पाहत आहोत, ज्यामध्ये लोक स्वत: पत्रकार असल्याचा दावा करतात. स्वयंघोषित पत्रकारांना मान्यता प्राप्त पत्रकारांसारखं संरक्षण मिळू शकत नाही,' असं न्यायमूर्ती जॉयमाल्या बागची म्हणाले.
लेखकाबद्दलKunal Gavankarकुणाल गवाणकर हे महाराष्ट्र टाइम्स ऑनलाइनमध्ये प्रिन्सिपल डिजिटल कंटेट प्रोड्युसर पदावर कार्यरत आहेत. मे २०२२ पासून ते मटा ऑनलाईनमध्ये काम करत आहेत. प्रिंट, टीव्ही आणि डिजिटल अशा तिन्ही माध्यमांचा एकत्रित १४ वर्षांचा अनुभव त्यांच्या गाठिशी आहे. राजकारण, समाजकारण, गुन्हेगारी यासारख्या विविध विषयांवरील बातम्यांचं लेखन करण्याचा अनुभव आहे. आंतरराष्ट्रीय घडामोडी आणि त्यासंदर्भातील बातम्या यावरही त्यांचा हातखंडा आहे.
पत्रकारितेतील अनुभव
बीएमएमचं शिक्षण घेत असताना सकाळ वृत्तपत्रातून त्यांनी बातमीदारीला सुरुवात केली. वयाच्या १९ व्या वर्षी ते सकाळमध्ये अंशकालीन बातमीदार म्हणून रुजू झाले. शहरातील मुलभूत समस्या, लोकांना दैनंदिन जीवनात भेडसावणाऱ्या अडचणी यावर त्यांनी वृत्तांकन केलं. त्यांनी केलेल्या बातम्यांमुळे काही समस्या सुटण्यास मदत झाली. मुंबईच्या दहिसर येथील गोदावरी ही मराठी माध्यमाची शाळा बंद होणार होती. त्यामुळे गरीब घरातील मुलांच्या शिक्षणाचा प्रश्न निर्माण झाला. हा प्रश्न त्यांनी बातमीच्या माध्यमातून मांडला. त्यामुळे ही शाळा वाचली. त्याबद्दल तिथल्या शिक्षकांनी 'सकाळ'चं कौतुक केलं होतं.
मालाडमधील एका खासगी संस्थेला दहिसरमध्ये नाममात्र दरात रुग्णालयासाठी दिलेली जागा, तिथे त्यांनी नियम मोडून खासगी वापरासाठी, श्रीमंत रुग्णांसाठी केलेली व्यवस्था, त्या रुग्णालयाचं दोन आमदारांनी केलेलं उद्घाटन, या सगळ्याबद्दल सखोल माहिती देणारी वृत्तमालिका विशेष गाजली. आमदारांनी सार्वजनिक निधीचा खासगी इमारतींमध्ये केलेला वापर, नियम धाब्यावर बसवून केलेली कामं या बातम्यांचीदेखील विशेष चर्चा झाली. जनतेचे प्रश्न मांडण्याचं काम त्यांनी सातत्यानं केलं.
'जय महाराष्ट्र' च्या माध्यमातून २०१३ मध्ये टीव्ही मीडियात पाऊल टाकलं. सुरुवातीला फास्ट न्यूजच्या बुलेटिनची जबाबदारी सांभाळली. त्यानंतर जनरल बुलेटिन प्रोड्युसर म्हणून काम केलं. 'मोहीम' या प्राईम टाईममधील विशेष कार्यक्रमासाठी प्रोड्युसर म्हणून काम पाहिलं, २०१४ च्या लोकसभा निवडणुकीशी संबंधित कार्यक्रमांचं संकलन केलं.
टीव्ही ९ मराठी वृत्तवाहिनीत स्पेशल पॅकेज लिहिण्याची जबाबदारी पार पडली. स्पेशल रिपोर्ट या प्राईम टाईम शोचा प्रोड्युसर म्हणून काम केलं. एकाच विषयाचे विविध पैलू प्रेक्षकांना उलगडून सांगण्याचं कौशल्य या शोमधून त्यांनी आत्मसात केलं.
लोकसत्ताच्या माध्यमातून त्यांनी २०१६ मध्ये 'डिजिटल' क्षेत्रात पदार्पण केलं. महाराष्ट्र, देश आणि आंतरराष्ट्रीय बातम्या करण्याची जबाबदारी त्यांना मिळाली. मुंबईसह महत्त्वाच्या निवडणुकांशी संबंधित बातम्या, त्यांचं विश्लेषण करण्याची संधी त्यांनी इथे मिळाली. डिजिटल माध्यमात पहिल्यांदाच न्यूजरुम बुलेटिनचा प्रयोग झाला. त्यात त्यांनी अनेकदा सूत्रसंचालनाची भूमिका बजावली. २०१७ मध्ये 'लव्ह डायरीज' नावाची प्रेमकथांना समर्पित असलेली मालिका सुरु करण्यात आली. त्यातील अनेक कथा त्यांनी लिहिल्या होत्या. या मालिकेतील बऱ्याचशा कथांचं कौतुक झालं.
लोकमत डिजिटलमध्ये त्यांनी २०१८ ते २०२२ अशी चार वर्षे काम केलं. लोकसभा, विधानसभा निवडणूक, प्रचारसभा, निकाल यांचं विश्लेषण करण्याची संधी त्यांना मिळाली. पाच राज्यांच्या निवडणुकांशी संबंधित बातम्या, निकालांचं विश्लेषण करण्याची, घडामोडींचे विविध कंगोरे उलगडून वाचकांपुढे ठेवण्याची जबाबदारी त्यांनी पार पाडली. जोक सेक्शनपासून ते अमेरिकेच्या व्हिसाशी संबंधित मालिकेपर्यंत सर्वदूर मुशाफिरी करण्याची संधी त्यांना इथे मिळाली. आकर्षक मथळ्यांमुळे त्यांच्या बातम्या वाचकांच्या पसंतीस उतरल्या.
२०२२ पासून महाराष्ट्र टाइम्ससाठी काम करताना त्यांनी राज्य ते राष्ट्रीय स्तरावरील राजकारण, समाजकारण, गुन्हेगारी, क्रीडा या क्षेत्रातील बातम्यांना प्राधान्य दिलं. बातमी मागील बातमी वाचकांपर्यंत पोहोचवण्याचा प्रयत्न सातत्यानं केला. घडामोडींचं विश्लेषण करणारे लेख त्यांनी लिहिले. एकनाथ शिंदे यांचं बंड, राष्ट्रवादी काँग्रेसमधील फूट, त्यामुळे बदललेलं राजकारण या नाट्यमय घडामोडींवर त्यांनी विस्तृत लिखाण केलं. सखोल माहिती घेऊन घडामोडींचं विश्लेषण करण्याची जबाबदारी त्यांनी समर्थपणे पार पाडली. घटनांमागील रंजक घडामोडी, वर्तमानातील बातम्यांची पार्श्वभूमी, त्यांचे होणारे परिणाम, सत्ताकारणासाठी सुरु असलेले शह-काटशह यावर त्यांनी सविस्तर लिखाण केलं. भाजपचे माजी खासदार आणि वरिष्ठ नेते किरीट सोमय्या यांना भ्रष्टाचाराच्या मुद्द्यावरुन रोखठोक सवाल करणारा त्यांचा व्हिडीओ समाज माध्यमांवर विशेष गाजला.
शैक्षणिक पात्रता
कुणाल गवाणकर यांनी २०१३ मध्ये पाटकर महाविद्यालयातून बीएमएमची पदवी संपादन केली. शालेय आणि बारावीपर्यंतचं शिक्षण दहिसरमधील शैलेंद्र एज्युकेशन सोसायटीत झालं. विद्यार्थीदशेत असतानाच त्यांना लिखाणाची गोडी लागली. मराठी भाषेवर प्रभुत्व असल्यानं त्यांनी निबंध स्पर्धेत अनेक पारितोषिकं जिंकली. बारावीच्या बोर्ड परीक्षेमेध्ये मराठी विषयात कनिष्ठ महाविद्यालयातून सर्वाधिक गुणांनी उत्तीर्ण होण्याचा मान त्यांनी पटकावला. त्यानंतर त्यांनी पत्रकारिकेचं शिक्षण घेतलं. शिक्षण घेत असतानाचा त्यांनी या क्षेत्रात काम करण्यास सुरुवात केली होती.... आणखी वाचा
